Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players' associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

**Primary Focus:**

As Director, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for defining the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda that shape Fanatics Casino performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and player insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role is the strategic link between player insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring the right problems are being solved and that learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM, and manages one Associate, Performance Creative.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the Casino performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
* Build and evolve the Casino creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
* Translate business objectives and player insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative agency, including scripts, hook variations and iteration briefs on winning concepts.
* Own the Casino testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
* Drive a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, continuously improving hit rate and speed to learning.
* Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
* Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Casino players.
* Identify and define the performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs
* Embed performance requirements into brand and full-funnel campaign briefs from the outset (in collaboration with integrated marketing and media), ensuring channel, audience, format and measurement needs are clear before creative development begins. Partner with the Casino Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
* Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
* Source player insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
* Lead performance strategy/creative insight sessions and contribute a strong POV to creative brainstorms, working closely with the Casino Creative Studio.
* Present performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews, turning results into a clear story for senior leadership.
* Lead, mentor and develop an Associate, building their craft in briefing, analysis and testing.

**How This Role Connects Across the Team:**

* Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
* Partners with the Casino Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
* Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
* Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
* Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.
* Partner with the affiliates teams to produce UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice, adapting content that's optimised for performance (via creative briefs)

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, including 3+ years leading creative strategy for a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, gaming or casino business.
* Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
* Deep knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
* Proven track record building and running creative testing programs at volume.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data, size results and translate them into clear recommendations.
* Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to an executive readout.
* Experience influencing brand and integrated campaigns across matrixed teams without direct ownership.
* Experience managing and developing direct reports.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

title: Associate Creative Director, Performance
description:
**About Sequencing**  
Sequencing is the world’s largest direct-to-consumer whole genome sequencing platform, helping define the future of AI-powered personalized health.

We’re a Series A venture-backed, fully remote company turning clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into meaningful, personalized insights. Through AI and a growing ecosystem of genomic applications, we’re building the trusted home for every genome.

In 2026, GenomeWeb named Sequencing a Best Places to Work winner, highlighting our fully remote culture of autonomy, transparency, and growth. As our COO, Shara Birn, put it: “We hire talented people, give them meaningful responsibility, and trust them to make decisions.”

**About the Role**

Sequencing.com turns clinical-grade whole genome sequencing into a lifelong source of personalized health insights, from everyday wellness questions to serious health decisions. We're rebuilding how that story looks, sounds, and performs, and we need an Associate Creative Director to lead it.

You'll define the new brand and make it earn its keep in paid channels. You'll work side by side with our product designers and agencies so the brand shows up in the product as clearly as it does in an ad. You report to marketing leadership and partner with growth, lifecycle, product marketing, and product design. This is a hands-on seat for someone who wants to ship, not just direct.

**What You'll Own**

* **The rebrand, end to end.** Lead our visual identity, voice, and creative language from concept through rollout across web, product, paid, and lifecycle.
* **Performance creative that works.** Concept, make, and iterate high-performing ads across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, CTV, and emerging AI-native channels. You live in the metrics and know why a creative won.
* **Partnership with product designers.** Work shoulder to shoulder with product design so the brand and the experience feel like one thing, from first ad to in-app moments to subscription flows.
* **Stories people trust.** Turn complex genomic data into clear, emotional, scientifically responsible stories that help people understand their genome and act on it.
* **Creative systems that scale.** Build templates, modular assets, and guidelines across acquisition, engagement, retention, and subscription so the team ships faster without losing quality.
* **Fast learning loops.** Run rapid experiments, read the results with growth, and turn what you learn into the next round.
* **A high, consistent bar.** Guide internal teammates, freelancers, and agencies, and stay close to the craft yourself: art direction, writing, design, motion, prototyping, and production.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in creative roles, with 2+ years leading creative or owning a brand at a startup or growth-stage company.
* Proven experience leading or driving a rebrand, ideally at an earlier-stage company where you built the identity and the system, not just applied one.
* A portfolio of performance creative with real results on Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or CTV in consumer subscription, DTC, wellness, or tech. You can show the numbers behind the work.
* Hands-on craft in design, video, motion, and creative strategy.
* A track record of working closely with product designers to bring a brand into the product experience.
* Solid digital marketing instincts: funnels, testing, attribution basics, and how creative drives acquisition and retention.
* You use AI tools every day for image, video, motion, copy, and ideation, and can show how they've made your work faster and better.
* Staying power. We value people who commit and grow in a role, so a history of multi-year tenures stands out.
* High ownership and autonomy in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. Experience leading teams, freelancers, and agencies is expected.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in wellness, healthtech, biotech, or another category where trust and science matter.
* Familiarity with design tools your product designers use (Figma) and comfort prototyping in them.
* Experience with lifecycle and subscription creative, such as email, onboarding, and win-back.

**Why Sequencing?**

For decades, the human genome has been one of the richest health information in the world, but most people have never been able to truly understand or use it. We’re changing that.

We're transforming billions of genetic variants and decades of scientific research into technology people can interact with naturally and trust. This isn't another health app. It's a new category that brings together bioinformatics, genetics, and consumer health.

**Your work won’t just help build Sequencing. It will help redefine how people understand themselves through their DNA for decades to come.**

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off
* Paid volunteer time off
* Fully remote work, with equipment provided and internet and cell reimbursements
* Parental bonding leave
* Private, confidential clinical-grade whole genome sequencing for you and your immediate family

*Join us in helping build the interface between humanity and its DNA!*

title: Creative Director (Organic Social)
description:
Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.

We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.

Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.

**The role**

You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.

Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.

You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.

Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.

We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.

**Requirements**

* **Proven organic social growth |** A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
* **Strategic content leadership |** Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
* **Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting |** Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
* **Content waterfall implementation |** Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
* **Management of both video editors and copywriters |** Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
* **Practical AI experience |** Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
* **Excellent written and spoken English |** The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.

**Preferred experience**

We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.

* **Significant audience growth |** Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
* **Coaching industry experience |** Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
* **YouTube or other long-form audience growth |** A record of building an audience through long-form content.
* **Commercial results |** A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.

**Working arrangement**

* This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
* Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST

**Applications**

* ***Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed.***
* Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within ***one to two weeks*** of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.

*Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!*

title: Creative Director
description:
Matchnode is a performance agency built for digital health. Our clients grow on qualified patients, completed appointments and revenue. In a category where every brand promises “personalized care: and “a provider today”, the work that wins says something no one else is saying, in a way people believe.

The Creative Director sets Matchnode’s creative point of view and leads the team that brings it to life. You’ll push briefs past the obvious and bring clients ideas that make them nervous and excited. You’ll show our clients why these ideas are worth pursuing using performance data, category insights and culture.

You’ll partner with Accounts and Paid Media as a business leader, not a service function. Together you’ll share how our clients grow and how Matchnode wins new business.

This is a hands-on role but your real output is a team that thinks bigger, and clients who trust us with bigger ideas.

**Core Creative Leadership Responsibilities**

* Define the agency’s creative POV: What great digital health advertising and marketing looks like, and why ours is different from other competing agencies.
* Translate complex health services into clear, empathetic language that helps people understand their options and take an informed next step.
* Own creative strategy for paid social, with Meta and Instagram as core channels and TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels as client needs require.
* Set the standard and tone for ideas, writing and craft across every account
* Bring cultural moments, platform shifts and category trends into the agency and the work before clients ask for them (or expect them)
* Push the briefs. Challenge the ask, the obvious angle until the problem is worth solving for.
* Turn audience insight, funnel data and competitive gaps into campaign platforms
* Own the creative roadmap with Paid Media, balancing big swings with iteration of proven sprint work.
* Carry winning ideas through to landing pages and conversion assets so the journey feels like one brand
* Build a culture where creatives feel inspired and connect creative to outcomes

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

**Creative & Production**
-------------------------

* Write and edit headlines, hooks, scripts and landing page copy, when needed.
* Direct statics, carousels, motion, short-form video, creator content (UGC), clinician explainers, demos, patient stories, etc.
* Make platform native work for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other channels as needed.

**Testing & Performance**
-------------------------

* Partner with Paid Media and Analytics to run a structured creative testing program. Define the hypothesis, audience insight, primary variable, and success criteria before production.
* Review performance at the concept, message, format, and asset level. Use attention and click metrics as diagnostic signals alongside conversion rate, cost per qualified acquisition, and downstream outcomes.
* Distinguish creative findings from changes in spend, targeting, landing pages, attribution, or patient intake. Avoid declaring winners from limited or misleading data.
* Turn results into clear recommendations: what to scale, what to revise, what to stop, and what to test next. Document learnings so they inform future work across the team.
* Monitor fatigue and maintain a steady pipeline of fresh concepts and useful variations that supports client growth.

**Client Collaboration & Team Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead creative discovery, concept presentations, and performance reviews. Explain the audience insight, creative rationale, and proposed test in language clients can evaluate.
* Partner with account management and paid media. Own creative recommendations, quality, and delivery.
* Coach internal creatives and external partners, set clear standards, and develop their ability to connect craft with measurable outcomes.
* Oversee briefing and creative process, feedback, approvals, workload, and production schedules across accounts. Flag scope changes and resource constraints early; deliver within agreed hours, budgets, and deadlines.
* Use AI and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, variations, and production where appropriate, with human review for accuracy, originality, brand fit, and sensitive content.
* Support new business and account growth through relevant concepts, case studies, and creative recommendations. Help leadership scope and price creative work realistically.

title: Creative Director
description:
### **About Us!**

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

### **About Fivestone Studios!**

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

### **Your Mission**

We are looking for an experienced **Creative Director** to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is **hands-on in visual development**, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

**PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Experience Strategy & Design**

* Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.
* Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.
* Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.
* Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

#### **2. Creative & Art Direction**

* Lead the creative direction across projects, defining the visual language, tone and overall approach.
* Develop and present concepts, mood boards, visual references and creative treatments.
* Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.
* Maintain creative consistency and quality across all outputs and disciplines.

#### **3. Creative Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and guide multidisciplinary creative teams, providing clear direction, feedback and creative decisions.
* Work closely with UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists, Creative Technologists, Developers, Animators, 3D Artists, Sound Designers and Producers.
* Encourage collaboration, experimentation and creative problem-solving.
* Ensure all disciplines remain aligned with the agreed creative vision and quality expectations.

#### **4. Technology & Production Collaboration**

* Work closely with Creative Technology and Production teams to ensure concepts are technically and operationally achievable.
* Understand relevant technologies, platforms and physical environments, recognising their opportunities and limitations.
* Balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, scope, budget and schedule.
* Identify potential constraints early and develop creative solutions without compromising the core experience.

#### **5. Creative Oversight & Delivery**

* Maintain creative oversight from concept development through to final delivery.
* Review designs, prototypes and integrated experiences, providing clear and constructive feedback.
* Make timely creative decisions and guide adaptations throughout development and production.
* Identify and resolve creative and experience-related issues, ensuring the final work maintains the quality, coherence and intent of the approved vision.

### **Your Journey**

#### **Must Have**

* **Experience:** developing immersive and interactive experiences across physical and digital environments.

* **Senior Creative Direction Experience:** Extensive experience leading the creative vision and execution of multidisciplinary projects from concept through final delivery.
* **Visual Design & Art Direction:** Strong artistic foundation with the ability to independently establish visual direction and create initial concepts, treatments and style frames.
* **Experience Design:** Proven expertise in shaping engaging user and audience experiences, including experience strategy, UX and interaction design.
* **Content Production:** Demonstrated experience directing sophisticated and technically complex content production across animation, game engines, film, UI and interactive experiences.
* **End-to-End Creative Ownership:** Ability to maintain creative leadership and involvement throughout development and production, ensuring the final experience reflects the approved creative vision.
* **Multidisciplinary Leadership:** Experience guiding creative teams across visual design, motion, animation, content, UX/UI, 3D and creative technology.
* **Creative Technology Understanding:** Strong understanding of technology-driven experiences, including technical possibilities, limitations and integration considerations.
* **Production Awareness:** Ability to balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, production constraints, budgets and schedules.
* **Creative Communication:** Ability to present concepts, communicate artistic direction, provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Background in brand experiences involving immersive, interactive or technology-driven creative work.
* Experience directing creative work across a broad range of content formats and production disciplines.

### **Engagement Opportunity**

The collaboration will begin on a **freelance basis**, with the intention of transitioning into a **full-time role** if there is a strong mutual fit. This is a remote position.

This opportunity is part of Fivestone Studios' long-term creative needs.

Thank you for applying. We’re committed to an inclusive process and we welcome talent from all walks of life. We aim to review every application. title: Art Director, Motion and Brand
description:

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

### **About the Role**

The PrePass marketing team is tasked with expanding the PrePass brand. We are energized by the prospect of breaking ground in our field and making a positive impact within the transportation industry. We are looking for an Art Director, Motion and Brand, with strong design, motion, and animation fundamentals and a passion for visual storytelling. This person not only values great craftsmanship but also knows how to turn complex products and ideas into clear, compelling video and animation that share the PrePass story and purpose with our customers.

As the Art Director, Motion and Brand, you'll work with the Senior Art Director, the Director of Marketing Comms, and the larger Marketing team to bring the PrePass brand to life in motion. You'll own video and animated content for performance marketing campaigns, product launches, social, web, and events, with secondary responsibility for digital design across email, social, landing pages, and other channels. This role requires strong organizational and communication skills to manage multiple projects, timelines, and deliverables.

### **Essential Responsibilities**

### **Video, Motion, and Animation**

* Conceptualize, storyboard, and produce video and animated content for social, web, email, paid media, webinars, and trade show screens.
* Create product explainers, animated demos, and short-form videos that make complex solutions—toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety—easy to understand.
* Design and animate 2D motion graphics, kinetic typography, illustrated animation, and animated data visualizations.
* Edit and finish video from raw footage, including pacing, sound design, music selection, captioning, and color correction.
* Support video shoots, customer testimonials, and event coverage, from shot lists to final edit.
* Build animated brand elements, including logo animations, lower thirds, transitions, and title sequences.
* Develop motion guidelines and reusable templates that keep video and animated content consistent and on-brand.

### **Brand and Creative Support**

* Design marketing assets, including emails, social graphics, landing pages, web banners, and paid ads.
* Create supporting collateral and assets for campaigns and events, such as video thumbnails, ad variations, and presentation graphics.
* Extend the PrePass visual brand identity consistently across video, motion, and digital channels.
* Generate strong conceptual ideas aligned with strategic business goals.
* Clearly articulate creative rationale, concepts, and visual direction to key stakeholders.
* Contribute to all phases of the creative process: research, brainstorming, scripts, storyboards, animatics, style frames, and final production.

### **Collaboration and Tools**

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.
* Use design and production tools such as Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, and Asana, along with generative AI tools such as Adobe Firefly and Google Flow, to speed up ideation and production.
* Prepare and optimize files for each channel, including aspect ratios, file sizes, and accessibility standards.

### **Project Execution**

* Manage day-to-day workflow while meeting deadlines across multiple initiatives.
* Support marketing events such as webinars, trade shows, and product launches with motion and design assets.
* Stay current on design, animation, and video trends and bring fresh ideas to the team.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Qualifications/Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in design, motion graphics, and animation, gained at an agency, startup, or in-house team.
* A portfolio and reel that showcase polished video editing, motion graphics, animation, and strong design fundamentals—including typography, layout, color, and composition.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions through a strategic business lens.
* A self-starter who takes full ownership of design projects, both large and small.
* Strong prioritization skills with the ability to manage timelines across multiple initiatives.
* Based in the United States.

### **Bonus Points For**

* B2B marketing experience, especially translating technical products into clear visual stories.
* Experience with 3D tools (Cinema 4D, Blender), AI-assisted design and video tools, or Lottie/web animation.
* Knowledge of the transportation, logistics, or fleet management industry.
* Availability in Mountain Standard Time or West Coast time zones.
  

  
  
**Benefits**  

### **How We Will Take Care of You**

* Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
* Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
* 401(k) plan with employer match.
* Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
* Tuition Reimbursement Program.
* Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
* Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
* Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
* Community Give-Back initiatives.
* Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

**Join Us**

**At PrePass, our mission drives us.**

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

**Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.**

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Foundation**

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

**Mission of the Role**

You own the quality bar for everything creative Foundation delivers: written content, design, video, and social and ad creative. You make sure the work clients get is clear, distinctive and built to be found and cited, and that every pod holds it to the same standard. Your job is making the work better and keeping it that way as we grow.

You work across all of our client teams. Each team is led by a Group AEO Marketing Director who owns a book of clients, with an AEO Program Director who runs delivery. Our writers, designers, editors and producers sit in those pods. The Head of Paid Media, the Head of Organic & AI Visibility and their leads set the standard for their channels. You hold the creative bar across all of them.

**Reports to:** Head of Client Services. Direct reports: creative makers not yet placed in pods. Dotted line: the writers, designers, editors and producers in every pod and through our freelance partners.

**What you'll own:**

* The quality gate. You design the creative quality check every piece goes through before it reaches a client: the criteria, the checklists, and who runs it in each pod. Pods run the check day to day. You review a sample of work each week, handle escalations, and personally review high-stakes work, such as a new client’s first deliverables. Work that isn’t ready goes back with feedback the maker can act on.
* The creative standard. You set and document what great looks like at Foundation: guidelines, examples, storytelling and brand frameworks, and the checklists the gate uses.
* Your team. You manage and develop the creative makers who aren't yet placed in pods. The resource manager staffs them across pods. When each pod can keep one busy, they move into pods and stay on your dotted line.
* Creative hiring. You run the technical skill assessment part of every creative hire and have a veto on creative quality.
* Creative levelling. You define what each level of writer, designer, editor and producer looks like, and give input on their promotions.
* Coaching. You give the people who make the work regular, specific feedback, train them, and close skills gaps across pods.
* AI in the creative workflow. You build and roll out AI tools and workflows that raise quality and speed, and make sure AI-assisted work still meets the bar.
* Partners and freelancers. You make sure third-party creators and editors meet the same standard as our own team.

**What you bring:**

  

* 8+ years in creative leadership for B2B brands, in an agency or in-house, with a portfolio across writing, design and video.
* You've built a quality system before: standards, review gates and feedback loops that held up as volume grew.
* You make the call. You hold the bar under deadline pressure and say no when work isn't ready, without needing someone more senior to back you.

title: Art Director, Brand & Design
description:

**Location:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Director of Brand Marketing  
**Status:** Full-Time  
**Salary Range:** $110,000-$130,000  
**Direct Reports:** Graphic Designers

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded haircare brand dedicated to restoring crowns and confidence. What began as a kitchen remedy has evolved into one of the most celebrated textured-hair care brands in the U.S., loved for our authentic story, transformative results, and community-first approach.

It’s an exciting time to join our team as we grow and build a culture rooted in creativity, collaboration, and care. Together, we’re shaping the next chapter of a brand powered by community and led by purpose to help people everywhere love their hair, love their journey, and love themselves.

**Role Overview**

Bask & Lather is seeking an Art Director, Brand & Design to bring our brand to life across campaigns, digital experiences, product packaging, retail displays, and experiential marketing.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a strong designer who can develop compelling concepts, personally execute key creative, and lead graphic designers to deliver cohesive, commercially effective work. You will translate brand strategy into clear visual direction and help build the systems, standards, and team capabilities needed to support a growing beauty brand.

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Art Direction & Brand Design**

* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for integrated campaigns, product launches, and ongoing brand marketing.
* Translate approved brand strategy into clear art direction, design briefs, and cohesive execution across customer touchpoints.
* Maintain and evolve design standards, templates, and asset libraries within the brand’s established identity.
* Art direct photography, short-form video, creator content, and product demonstrations, including mood boards, composition, styling, and post-production guidance. Ensure clear product education and consistent brand presentation.

**Hands-On Creative Execution**

* Personally design key creative across e-commerce, social, email, paid media, marketplaces, sales materials, and brand campaigns.
* Develop platform-specific creative for TikTok Shop, paid and organic social, creator content, and livestream shopping, adapting storytelling and design to how customers discover and purchase on each channel.
* Translate customer questions, hair concerns, cultural insights, and relevant trends into creative that resonates with our audience and reflects the brand’s voice and standards.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-Commerce, and the Director of Creative Performance to develop and refine creative using performance insights and customer feedback, supporting structured testing and iteration.

**Packaging, Retail & Experiential Design**

* Design packaging, labels, cartons, kits, and other physical brand materials from concept through production-ready artwork.
* Develop retail displays, merchandising assets, signage, and environmental graphics that translate the brand into physical spaces.
* Work with internal partners and external vendors on dielines, specifications, proofs, color, materials, and finishes.

**Team Leadership & Creative Operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop graphic designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback.

* Review deliverables for brand consistency, accuracy, channel suitability, and production readiness.
* Build scalable workflows that improve turnaround time and reduce unnecessary revisions while maintaining high standards.

**Key KPIs & Success Metrics**

* A cohesive, recognizable brand across digital and physical touchpoints.
* Strong creative delivered accurately and on time.
* A design team with clear direction, useful feedback, and consistent standards.
* Packaging and displays that meet brand, retailer, and production requirements.
* Creative systems that support growth and improve team efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional brand design or creative experience, including experience leading designers and providing art direction.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating consumer brand campaigns, photography and short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand experiences.
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with strong typography, composition, layout, and image-editing skills.
* Practical knowledge of packaging and print production, including dielines, artwork preparation, color management, and proof review.
* Experience designing for e-commerce and digital marketing, with an understanding of how creative supports customer education and conversion.
* Strong judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to move projects forward independently.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to balance personal execution with effective delegation.
* Experience in beauty, haircare, skincare, wellness, or consumer packaged goods is strongly preferred. Experience supporting social commerce, particularly TikTok Shop, is strongly preferred. Ability to direct video and motion work is required; hands-on motion design or video editing is a plus.

**Why Join Bask & Lather Co.?**

* Be part of a passionate, fast-paced team changing the narrative around scalp care
* Play a pivotal role in a high-growth, high-impact brand with national reach
* Directly support strategic initiatives and help shape scalable infrastructure

title: Head of Design
description:
**About Cardiff**

Cardiff lends to small businesses. Since 2004 we've funded more than $12 billion across the country, to businesses in logistics, healthcare, construction, professional services, and plenty in between. We're building our own underwriting technology, and we still answer the phone; our customers need capital fast, and they want a straight answer from a person who can actually help.

**Location:** San Diego, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Department:** Product and Design

**Reports to:** CMO

**Why This Role Matters**

Our customers are small business owners who need capital quickly and clearly. Every screen, form, and message they see shapes whether they trust us enough to apply, finish, and come back. As Head of Design, you'll set the standard for how Cardiff looks, feels, and works across our product, our brand, and every customer touchpoint, and you'll build the team and design system that keep that standard high as we grow.

**What You'll Own**

  

* Set the design vision and strategy for Cardiff's customer-facing products, internal tools, and brand, in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and leadership
* Lead end-to-end product design for the borrower journey, from first visit and application through underwriting, funding, and repeat borrowing
* Design internal tools for our underwriting, funding, sales, and servicing teams so they can move faster with fewer errors
* Build and maintain a scalable design system in Figma, with documented components, patterns, and accessibility standards that engineering can ship from directly
* Own brand and visual identity across web, paid media, email, direct mail, and sales materials, partnering closely with Marketing on campaign creative
* Ground design decisions in evidence through customer research, usability testing, funnel analytics, and split testing, with clear metrics tied to conversion and customer experience
* Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and the disclosure and compliance requirements of a regulated lending business
* Hire, lead, and develop the design team, running a predictable cadence of critique, delivery, and accountability
* Use AI tools throughout the design process, from research synthesis to prototyping, and help the team do the same

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3 years leading designers and owning design outcomes for a digital product at a growth-stage company. Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services is a strong plus.
* **Product Design Craft:** A portfolio that shows strong interaction design, visual design, and information architecture on complex, multi-step flows such as applications, onboarding, or dashboards.
* **Design Systems:** Hands-on experience building and scaling a design system, and working closely with engineers to implement it in code.
* **Tools:** Expert-level Figma skills, fluency with prototyping and AI-assisted design tools, and a working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and how front-end code gets built.
* **Research and Data:** Comfort running user research and usability tests, and reading product analytics to find friction and measure the impact of design changes.
* **Leadership Style:** Hands-on, execution-focused leader with strong cross-functional communication skills; able to give clear feedback, make decisions with incomplete information, and explain design choices to non-designers. **Must have experience managing at least 4 direct reports.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Industry Perspective:** Experience designing for small business owners, B2B customers, or regulated, high-trust products such as lending, payments, or banking.
* **Conversion Design:** A track record of improving funnel conversion, application completion, or activation through measured design changes.
* **Brand Leadership:** Experience leading a brand refresh or building a visual identity system that works across product and marketing channels.
* **Content Design:** Skill at writing and shaping clear product copy, especially for financial terms, disclosures, and error states.
* **Organizational Scale:** Experience building a design function at an early or growth-stage company, including hiring, career leveling, and managing freelance and agency partners.

**This Role May Not Be a Fit If You**

* Want a strategy or advisory seat rather than hands-on ownership of the work that ships
* Have been out of the tools long enough that you'd need someone else to build the file or the prototype
* Prefer structured corporate environments with clear lanes and layers between you and the business
* Solve problems offline and come back with polished results, instead of sharing work early and communicating while you work
* Use AI tools to assist your old workflow, rather than having rebuilt your workflow around them

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary range: $195,000+
* Performance bonus of up to 20% of base, tied to delivery and business outcomes
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Flexible PTO and observed holidays
* Remote-first, with support for your home-office setup
* Direct access to leadership and to the problems that matter

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Design Director, Brand
description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**Location:**
New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
  
  
**About The Team**
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the
**Design Director**
on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

title: Robotics Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

**The role**
------------

As a Robotics Mechancial Engineer, you will play a key role in the design and development of our robots. You will be responsible for creating robust and efficient mechanical mechanisms, assemblies, and systems that integrate with advanced robotic technologies. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, bringing together expertise in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering.

**The day-to-day**
------------------

* Design and develop mechanisms, systems, and electromechanical assemblies for robotic applications, including structures, actuators, and motion systems.
* Collaborate closely with the electrical and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of mechanical designs into complete robotic systems.
* Prototype, test, and iterate on mechanical designs to meet performance, cost, and manufacturability requirements.
* Analyze project specifications, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure that designs meet both functional and production objectives.
* Use CAD tools (SolidWorks) to create detailed designs, 3D models, and engineering drawings.
* Participate in design reviews, contributing innovative solutions and improvements.
* Conduct simulations, stress analysis, and FEA to ensure reliability, durability, and safety of the designs.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting during product development and manufacturing processes.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.

**You should apply if you**
---------------------------

* Hold a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master's preferred).
* Have demonstrated of experience in mechanical design, preferably in robotics or automation.
* Are proficiency with CAD software (ideally SolidWorks).
* Have a strong understanding of mechanical principles, including statics, dynamics, and material properties.
* Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
* Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
* Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
* Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
* Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
* Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.

**Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns
* The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world
* Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward
* In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts
* We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn't work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive salary** and **VSOP options**
* **Relocation support**: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
* **Learning**: €500/£450 yearly allowance
* **Health & wellness**: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
* **Social**: regular company events and monthly social allowances
* **Enhanced parental leave**: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Family support:** 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
* A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled "Infraduction"), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one (Specifically for engineering and AI)

*These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.*

  

*Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.*

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, ” What’s the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We’re seeking an experienced Experiments & Insights Lead to join our Experiments & Insights (EXPI) team in Barcelona to to direct, mentor, and grow a team of data analysts dedicated to our most dynamic product verticals: Prime (our flagship subscription program), Accommodations (Hotels), and Checkout/Payments.

In this role, you will lead 6 dedicated data analysts, champion statistical rigor, and raise the bar for analytical excellence across high-stakes experimentation funnels. You will partner as a peer with our other Analytics Lead—who oversees our Customer Experience, Transport, and Discovery verticals—to establish unified experimentation frameworks, share best practices, and build a cohesive cross-vertical analytics culture.

Additionally, as our analytics workflows evolve, you will play a pivotal role as a **Domain & Semantic Architect**, standardizing semantic data models, schemas, and context layers that empower our internal AI workflows (such as agentic code generation and automated test analysis) and enable product teams to make safe, self-service data decisions.

This is a high-leverage leadership position (~80–90% people leadership, technical governance, and strategic steering; ~10–20% targeted hands-on analysis for complex problems). If you’re ready to soar, we’re ready to take you there.

**Why eDreams ODIGEO**
  
We’re the world’s leading travel subscription platform.

* We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
* Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
* 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
* This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
* Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

**What you will do:**
  
The Role’s Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Experiments & Insights Lead in the EXPI team you will be in charge of:

Team Development & People Leadership

* Directly lead, mentor, and coach a team of **6 talented data analysts** embedded within Prime, Accommodations, and Checkout.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, intellectual curiosity, continuous learning, and experimentation integrity.
* Conduct regular 1-on-1s, set clear performance objectives, design career development plans, and support the hiring and onboarding of future team members.

Dual-Lead Partnership & Cross-Vertical Alignment

* Co-Lead the EXPI Function: Partner closely with our parallel Analytics Lead (overseeing CX, Transport, and Core Funnels) to co-drive team-wide operational standards, tooling choices, and talent practices.
* Harmonize Methodologies: Ensure cross-funnel consistency in tracking definitions, KPIs, metric attributions, and experimentation methodologies, eliminating reporting discrepancies between interlocking product verticals.
* Run structured weekly alignment sessions within your verticals to eliminate analytical silos, share learnings, and standardize reusable dashboards and reporting assets.

Operational Governance & Technical QA

* Act as the primary technical sign-off and QA authority for complex experiment designs, tracking plans, and post-experiment analyses in your business domains.
* Establish best practices for code reviews (SQL/Python/R), query optimization, and reproducible analytical pipelines.
* Balance analytical depth with operational speed, helping your analysts prioritize high-impact business questions over reactive, ad-hoc queries.

AI Modernization & Semantic Architecture

* Champion the integration of modern AI tools (e.g., LLM code assistants, automated analytical pipelines) to scale analyst efficiency and slash test time-to-insight.
* Act as the **Hub Semantic Architect**: maintain and govern machine-readable domain logic, data dictionaries, metric definitions, and schema contexts (.yaml) to ensure internal AI agents and automated statistical engines generate accurate, hallucination-free code and insights.
* Partner with Product and Data Engineering to expand safe, guardrailed self-service experimentation capabilities for Product Managers.

Strategic Partnership & Business Impact

* Serve as the strategic analytics partner to Product Directors and Business Leads across Prime and Accommodations, translating complex statistical evaluations into clear, actionable business strategies.
* Proactively identify systemic product opportunities or friction points within subscription lifecycles, booking flows, and transaction funnels.
* Bridge quantitative experiment results with qualitative user research and data science predictive models to deliver rich, holistic product recommendations.

Targeted Hands-On Guidance

* When needed, contribute directly to complex analyses and collaborate on high-impact projects.
* Set methodological benchmarks that upskill your analysts and elevate the team’s overall data craft.

**What you need to succeed:**
  
Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here’s what you need to succeed:

Leadership & Management Experience

* Proven Leadership: 2+ years of experience managing, leading, or mentoring data analysts in a fast-paced, product-led environment.
* People-First Mentality: Demonstrated passion for growing individual careers, giving constructive feedback, and building psychological safety.
* Collaborative Mindset: Strong collaborative instincts with proven experience co-leading initiatives or closely aligning with peer leads across interconnected business lines.
* Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex statistical findings into compelling executive narratives for non-technical stakeholders (Product, Commercial, Engineering).

Technical & Experimentation Expertise

* Deep Experimentation Acumen: Strong practical mastery of online controlled experiments (A/B/n testing, multivariate testing, Sample Ratio Mismatch detection, power analysis, variance reduction techniques, and sequential or Bayesian testing).
* Advanced SQL & Data Warehousing: Expert-level SQL skills working with massive, multi-table datasets (Google BigQuery preferred; Snowflake or Redshift experience welcome).
* Data Visualization & BI: Proficiency in enterprise BI platforms (Looker, Tableau, or Looker Studio) building scalable, governed reporting assets.
* Modern Data & AI Awareness: Experience in leveraging AI coding tools, building semantic data layers (e.g., dbt, metric stores, machine-readable YAML dictionaries), and deploying automated analytical workflows.
* Analytical Tooling (Bonus): Working knowledge of Python or R for statistical analysis and causal inference is a strong plus.

Domain Experience (Nice to Have)

* Prior experience analyzing subscription models (churn, lifetime value, recurring retention curves), marketplace/travel dynamics, or checkout/conversion funnels.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Experience with Applied AI Tools:** Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
* **Experimentation Mindset:** Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
* **AI-Enhanced Problem Solving:** Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
* **Adaptability and Learning Agility:** Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.

**What’s in it for you?**
  
The best talent deserves the best benefits

Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and **device ownership** through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

* Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
* Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You’ll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
* Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
* Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You’ll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

Wanna take a peek into what it’s like to work at eDO?

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.
