title: Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe
description:
**About the Role**

Teach For All is seeking a dynamic and strategic leader to support a diverse group of network and prospective partner organizations in the Europe region and to lead regional work on public sector partnerships. As a Senior Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe, you will steward Teach For All's engagement with a group of partner organizations in the Europe region, working to build and deepen relationships and collaboration in pursuing educational equity in Europe. In this role you will act as a strategic advisor to partner organizations, diagnosing needs and opportunities, consulting on strategic challenges, and mobilizing network resources to drive collective impact.

In this position, you will also play a critical role in strengthening partner organizations' public sector partnerships through targeted support around institutional relations strategy development and execution in key countries in Europe. You will work closely with global team members to build more active partner connections and collaboration with their governments (Ministries of Education at national, regional or local levels; regional and local authorities; universities and research institutions), by developing specific partner support initiatives, contributing to Erasmus+ projects, and designing learning experiences and ad-hoc resources when needed. The ideal candidate for this position will have a proven ability to work effectively across diverse contexts and cultures, navigating ambiguity with ease, and will have experience making sound strategic decisions that drive impact in complex and changing environments.

This role provides an exceptional opportunity for an individual with superior leadership, strategic, interpersonal, and programmatic skills to increase the impact of our mission and shape the education landscape in the region. The strongest candidates will have a proven ability to set a clear vision, build culture and relationships, influence outcomes through others, and make strategic decisions that drive meaningful impact. A strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is essential.

The ideal candidate will have a deep familiarity of living and working in Europe, must reside and be authorized to work in the region, speak English and ideally one additional regional language. The Director - Partner Engagement & Institutional Relationships, Europe will report to the Head of Partner Engagement & Program - Europe and work closely with the Head of Region, Europe on external positioning and advocacy.

**Outcomes**

* Regional partner organizations are highly engaged with each other and the network and are dedicated to our mission and values, and to contributing to progress towards Teach For All's vision and intended outcomes, as measured by the annual network survey.
* Partner organizations in the region are better supported to develop and implement new, innovative and forward looking public sector partnerships that enable them to scale their programmes and increase their impact in the education system.
* There is growth in aggregate progress across the region, as demonstrated by relevant measures for the intended outcomes:

* Our network is expanding in the region.
* Collective leadership is strengthening within the communities and countries of network partners.
* Students in our classrooms are developing holistically as leaders who can shape a better future.
* Our network staff members, teachers, and alumni are a deeply interconnected, learning regional and global community.
* Insights from our network inform the regional understanding of what will drive progress for marginalized children.
* Strengthened relationships with regional program stakeholders in the region generating new opportunities for impact and influence. Support the growing impact of alumni in the region as leaders in schools and the education ecosystem.

**Key responsibilities:**

Partner Support (40%)

* As a "portfolio lead," serve as the primary day-to-day relationship holder with a portfolio of current and prospective partner organization CEOs, cultivating relationships to build positive, long-term partnerships as a means to achieving shared and mutually beneficial goals and outcomes
* Co-create and manage the implementation of an annual partnership plan with each organization in the Network Engagement Director's portfolio, identifying how Teach For All will support them and how they will contribute back to the network on an ongoing basis. This plan will include the strategic engagement of other colleagues, teams and resources from across Teach For All
* Share insights, ask thoughtful questions, and provide support to partner and prospective partner organization CEOs and their leadership teams, to build their capacity, advance strategic clarity and impact, and foster learning and sharing across the network, in line with Teach For All's shared global vision and priorities

Public Sector Support (50 %)

* Work directly with CEOs and Head of Institutional Relationships in each partner organization to develop strong public sector strategies and action plans to identify new champions in government and identify new ways of partnering with the public sector to increase their ability to scale their programmes and increase their impact by leveraging regional, national and multinational opportunities
* Leveraging deep understanding of the educational landscape, develop and execute on strategies that build external champions and elevate awareness of our programmatic work in Ministries of Education and Ministries of Labour and Social Welfare, Regional and Local governments, and Universities across the region
* Continue to build more capacity across the region, in both partner organizations and Teach For All to develop and manage stronger public sector relationships in pursuit of sustainability and scale of our work in Europe
* Facilitate meaningful learning experiences for partner organizations in the region, virtual and in-person when possible, such as immersive experiences and peer-to-peer visits for network partner organizations and emerging social entrepreneurs, fostering collaboration, culture, and connection in line with our broader network vision and values
* Lead initiatives and strategies on region wide and global priorities to contribute to progress against our network intended outcomes
* Co-build public sector partnership collaboration and learning across the region and globally
* Support leadership development of key stakeholders in the region from alumni and senior partner staff through coaching and leadership development experiences

Contribute to Teach For All globally (10%)

* Work with the other global teams to contribute to global priorities and initiatives in particular in relation to our leadership development and program strategies
* Represent the global organization as needed at external opportunities

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience & Track Record: Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including demonstrable success leading senior-level public sector partnerships and navigating complex government or education systems across Europe.
* Contextual & Geographic Mastery: Deep familiarity with living and working within the European sociopolitical landscape, with current legal authorization to live and work long-term in an eligible hiring country.
* Strategic Systems Thinking: Proven ability to analyze educational landscapes, navigate bureaucratic systems, and design actionable public partnership strategies that achieve scale and sustainability.
* Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional interpersonal and political acumen, with a track record of building trusted relationships with senior leaders, government ministers, and diverse community stakeholders.
* Adaptive Leadership: Demonstrated experience navigating ambiguity, leading through influence across matrixed and cross-border teams without formal authority, and making sound decisions in complex environments.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: Demonstrated commitment to DEI principles, with deep self-awareness and the ability to navigate racial, cultural, ideological, and power dynamics across countries.
* Linguistic Capability: Professional fluency in written and spoken English, paired with strong, professional-level communication skills.

**Additional Desirable Skills / Experiences**

* Fluency or professional working proficiency in French or an additional European language.
* Direct professional experience working inside schools, school networks, or national education ministries.
* Formal executive or leadership coaching experience supporting senior executives and social entrepreneurs.
* Prior hands-on experience designing or managing EU-funded programs (e.g., Erasmus+ projects).
* Familiarity with the Teach For All network model and theory of systemic change.

**What Teach For All Offers:**

* Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization's progress
* Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
* Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
* Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
* And much more!

**Application Instructions**

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Work authorization**

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

**Compensation**

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

**Travel and Hours**

Most work is delivered virtually. Up to 30% of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

**About Teach For All**

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations' under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All's global organization works to increase the network's impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

title: Lead Deployment Strategist - EMEA
description:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and lead a high-performing Deployment Strategist team that helps n8n's enterprise customers turn automation opportunities into measurable business impact. You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

### **Build & Lead the Deployment Strategist Team**

* Hire, onboard, and coach a team of Deployment Strategists who partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver high-impact customer engagements.
* Set a high bar for executive discovery, ROI definition, change management, and customer handovers, ensuring consistent delivery quality across the team.
* Stay hands-on by leading customer engagements yourself while building the team, creating a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer impact.

### **Own & Scale the Deployment Methodology**

* Build and continuously improve our four-phase engagement methodology (Define, Identify, Co-build, Handover), including ROI frameworks, discovery guides, opportunity assessments, and handover templates.
* Partner with CSMs, AEs, and Sales leadership to identify and qualify high-impact customer opportunities, define clear success criteria, and scope the right engagement model.
* Turn learnings from workshops, hackathons, on-site builds, and staff augmentation engagements into repeatable playbooks that scale across FDE, Customer Success, and partner teams.

### **Drive Customer Adoption & Business Outcomes**

* Lead executive discovery and ROI conversations to align customer stakeholders on high-value automation opportunities, success metrics, and organizational change.
* Measure engagement success through workflows deployed to production, customer adoption improvements, and measurable business outcomes, rather than services delivery alone.
* Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers and provide CS and GTM leadership with visibility into engagement results, customer ROI, and expansion opportunities.

### **Scale Delivery Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Partner Delivery Manager and Partnerships teams to ensure external delivery partners follow the same engagement methodology and quality standards.
* Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.
* Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.

**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------

### **Must-haves**

* **Enterprise Customer Experience:** You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.
* **People Leadership:** You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.
* **0-to-1 Builder Experience:** You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.
* **Executive Stakeholder Management:** You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.
* **Technical Fluency:** You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.
* **Operational Excellence:** You know how to define success metrics, build scalable methodologies, and turn customer engagement learnings into actionable playbooks.
* **Customer Outcome Mindset:** You're focused on driving measurable customer adoption and long-term value, rather than simply delivering projects or completing engagements.

### **Nice-to-haves**

* **Automation Platforms:** You're familiar with n8n or other workflow automation, integration, or low-code platforms.
* **Change Management:** You have experience helping enterprise organizations drive adoption, navigate organizational change, and embed new technologies into their ways of working.
* **Partner Ecosystems:** You've worked with systems integrators, consulting firms, or external delivery partners to deliver customer implementations or technical engagements.

title: Process Automation Engineer
location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, CN, Spain
description:
##### ***-******Las Palmas De Gran Canaria******-***

**Alien Technology Transfer** empowers top-class innovators to transform visionary product concepts into commercial realities. We do this by helping companies with concrete growth ambitions to secure funding for their product development through our innovation consulting expertise. To date, we have raised more than $700 million for our clients - Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) - across many domains, including agri-tech, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, clean-tech, cyber-security, quantum computing, space, and transport.

We’re looking for a versatile **Process Automation Engineer** to join Alien Technology Transfer at **our office in Las Palmas**. Working closely with and reporting directly to our CEO, you will play a central role in a company-wide review of how each of our departments operates. Your job is to understand how work actually gets done, identify where time, quality and effort are being lost, and then design, build and maintain the tools that fix it. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role that combines process analysis with full-stack engineering. You will spend time with department heads and their teams to map workflows and pinpoint inefficiencies. You will turn your findings into standardised processes and reliable software that is easily adopted. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer, nor for someone who only writes code to a specification. We need a strong generalist who can diagnose a business problem, decide what should be standardised, automated or eliminated, and then deliver a working solution end-to-end.

To join our team, you must possess a genuine interest in technology and business, be fluent in English, and take a highly analytical, articulate, and well-organised approach to your work. We are seeking a self-motivated team player with a strong startup attitude and the stamina to thrive within an ambitious, goal-driven environment. The ideal candidate is eager to take on high levels of responsibility, possesses sharp problem-solving skills, and is proactive about staying up to date on the latest tools — AI or otherwise — to ensure top performance. You are energised by wearing multiple hats—effectively managing priorities and diverse deliverables autonomously without needing a detailed playbook. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in this dynamic role, we would be excited to hear from you.

* **Contract Type:** Permanent.
* **Hybrid Work Modality:** Monday to Thursday at the Office (Las Canteras area) and Friday Work from Home.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

Process Diagnosis & Standardisation

* Work with each department to map current workflows and understand how work is actually done.
* Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated effort, error-prone manual steps and activities that add little value, and quantify their impact where possible.
* Define standardised processes, templates and quality checks that reduce variability and prevent quality issues before they reach clients.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CEO and department heads, and prioritise improvements by impact and effort.

Tool Development & Platform Engineering

* Design, build and maintain internal tools and applications that enhance the performance of each department, from data layer through to API and user interface.
* Integrate tools with the systems our teams already use, such as Google Workspace, Odoo, and other AI-powered tools, so that solutions fit naturally into existing workflows usable by department personnel.
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and keep internal tools documented and easy to hand over.

Infrastructure & Deployment

* Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
* Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

* Support teams in adopting new tools and processes through clear documentation, training and hands-on support.
* Define and track metrics that show whether each change is improving department performance, and iterate based on results and user feedback.
* Continuously identify new opportunities for standardisation and automation as the business evolves.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
* Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM or other AI/ML-based solutions.
* Proven ability to analyse business processes and translate them into practical software or automation solutions.
* Ability to translate user needs into clear UI/UX requirements (user flows, screens, states, edge cases) and to evaluate and refine interfaces until they are intuitive for non-technical users.
* Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with non-technical colleagues, understand their needs, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem from diagnosis through to a deployed, maintained solution.
* Fluency in English (C1/C2 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience building AI tools that work with documents, such as searching, summarising, extracting or checking text (e.g. RAG, vector databases, NLP).
* Experience with Google Workspace APIs and workflow-automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make).
* Knowledge of process-improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma or business process mapping.
* Experience in consultancy or professional-services environments, particularly in document-heavy work such as proposal or report writing.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Relocation & Bureaucracy Support: Dedicated guidance and administrative assistance for obtaining your Spanish NIE, social security, and local residency registration in Las Palmas.
* Work Flexibility: Hybrid work model (4 days onsite / 1 day WFH) + 20 extra remote working days per year to use at your convenience.
* Health & Wellbeing: Private health insurance coverage.
* Time Off: 30 days of paid annual leave.
* Company Culture: Regular team-building events, social activities, and a vibrant work environment in a co-working space just 50 meters from the beach in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria.

Please note: Due to the high volume of candidates, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback on the outcome of every application.

title: Fabrications - Mechanical Engineering
description:
The Mechanical Engineering role is part of the Fabrications team within the Wind Machine Head Engineering Subsection. This position involves ownership of mechanical components with significant human interaction, such as working surfaces, railings, ladders, trays, machinery protections, and brackets. Responsibilities include New Product/Technology Introduction, Validation & Testing, Field Support, and Root Cause Analysis. The role requires design and development of mechanical components under the technical guidance and mentorship of senior engineers.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Technical Contribution:** Support the design of fabricated wind turbine components and help resolve mechanical engineering challenges under the guidance of senior engineers.
* **Project Execution:** Support New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, technology integration, and field issue resolution by completing assigned engineering tasks, with a primary focus on safety, quality, and reliability.
* **Product Safety and EHS:** Support the identification and mitigation of risks for safety-critical components, helping ensure designs meet tolerable risk levels. Assist in the resolution of SAFER cases by completing assigned action items in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* **Systems Thinking & Integration:** Develop a "Systems Thinking" mindset to understand how components integrate into the overall turbine design. With support from senior engineers, learn to assess tradeoffs and communicate the implications of component changes on the wider machine.
* **Compliance & Standards:** Apply relevant design practices, industry regulations, and standards to the design of mechanical components. Build and maintain knowledge of the engineering requirements affecting wind turbine systems.
* **Tools & Process:** Apply standardized engineering tools, analysis, and calculation methodologies to ensure a rigorous engineering approach. Share observations and lessons learned to support continuous improvement of our designs.
* **Risk Management:** Participate in risk identification and mitigation activities, including DFMEA sessions, helping to ensure that potential failure modes are identified, addressed, and validated against quality and reliability standards.
* **Prototyping & Validation:** Assist in the prototyping and physical testing of mechanical systems. Help investigate and resolve technical issues or defects identified during the validation and testing phases.
  

  
  

**Critical Soft Skills**
------------------------

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of the quality and integrity of assigned design tasks, working to meet Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) expectations and seeking guidance when needed.
* **Innovation:** Shows curiosity and proposes practical improvements to existing designs or processes within a fast-paced engineering environment. Learns to balance creative thinking with engineering rigor.
* **Proactiveness & Energy:** Demonstrate a positive, collaborative energy and a strong willingness to learn across the organization, contributing to an environment focused on continuous learning and technical excellence.
* **Effective Communication:** Ability to communicate technical problems, progress, and open questions in clear, factual, and simple terms to team members and stakeholders.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* **Experience:** Relevant product design and development experience, ideally in the wind industry.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Working knowledge of mechanical design (static, fatigue), FEM (Finite Element Method), and manufacturing processes (Sheet metal, machining, welding).
* **Software Tools:** Knowledge of CAD (Unigraphics NX 3D-CAD preferred), CAE tools (Ansys, Hypermesh), and PLM tools.
* **Travel:** Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% of the time
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**
---------------------------

* Knowledge of structured problem-solving (RCA) and Lean design principles
* Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in international, multi-disciplinary project teams (Electrical, Structural, and Systems).
* Familiarity with wind turbine structural components and internal mechanical systems, or with similar mechanical products in other industries.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Group Product Manager (Core)
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead Wrike's Core unit - the product area at the heart of how customers plan, structure, manage, and scale work in Wrike.

In this role, you will lead a unit of five product teams and manage a team of five Product Managers. You will define the vision and strategy for Core Wrike going forward, balancing three critical forces: increasing product power, preserving ease of use, and evolving the experience to be suitable for the AI-native future.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can combine strong product judgment, people leadership, customer empathy, and strategic prioritization. You will help shape the foundation of Wrike's product experience while developing a team of PMs into stronger strategic product leaders.

### **Your Impact:**

* Set the Core strategy: Define and evolve the vision, strategy, and priorities for Wrike's Core unit, ensuring the product remains powerful, scalable, easy to use, and ready for AI agents collaboration as well as for human.
* Lead a multi-team product area: Manage five Product Managers across five teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, strong decision-making, and consistent product quality across the unit.
* Prioritize ferociously: Balance customer requests, enterprise needs, technical investments, usability improvements, and long-term strategic bets — with a clear view of what matters most.
* Enable AI-native R&D: Contribute to building the processes, tooling, and mindsets needed for the R&D organization to scale output and outcomes by 10x with AI-native ways of working.
* Develop the PM team: Coach, mentor, and grow Product Managers, helping them to achieve the next level.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* Product leadership experience: Proven experience leading product managers or managing a complex product area with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Strong core PM craft and customer-centric mindset: Deep understanding of product discovery, customer validation, roadmap strategy, prioritization, metrics, and product delivery.
* Enterprise SaaS experience: Strong knowledge of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer needs, including scalability, adoption, usability, configurability, and change management.
* Strategic prioritization: Ability to make hard trade-offs across incomparable investments, customer escalations, technical complexity, and long-term platform direction.
* Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management: Ability to align teams and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive leadership.
* People management skills: Experience coaching, mentoring, hiring, developing, and managing performance of product managers.
* Excellent UX judgment: Ability to balance power and simplicity in complex product experiences.

### **Standout Qualities:**

* Experience in B2B SaaS enterprise products in collaboration or productivity area
* Practical understanding of AI-native product development and agentic workflows.
* Visionary mindset and ability to redefine complex products vision
* Strong technical fluency and ability to partner effectively with engineering leaders.

### **Our Work Style:**

* Core product impact: You will shape the foundational Wrike experience used by customers every day to manage work at scale.
* Strategic complexity: The role requires balancing power, simplicity, customer demand, technical depth, and AI-readiness in one of Wrike's most important product areas.
* People leadership scope: You will directly develop a team of five PMs and influence the product culture of a larger R&D unit.
* AI-native transformation: You will help define how Core Wrike evolves for a future where AI changes how teams create, structure, and manage work.
* High visibility: Your decisions will influence Wrike's product direction, customer value, and long-term competitiveness.

### **What's Next?**

* Exploratory call with a Recruiter
* Meeting with the hiring manager - Product Director
* Panel interview with Product, Engineering, and Design representatives
* Home task
* Final interview with the CPO

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies and plans that drive revenue and support the hotel's business objectives. This role oversees the execution of marketing initiatives, including digital marketing, advertising, public relations, social media, promotions and collateral, ensuring alignment with brand standards and commercial priorities.

The Marketing Manager is committed to bringing to life a distinctive luxury boutique hotel shaped by arts, creativity and curiosity. From its distinctive suites to its singularly designed restaurants, bars, spaces and experiences unfolding across a dedicated floor, every touchpoint presents an opportunity to provoke, inspire and indulge, revealing a new expression of Barcelona through a oneiric, enigmatic and cosmopolitan lens.

Deeply connected to local culture and its artistic excellences, the Marketing Manager ensures that every expression of the hotel remains distinctive, meaningful and authentic.

The Marketing Manager supports the Director of Marketing & Communications in translating the hotel's marketing strategy and positioning into effective plans, campaigns and day-to-day execution. The role is hands-on and highly transversal, partnering closely with hotel departments and external agencies to ensure consistency, creativity and excellence across every guest-facing touchpoint.

**Content Management & Storytelling**

title: Director, Site Enablement Solutions
description:

**Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships.**
-------------------------------------------------------

  
  

IQVIA is changing an entire industry through inspired innovation. Our people make the difference. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we look for talented people and give them meaningful work to do. Join IQVIA and help us drive healthcare forward.

----------------

Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Head of Site Enablement Solutions, the Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships will lead execution of the business growth strategy through strategic account planning, executive customer engagement, customer expansion, opportunity conversion, and commercialization of emerging capabilities.

  
  

This is an execution-focused commercial leadership role requiring deep expertise in site support, site augmentation, and site engagement. The Director will develop customer-specific solutions and creative commercial structures that balance customer needs with pricing, geographic reach, implementation requirements, and operational delivery feasibility. The role will be dedicated to Site Enablement Solutions and will work across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy to convert opportunities into sustainable, deliverable partnerships.

* Build and maintain executive customer relationships, stakeholder maps, sponsorship models, and governance approaches.

* Establish disciplined account reviews, opportunity ownership, executive stakeholder mapping, and progress reporting against growth priorities.
* Provide coaching and subject matter guidance to colleagues supporting customer engagement and solution positioning.
* Initially operate as an individual contributor; the role may assume leadership of customer-aligned delivery resources as the operating model and business needs evolve.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

  
  

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research, healthcare services, contract research organization services, site services, or a related life sciences environment.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic account management, customer partnerships, commercial growth, solution development, or business development.

title: Cuentas (Barcelona) - Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle.
description:
**Queremos conocerte en el equipo de Cuentas Barcelona**

Somos una agencia de comunicación creativa.

Nuestro propósito es conectar a las marcas con sus audiencias de forma genuina, memorable y hecha para durar.

Estamos cerca de la cultura y conectados a las conversaciones que marcan la vida de las personas. Entendemos qué le importa a cada audiencia, y quién la inspira, para ayudar a las marcas a crear contenido relevante y a ganarse un lugar con sentido en la mente de la gente.

Nuestra fórmula: experiencia, curiosidad y trabajo en equipo.

**¿Que buscamos?**

Queremos conocer a profesionales de **dirección de cuentas** que quieran formar parte de nuestro equipo en Barcelona. Abrimos 2 posiciones para liderar la comunicación de marcas de **Moda y Gran consumo. (Moda & lifestyle y Gran consumo & Lifestyle)**

**Cómo es un rol de cuentas en Equipo Singular**

En Equipo Singular, el director/a de cuentas es quién conoce a la marca, el entrono y las tendencias. Quien define la estrategia de comunicación y lidera al equipo para trabajar un buen plan en tiempo y forma, con los mejores resultados para el cliente y la agencia.

**En su día a día:**

* Es el interlocutor principal del cliente y su socio estratégico.
* Define las estrategias de comunicación y relaciones públicas del sus marcas y vela por que cada acción responda a ellas.
* Dirige al equipo multidisciplinar que formamos (prensa, social media, influencers, eventos, contenidos, creatividad, video..) y coordina su trabajo.
* Gestiona la rentabilidad del proyecto: desde el presupuesto y la facturación hasta su cierre de resultados.
* Detecta oportunidades y participa en propuestas a nuevos clientes.
* Tiene un pensamiento crítico para mejorar su día a día, para tomar decisiones, par implementar procesos y herramientas (incluidos la IA) que le ayuden a mejorar a si mismo/a, y al equipo.

* **Equipo implicado y con ganas de hacer proyectos retadores,** con una buena dirección general creativa y dirección de negocio.

* **Horario:** flexible de entrada y salida, con jornada intensiva todos los viernes y en julio y agosto.

* Experiencia demostrada (Mínimo 4 - 6 años) en agencia de comunicación y/o relaciones públicas.

* Experiencia liderando equipos multidisciplinares.
* Experiencia en la gestión económica de clientes.
* Curiosidad por las tendencias, la cultura y el negocio de tus clientes.

**Director, Management Consulting - Public Sector, Iberia**

Are you passionate about helping clients navigate the most critical challenges of the digital age? Do you have experience shaping and scaling high-impact, technology-enabled transformation? Are you a visionary builder who thrives in entrepreneurial environments?

  

If the answer is yes, we have an exciting opportunity for you to help architect the next chapter of **Uvance Wayfinders** , Fujitsu’s global consulting brand, in Europe.

Working side by side with clients, we deliver integrated solutions that span the full lifecycle of change, from initial strategy to sustained impact. We are focussed on fostering an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives.

  

In Iberia (Spain and Portugal), we are building the practice from the ground up, with Data & AI at its core and an initial focus on Banking & Insurance, Energy & Utilities and the Public Sector. We connect strategy, technology and execution end-to-end, from the first diagnosis through to production.

  

**Your role will involve:**

As Director for the Public Sector, you’ll work closely with the Consulting Partner to open and grow the sector across Iberia. Your challenge is to help public administrations and public companies use AI and data to deliver better services to citizens and run more efficiently, doing it safely, transparently and in line with regulation.

  

As a market-facing visionary, you’ll be targeted to pursue new revenue and business development opportunities, whilst nurturing key client relationships, and leading collaborative, high-performing consulting teams. Your exceptional ability to build and maintain lasting, trusted relationships will empower clients to fulfil their business aspirations.

  

As a thought leader in your field, you’ll influence the future of Uvance Wayfinders consulting, bringing fresh perspectives and creative, innovative solutions.

  

**As a Director, you will be responsible for:**

**Business Development**

* Driving the go-to-market strategy for the Public Sector in Iberia and leading business development efforts, including public tenders, proposals and executive presentations, resulting in standalone consulting revenue growth.
* Defining our Data & AI proposition for public administrations and public companies: better services for citizens, operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making and trusted, sovereign AI.
* Identifying opportunities across central, regional and local government and public companies, and shaping them into viable procurement routes, such as framework agreements, open tenders and innovation procurement.
* Identifying pull-through opportunities for technology solutions and services through consulting engagements and gained knowledge of clients’ challenges.
* Shaping complex value cases and facilitating executive workshops that link AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.
* Leading deal shaping, pricing and commercial negotiations, and managing revenue, margin and delivery health across engagements.
* Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities with public administrations and public companies across Iberia.
* Creating eminence and thought leadership through provocative points of view on AI in public services, trust and digital sovereignty.
  

**Client delivery & leadership**

* Setting the direction for complex, multi-disciplinary consulting engagements, identifying the right functional knowledge, technical expertise and proprietary tools required to deliver.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to senior public officials and executives of public companies on AI- and data-driven transformation.
* Leading programmes where AI improves public services: citizen service with AI agents, case management and document processing, fraud detection and planning.
* Building data foundations for the public sector: data governance, interoperability, data sharing between administrations and data quality.
* Advising clients on how to deploy AI responsibly and in line with regulation, including the EU AI Act, GDPR and, in Spain, the National Security Framework (ENS).
* Turning strategy into pilots with clear, measurable results and scaling them into production.
* Collaborating with the wider Uvance Wayfinders network and technology partners to bring the right capabilities and solutions to each client challenge.
* Providing senior technical oversight across multiple AI and data engagements.
* Validating architectural approaches spanning data platforms, machine learning, large language models, AI agents and orchestration layers.
* Ensuring AI solutions are production-grade, scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards, with strong engineering discipline and MLOps practices.
* Guiding teams on trade-offs between rules-based systems, machine learning, LLMs and hybrid approaches.
* Acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical, architectural or Responsible AI decisions.
* Building and sustaining long-term client relationships, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
  

**Practice development**

* Collaborating with the Consulting Partner to shape the Public Sector offering, including methodologies, accelerators and thought leadership.
* Building a high-performing Public Sector team, providing direction, mentorship and quality assurance over team performance and deliverables.
* Working with Uvance Wayfinders partners across Europe and with the teams already present in client accounts.
* Inspiring Uvance Wayfinders consultants to realise their full potential, supporting collaboration, continuous development and a culture where talent thrives.
  

**Your transferable skills and experience:**

* 14+ years of experience in consulting or equivalent senior leadership roles, including experience at Director or Associate Partner level in a tier-one consultancy or technology advisory firm.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with public sector decision-makers and to win public tenders.
* Experience working with public administrations and public companies in Iberia, at central, regional or local level.
* **Solid knowledge of public procurement, including Spain’s Public Sector Contracts Law (Law 9/2017) and Portugal’s Public Contracts Code, and of how consulting and technology services are bought.**
* Solid knowledge of the regulatory framework for AI and data in the public sector, including the EU AI Act, GDPR and the ENS, and its impact on AI initiatives.
* Track record leading data, AI or digital transformation programmes in the public sector.
* Experience building practices or offerings from scratch and taking them to market.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach to growing, developing and inspiring cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of modern data and AI architectures, including cloud-native data platforms and pipelines, machine learning and advanced analytics, LLM-based solutions (prompting, RAG, agents), and orchestration, monitoring and lifecycle management.
* Experience overseeing AI systems in production and understanding their operational risks: performance, drift, reliability and security.
* Proven ability to build complex value cases and to facilitate workshops with senior decision-makers to shape engagement outcomes.
* Strong commercial acumen, with revenue and margin accountability.
* University degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* Fluent Spanish and professional English; Portuguese is a plus.
  

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with European funding programmes for digital transformation.
* Experience with sovereign cloud or sovereign AI initiatives.
* Knowledge of interoperability frameworks, such as Spain’s National Interoperability Framework (ENI) and the EU Interoperable Europe Act.
* Market presence through teaching, speaking or publications.
  

**Recruitment process:** The recruitment process consists of 2-3 stages.

  

**About Uvance Wayfinders**

Uvance Wayfinders is Fujitsu’s global consulting business, launched in February 2024. The name reflects what we do: help organisations find their way when the route is unknown or uncertain, from setting direction and designing the strategic path to guiding implementation. We combine AI-driven consulting, deep industry expertise and advanced technology to turn strategy into measurable business outcomes, connecting strategy, architecture, technology and execution from planning through to adoption. Our services span four domains: Industries, Operations, Experiences and Technologies.

We are people centric: Our hybrid work environments enable you to Be Completely You. Our active people-led Inclusive Community networks are representative of all aspects of diversity and are instrumental in enabling and supporting our innovative approach to inclusion.

title: Continous Improvement Specialist
description:
**Position Summary**

  

The Supply Chain Continuous Improvement Process Analyst drives continuous improvement across supply chain international operations, identifying inefficiencies and leading small-to-medium improvement projects across the APAC, EMEA, and LATAM regions. This role applies Lean methodologies to reduce waste, cost, and lead times, while working closely with regional teams that operate across different time zones, languages, and business cultures. It works to harmonize processes across regions, ensuring consistent standards and ways of working while respecting local operational realities.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  

* Work with regional teams across planning, and logistics (transport and warehousing) in APAC, EMEA, and LATAM to identify process improvement opportunities, and align with the Supply Chain Director to prioritize and lead small-scale improvement projects.

* Apply Lean tools (5S, Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis, PDCA) to diagnose inefficiencies and design solutions adapted to regional constraints.

* Map current-state processes and design future-state workflows with measurable KPIs (cost, lead time, quality, service level, etc.), consistent across regions but flexible to local realities.

* Facilitate Kaizen events and improvement workshops with cross-functional, cross-regional, and often virtual teams.

* Track and report project progress, savings, and impact to global and regional management.

* Support standardization of best practices and documentation (processes, work instructions, etc.) while allowing for necessary regional adaptations.

* Coach and train regional team members on Lean principles and a continuous-improvement mindset, considering cultural and language differences.

* Collaborate with other departments’ teams (IT, Sales, Finance, etc.) to identify opportunities.

* Monitor post-implementation results across regions to ensure sustained improvements (control phase).

* Manage stakeholder communication across multiple time zones, adjusting meeting schedules and communication style as needed.
  

Note: *The responsibilities listed above are not exhaustive and may be subject to updates or periodic review.*

  

**Education & Experience**

  

**Educational Requirements & Skills:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.

* Solid knowledge of Lean/Continuous Improvement methodologies

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certification (or working toward it) is a plus.

* Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with Excel, data analysis tools, and process mapping software (Visio, Bizagi, etc.).

* Good project management skills — able to plan, execute, and close small projects independently, often remotely.

* Strong cross-cultural communication and facilitation skills; comfortable working with stakeholders across APAC, EMEA, and LATAM.

* Proactive, hands-on, and detail-oriented, with a structured problem-solving approach
  

**Professional Experience**

  

More specifically, we are looking for the following attributes and competencies:

  

* 5+ years of experience in supply chain, operations, or process improvement roles.

* Prior experience working in or with international/multi-regional teams is a strong plus.

* Proven experience leading or supporting small improvement projects.

* Experience with ERP systems (SAP and Sage) used across multiple regional entities, is a plus, but not required.

* Exposure to digital transformation / automation projects in supply chain, is a plus, but not required.

* Languages: Candidates must be fluent in both English and Spanish. Additional languages relevant to APAC or EMEA operations (e.g., Mandarin, German, French) are a plus but not required.
  

**Pay and Benefits**

  

The estimated base pay for this position is EUR 36.000 annually.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

  

Vantage is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other protected category.

  

**About Vantage**

  

Vantage provides natural solutions to our customers’ technical performance and marketing needs through a unique combination of chemistry, application expertise and service. Underpinned by our broad portfolio of formulations, ingredients and actives that are built on a backbone of sustainable oils, fats and their derivatives, Vantage targets selected markets and applications including personal care, food, surface treatment, agriculture, pharma, and consumer and industrial performance. Vantage is headquartered in Deerfield, IL., operates in 11 countries worldwide and employs more than 1,000 talented professionals focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences with every interaction.

  

We are a dynamic people-centered organization where you’ll be part of a collaborative global team. Embracing our cultural diversity, we learn from each other to constantly improve, adapt and iterate. We value the voices and talents of our colleagues, empowering them to drive their unique ideas to completion. We’re convinced that exceptionally motivated employees produce outstanding results and we celebrate them by fostering a culture of recognition, development, learning, excellence and shared achievement. Most importantly, we know you’re going to like it here. For more information visit: vantagegrp.com or LinkedIn/vantage.

title: Customer Onboarding Engineer | Implementation Specialist (ES)
description:
#### **Welcome to Infraspeak.**

Our mission is simple: to transform facilities management with a **collaborative platform** that unifies every part of FM operations into one cohesive system — **enabling every stakeholder to Work as One**.

We go beyond traditional tools, eliminating fragmented systems in complex operations. Our platform ensures end-to-end collaboration across FM teams, processes and assets — with no silos, blind spots or overload.

**Born in Porto**, Portugal, we’re now a **global company** serving customers in **45+ countries** and backed by top investors. **But we’re just getting started**.

* We believe in ownership, collaboration, and meritocracy.
* We believe that only great teams build great products — and that includes our customers.
* We believe happiness is in the journey, not just the destination.

Above all, we are guided by our purpose: to ***Be a Source of a Good Life*** — for our customers, our team, and the broader community.

#### **What are we building**

We seek a senior, technically minded specialist to own the technical onboarding of our enterprise customers in the EMEA region. This is not an entry-level implementation role. You will join rollouts that span multi-site, often multi-country portfolios, with years of legacy data to migrate and an operations director who expects you to have the answer.

We want you if you have already fought these battles and know how to hold your ground with a demanding customer. We will train you on our product and our processes. We will not have time to teach you how to lead a workshop with senior stakeholders, push back on a requirement that won't scale, or carry a go-live under pressure. You will be the customer's technical authority, working alongside the Delivery Manager who owns governance and scope.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

**Solution Design:** Lead discovery workshops with the customer's operations, maintenance, and IT leads, and translate complex, multi-site operations into a configuration that scales.

**Technical Configuration:** Configure asset hierarchies, maintenance plans, SLAs, workflows and permissions for large, multi-site and multi-country portfolios.

**Data Migration:** Own the technical side of migrating data from legacy systems, from mapping and cleansing rules to validation and load, and hold the customer to the quality of what they hand over.

**Integrations:** Work with our Integrations team and the customer's IT to specify, test and validate integrations with ERPs and other enterprise systems.

**Training & Rollout:** Train users from administrators to field technicians, and plan phased rollouts across sites and regions.

**Pushback & Trade-offs:** Challenge requirements that don't scale, propose standard alternatives to customisation, and explain the trade-off to senior customer stakeholders with confidence.

**Technical Troubleshooting:** Diagnose and resolve technical issues during implementation, and escalate to Product and Engineering with clear evidence when needed.

**Partnership with Delivery:** Work alongside the Delivery Manager, keeping them informed of technical risks, effort and dependencies so that scope and timeline decisions are made early.

**Documentation:** Produce configuration documentation that the customer and our Support team can rely on after go-live.

**Product Feedback:** Channel structured feedback from enterprise customers to Product and Engineering.

**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------

**Spanish:** Native-level or fluent.

**English:** Business-level fluency. Non-negotiable.

**French:** A plus.

**Location:** Based in or near Barcelona, Spain, and available to travel to customer sites.

**Technical Background:** An engineering background (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical) or substantial hands-on experience in facilities or maintenance management.

**Enterprise Implementation Experience:** A proven track record in customer-facing B2B SaaS implementation roles, including large, multi-site enterprise rollouts delivered end to end.

**Seniority & Composure:** At ease leading workshops with operations directors and IT leads, and steady when a go-live is under pressure.

**Courage:** Willing to say no to a customer, defend a design decision and raise a problem on the day you see it.

**Data Migration:** Hands-on experience migrating and cleansing large datasets from legacy systems.

**Software Proficiency:** Experience with CMMS, EAM or field-service platforms is a significant plus, as is familiarity with APIs and integrations.

**Autonomy:** Able to run your workstream independently within weeks. We will train you on product and processes, not on how to operate at this level.

**Communicator & Educator:** Able to explain complex configuration to anyone, from a field technician to a C-level sponsor.

**AI-Savvy:** Skilled in using AI tools to streamline daily operations and enhance performance.

#### **What do we offer?**

* A challenging, high-growth environment in an agile, global company.
* Access to our co-working space in central Barcelona.
* A flexible-remote working culture.
* Competitive compensation with performance-oriented bonuses, SPIFFs, and incentives.
* Excellent bonus structure tied to delivery quality and KPIs.
* Monthly perks and a training budget for professional development.
* Flexible working hours.
* Regular training, coaching, and team events.

*At Infraspeak, everyone is equal, unique, and valued. We believe diversity makes us stronger — shaping our culture, our business, and the world around us for the better — and we're committed to ethical talent acquisition, grounded in respect, fairness, and equal opportunity.*  
  
*Our code of conduct is clear: discrimination has no place here — whether based on age, disability, gender, race, religion or belief, civil or parental status, political views, or any other basis protected by law.*  
  
*"To be a source of a good life" isn't just a statement — it's our mission, and everyone is welcome to join us on that journey.*

title: Conversion Oriented Copywriter

title: Marketing Technology Engineer
description:
#### **Who We Are**

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

**Working in MarTech with WPP Enterprise Solutions**

WPP Enterprise Solutions is a full-service digital agency helping ambitious brands deliver connected, personalised experiences across digital channels. Our expertise spans Marketing, Commerce, CRM, PXM and CX, enabling us to deliver end-to-end solutions with measurable impact.

Our clients include Bayer, MSD, Dyson, Johnson & Johnson, RTL, Nestlé, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein and other global brands. Our teams are based in Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Poland and India, with access to the wider WPP network worldwide.

**The Opportunity**

You'll help design and build MarTech solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and the wider Salesforce platform, working collaboratively across the wider team. Depending on the client, you may work across platforms such as Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach and Adobe, together with data and cloud technologies including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Tealium, Segment, AWS, Azure and GCP.

**What You'll Do**

* **Design** **MarTech** **solutions:** Shape data models, integrations and technical designs that connect marketing platforms with CRM, CDP, data and cloud services.
* **Build and integrate:** Develop reliable production solutions using APIs, SQL, platform languages and general-purpose code, including queries and automation logic that support segmentation and journeys at scale.
* **Work with customer data:** Build segmentation, identity, ingestion and activation solutions, including automated, multi-step customer journeys connected to live data sources, across marketing platforms, CDPs and data warehouses.
* **Deliver maintainable solutions:** Build, test, deploy and support production code, applying appropriate version control, peer review, monitoring and recovery practices, and taking ownership of diagnosing production issues.
* **Improve existing implementations:** Review, troubleshoot, migrate and enhance solutions already running in client environments.
* **Turn requirements into solutions:** Work directly with clients and cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, make technical trade-offs and communicate solutions clearly.

**What You'll Need**

You combine software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience delivering marketing technology solutions. You do not need to know every platform we use, but you should be comfortable learning new technologies and working across systems.

*The basics:*

* **Experience:** +5 years in a similar role is required.
* **Eligibility**: You must be currently residing in Barcelona, and eligible to work without a need for a visa or work permit.
* **Software engineering:** Production experience with at least one general-purpose language such as Python, Node.js, Java, PHP or .NET. You write maintainable, tested, idempotent and bulk-safe code, with appropriate logging and error handling.
* **Data and SQL:** Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational datasets, customer profiles, segmentation and automation at scale.
* **Customer identity:** Understanding of identity resolution across fragmented sources, including deterministic and probabilistic matching, survivorship and profile consolidation.
* **APIs and integration:** Experience building production integrations using REST, SOAP, webhooks, batch processing or event-driven patterns. You understand retries, rate limits, failure recovery and duplicate prevention.
* **Marketing technology:** Hands-on delivery experience with an enterprise marketing, CRM or customer engagement platform such as Salesforce, Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe.
* **Web technologies:** Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with the ability to build and troubleshoot rendered customer experiences.
* **Team delivery:** Experience using version control, pull requests and peer review as part of a collaborative development process.
* **Client collaboration:** Comfortable working directly with marketing and technical stakeholders to turn business requirements into practical solutions, rather than working only through a ticket queue.

*Bonus points:*

Any of the below will definitely make you stand out!

* **Salesforce technologies:** Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Personalization, Account Engagement, Marketing Cloud Next, or Salesforce Sales, Service, Experience, Commerce and Industry Clouds
* **Other** **MarTech** **platforms:** Braze, Klaviyo, Bloomreach, Adobe Campaign, Journey Optimizer or Marketo Engage
* **Platform development:** AMPScript, SSJS, Apex, LWC, Liquid or Jinja
* **Customer data:** CDPs, identity resolution, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, batch or streaming pipelines, data governance and big-data processing
* **APIs and cloud:** GraphQL and cloud technologies across AWS, Azure or GCP
* **DevOps:** CI/CD and deployment tooling such as Salesforce CLI, SFMC DevTools, Copado or Gearset
* **Front-end development:** React, Angular or Vue
* **Email engineering:** Responsive email development, cross-client and dark-mode testing, deliverability, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and dedicated-IP warming

**Who You Are**

* **You stay hands-on.** You contribute throughout the delivery lifecycle, from solution design and implementation to testing, deployment and production support. You are also comfortable reviewing, improving or migrating existing solutions.
* **You build for reliability.** Your solutions are maintainable, tested, observable, bulk-safe and safe to rerun. You consider error handling, logging, performance and recovery from the start rather than adding them later. You take responsibility for what you ship and can diagnose and resolve production issues.
* **You are pragmatic about platforms.** You understand that enterprise marketing platforms have constraints. You know when native functionality is sufficient and when custom code or an external service is the better solution.
* **You document important decisions.** You use clear naming and proportionate documentation, record important trade-offs and avoid leaving behind solutions that only you can understand.
* **You welcome technical** **challenge****.** You use version control, peer review and repeatable deployment practices, and prefer resolving design risks before they reach production.
* **You communicate clearly.** You can lead requirements discussions, present a solution and adjust the level of technical detail for marketing, engineering and client audiences.
* **You work across disciplines.** You collaborate effectively with campaign specialists, data engineers, developers, architects and strategists, helping translate between business objectives and technical implementation.

**In return, this is what we offer**

We encourage ambitious ideas, invest in your development and support a flexible, welcoming workplace.

**Our compensation**

* An annual gross salary of €43,700–€50,000, depending on experience.
* Company private health insurance.
* A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.

**Career progression**

* Deepen your technical path towards Senior Marketing Technology Engineer, with a longer-term route into Technical Lead responsibilities across a portfolio.
* Broaden your practice path by improving how we deliver, what we standardise and how the wider team develops.
* We'll help you build either path through demonstrated impact, growing responsibility and business need.

**Our culture**

* Work from home at least one day a week.
* A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.
* Mental health: Complimentary membership to EAP counselling services.
* Experience working across both B2B and B2C delivery contexts.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

description:

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us..

Your biggest lever on churn is the box: finding, testing, and approving crafts that subscribers love and actually finish. * **Plan the box calendar.** Balance variety, seasonality and difficulty across Creative and DIY, within the cost-per-box target.
* **Learn from subscribers.** Read and summarize reviews, CS tickets, community posts and cancellation reasons every month, and use them to shape the boxes.
* **Own churn.** It's your main KPI. Understand what drives it by box, channel and track, and act on it.
* **Protect acquisition quality.** Work with performance marketing on channels and first-box offers, and avoid offers that attract one-box buyers.
* **Keep the subscription running smoothly.** Own the cancellation flow (reasons, offers, copy) and failed-payment recovery, with saves that still hold a month later.

* 1+ years in consumer product development, merchandising or brand management, ideally with craft kits, hobby products or subscription boxes.
* A track record of products you chose or developed, and how customers responded: ratings, sell-through, repeat purchases, returns.
* A hands-on maker. You craft yourself, and you can make a kit and judge its difficulty, instructions and quality.
* Supplier experience: sourcing samples, negotiating, and working to cost targets and lead times.
* Taste grounded in customers. You use reviews and feedback to decide, not only your own preferences.
* Ownership across teams. You push work through with marketing, CS, design, inventory and operations without being chased.
* Comfort with numbers. You can read a retention table and question a figure that looks too good, connect reason with outcome based on numbers
* Clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience running a subscription box.
* Experience writing craft instructions.
* An active presence in craft communities or social media.
* Experience with Shopify.
* Spreadsheet analysis skills.

**THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.
* Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.
* Test Task

**Up to € 2300 euros** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience.

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.
