title: Content Marketer (SEO & AI Search)
description:
**Join Reach as our Content Marketer (focused on SEO & AI Search)!**
You'll define what content engineering at the highest level looks like, then execute it for some of the best companies in the world. You'll shape how our proprietary platform automates content workflows, deciding what scales with humans and what scales with software. And as we grow, you'll build a team to scale production without sacrificing quality.
  
  
This is not a traditional content manager role. You'll combine deep SEO knowledge, advanced AI-powered production workflows, visual design skills, and LinkedIn content expertise to produce and scale high-quality content across our entire customer portfolio and for Reach itself.
  
  
**About Reach**
At Reach we're building the operating system to help companies monitor and control their visibility in AI search. We built a proprietary platform that combines our software, custom AI agents, and forward-deployed experts from the top 1% in organic growth (SEO & AEO), to help companies show up when buyers are researching and comparing solutions on Google and inside AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and turn that visibility into pipeline and revenue.
  
  
We reached $1.4M ARR in 14 months, basically bootstrapped, and we're scaling to $10M ARR by the end of 2027. We've been doing this for companies like ColdIQ ($7M ARR, #1 Clay worldwide sales agency), Indie Campers ($140M+ ARR), Carro, Fidelidade, Fraudio, Noxus and others.
  
  
A few recent results:
  
  

* Grew Indie Campers' revenue attributed to AI search by +1,318.62% YoY (14x) and organic search revenue by +7.85% YoY across 2025, delivered during a full website migration. Read the case study.
* Helped ColdIQ influence $506K in signed contract value from organic and AI search in ~4 months, making SEO and AI search their #1 traffic source with organic traffic up 7.3x. Read the case study.
* Took Carro from a 0% to 34.58% AI citation rate (4.5x the nearest competitor) and the #3 most-cited domain in their category, now consistently closing 7-figure deals sourced from AI search. Read the case study.

You can see more of the results we drive for our customers here.
  
  
We're turning services into software to disrupt the $100B+ SEO/AI Search market, which will get drastically bigger as search behavior shifts to AI and ad budgets follow.
  
  
"The global SEO and AEO services market will grow to $171 billion by 2030 from $81.4 billion last year", Wall Street Journal
  
  
**The team**
We're a team of founders, AI engineers, and SEO & AEO specialists passionate about creating a category defining company that moves fast and has fun doing it.
  
  
Here's a look at what life on the team is like. This is our latest company retreat:
  
  
Our founders have a proven track record of building and scaling fast growing tech companies. Jose Velez (CEO) was the solo founder & CEO of Rely.io, an internal developer portal used by top engineering orgs like ESPN Bet and Feedzai, and launched AI products that reached #1 Product of the Day and #1 AI Product of the month on Product Hunt. He raised $3.6M from top-tier firms like J12 Ventures, Shilling Capital Partners, Techstars NYC, and TheVentureCity, as well as from notable angels.
  
  
Bernardo Ferreira (founding AI search strategist) led the strategy behind more than
**250M organic visits**
and
**€100M in revenue attributed to SEO**
at Worten (think Iberian Amazon) in 2024.
  
  
**Location**
For this role, we're open to it being remote, mainly because we're growing fast and we can't afford to limit ourselves. That said, we care deeply about working in person.
  
  
If you can work alongside us from our Lisbon hub, that's our preference:
  
  
→ Lisbon: with the founding team day-to-day, plus regular travel to the US.
  
  
If you can move to Lisbon, we'll support relocation including visa sponsorship where possible.
  
  
Either way, expect to travel a lot.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for a builder-leader: someone who sets a new standard for what SEO content production looks like in the AI era, and then builds the systems and team to scale it.
  
  
You will own three things:
  
  

* Define What Content Engineering at the Highest Level Looks Like, and Execute It

This is not about pasting a keyword into ChatGPT and editing the output. You'll build the workflows, set the bar, and ship content for some of the best companies in the world.
  
  

* Build and use advanced AI content pipelines. Use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, and whatever tools give you leverage to produce content at 5-10x the pace of a traditional content team, with higher quality. Show us your setup. If you can't walk us through your AI workflow and impress us with how you use it for research, drafting, editing, analysis, and optimization, you won't pass the interview.
* Ship content that drives revenue, not just rankings. Blog posts, comparison pages, use case pages, landing pages, how-to guides, community responses for Reddit, Quora, and G2. Every piece of content is optimized for both search engines and AI models, on-brand, accurate, and genuinely useful for the target buyer.
* Create visual content that gets saved and shared. LinkedIn infographics, data visualizations, carousels, comparison graphics, process diagrams. You don't just write. You design. You need a strong eye and the ability to produce polished visual content quickly using tools like Figma, Canva, or equivalent.
* Write LinkedIn content that generates pipeline. Posts for Jose's personal brand, Reach's company page, and customer accounts. You understand hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and what drives B2B engagement on LinkedIn.
* Set the quality bar. Excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries. Deep on-page SEO knowledge: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, content structure. Every piece you ship is the reference standard for what "great" looks like.
* Improve our platform and the content system

Your expertise doesn't just serve customers. It becomes the product.
  
  

* Be the power user who shapes the AI content tools. You'll use our AI agents daily for content production. Your feedback on what works, what's slow, and what's missing directly influences the product roadmap.
* Identify what scales with humans vs. what scales with software. Some content requires editorial judgment, deep brand knowledge, and creative thinking. Some content can be templated, automated, or generated programmatically. You'll help us draw that line correctly, and push it further every month.
* Build workflows that scale. Create templates, processes, and automations that let you produce 15-20 pieces of optimized content per month across multiple customer accounts without dropping quality. Document everything so it's transferable.
* Close the loop with Strategy and Engineering. Work with our Growth Strategists to translate content briefs and action plans into finished, published content. Feed patterns back to Engineering: what should the agents handle, what needs human attention, and where the gaps are.
* Push the boundaries of programmatic content. If there's a way to generate structured, high-quality pages at scale using data and templates, find it. If a content type can be partially automated, build the workflow. Always with quality as the non-negotiable.
* Build and Lead a Team of World-Class Content Engineers

As we scale, you'll grow from individual contributor to team leader.
  
  

* Recruit and develop content talent. Hire people who combine writing ability, SEO depth, AI tooling mastery, and speed. Build a team that's genuinely better than any agency's content team.
* Hands-on leadership. Jump into content production, quality reviews, and customer accounts. Model excellence through action, not just direction.
* Build scalable systems. Create onboarding, training, and quality assurance processes that let new team members ramp fast and produce at your standard. Maintain customer knowledge bases that power personalized content generation.
* Manage multi-customer production. Coordinate content production across a portfolio of customers with different brands, voices, industries, and priorities. Ensure nothing slips.
* Define the craft. "Content engineer" is a new role. You'll define what it means, what the career path looks like, and how the best content engineers in the world work.

**Signs you’re a great fit…**

* You have 3+ years of experience producing SEO content for B2B/SaaS companies, with proven ranking and traffic results.
* You're an excellent writer who can adapt voice and tone across different brands and industries.
* You have an advanced AI workflow that goes far beyond "use ChatGPT to draft." You use Claude Code, custom agents, programmatic approaches, or similar tools, and you can show us a setup that's genuinely impressive.
* You understand on-page SEO deeply: keyword placement, heading structure, internal linking, meta tags, schema markup, and content structure.
* You can work with data and analytics: GSC, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, and use them to prioritize what content to create or optimize.
* You have a strong design eye and can create infographics, LinkedIn visuals, and web pages that look polished and professional.
* You understand what works on LinkedIn: hooks, storytelling, visual formats, and engagement patterns.
* You're fast, organized, and can manage content production across multiple customers simultaneously without dropping quality.
* You use AI tools extensively and are obsessive about improving your setup.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience with programmatic SEO or templated content at scale
* Proficiency in Figma, Framer, Webflow, or similar design/web tools
* Experience writing content that targets AI search visibility (structured for LLM consumption)
* Technical comfort with Markdown, HTML, CSS, or light scripting
* A portfolio of LinkedIn infographics or visual content you've created
* Experience at a content-led agency or a startup where you owned the full content pipeline
* You've built content processes or playbooks that scaled a team's output
* Our job titles may encompass various career levels, and the actual base pay for this position will be determined based on multiple factors including training, transferable skills, work experience, business requirements, and market conditions. Additionally, this role is eligible for equity and comprehensive benefits.

title: Head of Content
description:
**About us**
============

At THEKER, we're taking on one of the greatest challenges of the 21st century: redefining how physical work gets done in the world.

We are a robotics and AI company building intelligent, adaptable systems that solve problems traditional automation never could. From Barcelona, our mission is to create a generation-defining company leading the robotics revolution.

By joining us, you will have the chance to do the most meaningful work of your life, setting a new standard for industrial automation and driving breakthroughs with global reach, while being surrounded by a focused, talent-dense team that shares this ambition and is here to win.

We recently closed the largest robotics Series A in Europe's history, and we're looking for the top 0.01% of talent to take on that mission with us, and build the biggest company in the world.

**Your role**
=============

We are looking for a Head of Content to run THEKER's content operation from request to delivery. You will receive what the company needs from marketing, decide what comes first and make sure it ships on time and on brand. This is an operations and management role with a strong eye for brand. You won't be designing or editing yourself, but you will know good work when you see it.

You will be the single point of contact for marketing requests across THEKER, from videos and photos to presentations and events. You will turn each request into a clear brief, assign it to the right person in the content team and follow it through to delivery. You will also own the materials our sales team uses with clients and keep them current and consistent.

Day to day, you will manage the team's timeline and keep several projects moving at once. You will work with the founders and with every team from engineering to sales. You will also track what each channel delivers and propose new actions, from trade fairs to formats we haven't tried yet. Success means every request has an owner and a date, and sales trusts every material it sends.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We are looking for a hybrid profile: part creative director, part motion designer, part AI-native creator and part team leader.

You should have:

* Strong experience in marketing or content, ideally B2B, including leading a creative team and giving clear, demanding creative direction.
* Strategic judgement. You set objectives, prioritize, and can explain why an action is worth doing.
* Strong brand and visual judgement, with deep knowledge of video and motion production. Your portfolio shows a point of view of its own.
* Solid copywriting in Spanish and English, plus comfort working with marketing metrics and analytics tools.
* A genuinely AI-native way of working. Claude should feel like your working environment, not an occasional tool.
* Based in Barcelona or willing to relocate (100% on-site role).

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Knowledge of motion graphics or 3D.
* An AI-native way of working, with tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow.
* Experience planning trade fairs and external events in industrial or tech sectors.
* A track record of turning complex technical products into content that non-technical audiences understand.

**You'll thrive at THEKER if**
------------------------------

* You're excited by a fast-paced and ambitious environment. The opportunity ahead of us is enormous, and we're going all in to capture it.
* You want responsibility early on, delivering at world-class standards for leading clients.
* You enjoy experimenting, iterating quickly, and embracing change as part of the learning process.
* You enjoy bringing order to many moving parts, and you're comfortable saying "not yet" when priorities require it.

**Main responsibilities**
=========================

* Own the single entry point for marketing requests from the rest of the company. Turn each one into a brief, prioritize it, assign it and track it to delivery.
* Manage the content team's calendar and coordinate internal and external collaborators on each project.
* Own every material that goes to GTM, from sales decks to product documentation, with clear versions and approvals.
* Act as the main contact for sales on what they need and what is out of date.
* Keep the message and the brand consistent in everything that reaches a client.
* Write and review copy for LinkedIn, presentations and product materials.
* Define the metrics for each channel and turn what they show into decisions.
* Choose and plan the trade fairs and external events we attend, and propose new channels and formats with a clear goal and a way to measure them.

**What we offer**
=================

* Being part of a fast-growing robotics and AI company with genuine ambition, where your career can accelerate alongside us.
* The chance to build THEKER's content function and decide how a robotics company should look and sound.
* A focused, talent-dense team where your work is visible and your decisions count.
* An environment where new ideas are encouraged and your contributions shape both the product and the company.
* 100% on-site work in Barcelona.

**What the process looks like**
===============================

* Intro call with Talent Team. 30 minutes.
* Portfolio review and a case study on a real THEKER content and marketing challenge.
* Conversation with the founding team.
* Meet the rest of the team and founders at our offices.

These steps can be completed in 7 days.

**Final observation**
=====================

We're committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion. We welcome all applications regardless of background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, or beliefs.

* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team

* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

* Working closely with Product and Engineering leaders, you will establish a structured feedback loop that translates these insights into actionable engineering priorities, addressing underlying product, platform and integration weaknesses rather than relying on operational workarounds or repeated support interventions.
* You will ensure that improvements are measured against tangible outcomes, including reduced incident recurrence, lower support demand, improved employee productivity and experience, and sustainable reductions in operational cost.

**Global workplace operations and service ownership**

* Set and execute the global Workplace Operations strategy, service portfolio and operating model across service management, remote support, regional onsite support and multimedia services, with clear responsibilities and consistent standards.
* Own end-to-end service delivery outcomes and the interfaces across the enterprise Service Desk (first level), remote second-level support, onsite teams, engineering specialists and managed-service providers.
* Translate business priorities into measurable service objectives, service catalogues, location coverage and capacity plans, balancing global consistency with justified local requirements.

**Regional Field Services and employee technology lifecycle**

* Lead onsite technology support across the Americas, EMEA and Asia Pacific, including executive and business-critical support, ensuring effective regional leadership, service continuity and a consistent employee experience.
* Oversee operational delivery of end-user hardware throughout provisioning, onboarding, deployment, replacement, recovery, reuse and secure retirement, including inventory availability and demand planning in partnership with Engineering, Procurement and suppliers.
* Ensure technology readiness and support for meeting rooms, multimedia services, office openings, moves and closures, and major employee events, in coordination with relevant workplace and infrastructure teams.

**Service management, quality and operational resilience**

* Lead Workplace service-management governance and operational performance across incident, major incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service-level and service-transition practices, aligned with enterprise processes.
* Ensure effective escalation, restoration and communication during major disruptions; drive rigorous root-cause analysis, permanent remediation and a reduction in recurring incidents and avoidable service demand.
* Establish meaningful service levels and experience measures (SLAs, XLAs and operational KPIs), and maintain a transparent view of quality, reliability, employee impact, risk, demand and improvement priorities.

**Security, controls and governance**

* Ensure workplace services operate within applicable security, privacy, regulatory and internal-control requirements, with clear operational ownership for risk, vulnerabilities, privileged support access and third-party obligations.
* Oversee audit readiness, control evidence, management actions, service-continuity arrangements and supplier resilience, ensuring risks are raised early, remediation is effective and accountability is clear.

**Managed services, commercial and financial leadership**

* Own Workplace Operations financial planning and performance, including operational budgets, forecasts, service cost drivers, workforce and supplier spend, investment cases and sustainable cost optimization.
* Lead strategic partner governance, sourcing and service transitions; manage vendors against contracted outcomes, quality, experience, innovation and value rather than resource counts alone.
* Maintain effective oversight of workplace technology assets, service contracts and relevant licence consumption, partnering with Finance, Procurement and product owners on lifecycle cost and value.

**Transformation and employee experience**

* Build an evidence-led improvement roadmap that uses employee feedback, digital experience telemetry, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted operations to reduce friction, prevent incidents and improve productivity.
* Own operational assurance and readiness for workplace transformations, large-scale technology deployments and provider changes, ensuring credible delivery capacity, support acceptance, communication, hypercare and business continuity.
* Strengthen the experience of critical employee journeys, including joining, moving, changing devices, seeking support and leaving, with measurable gains in quality, speed, cost and satisfaction.

**Organizational and executive leadership**

* Lead and develop a multi-region organization of 150+ employees through its service-management, regional Field Services and multimedia leaders; shape structure, talent, succession, workforce planning, performance and a culture of accountability.
* Serve as a member of the Digital Workplace leadership team and partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, HR, Facilities, Finance and business leaders to resolve cross-functional issues and translate strategy into reliable operations.
* Act as the senior escalation and decision point for critical service matters, communicating clearly with executives and making balanced decisions across employee experience, cost, risk, speed and resilience.

**About the team**

In GSTP Digital Workplace, we make it easy for Swiss Re employees to use their digital workplace to connect seamlessly with people, ideas and expertise across the company and beyond. We focus on translating internal client needs into workplace products and services that improve productivity, enable flexibility and support secure ways of working.

Digital Workplace provides the products, services and support that enable Swiss Re's workforce to work from anywhere, anytime, in a stable and secure environment. This includes collaboration, productivity, endpoints, workplace foundations, governance and emerging workplace capabilities such as AI.

Workplace Operations is the global delivery and service-management capability behind that experience. It brings together remote and onsite user support, global Field Services, multimedia technology services and operational governance, in close partnership with the engineering and product organizations accountable for the technology platforms.

**About you**

To be successful in this role, you are already an established senior leader of large-scale, global IT operations or Digital Workplace / End User Services. You bring direct accountability for a comparable operation, not only individual service-management processes, engineering platforms or transformation programmes.

You have led leaders across regions and time zones, managed significant internal and outsourced service capacity, and improved service quality while controlling cost and operational risk. You are credible with engineers and service providers, but you measure success through employee productivity, reliable services and business outcomes.

You combine executive presence, sound judgement and calm incident leadership with the ability to build a strong organization. You know when to challenge, when to empower and how to turn operational evidence into clear priorities and decisions.

**You have:**

* 15+ years in enterprise IT operations or Digital Workplace, including several years as a Director or Head of a significant global service organization.
* Prior end-to-end accountability for global remote support, onsite Field Services, service governance and strategic outsourced service providers.

* Proven experience establishing data-driven operational improvement capabilities, using service analytics, digital employee experience telemetry and customer feedback to influence product roadmaps and engineering priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work across Operations, Product and Engineering to eliminate recurring issues at their root cause, reduce support demand and improve the end-to-end employee experience.
* A proven record of leading managers across regions, building effective teams and developing talent, succession and delivery accountability.
* Deep practical knowledge of IT service management (ITIL / ITSM), major incidents, problem and change management, service transition, ServiceNow or comparable platforms, and measurable service and experience outcomes.
* Strong commercial and financial leadership, including substantial operating budgets, outcome-based managed-service contracts, supplier negotiation, service cost optimization and sourcing decisions.
* Demonstrated delivery of operational modernization with measurable improvements through automation, self-service, AI-enabled support, digital employee experience insights and continuous improvement.

description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention & Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.

We're doing $50M+ a year and scaling to $100M+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**

Own retention A-Z to fuel the growth to 9-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**

We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, cross-sell, win-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5-6+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30-50M+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.
* Customer obsessed: you understand why customers stay or leave, and fix the cause, not the symptom.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.

**Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* **Subscriptions and churn:** own the subscription program for both brands, keep at least one save or retention test live every week, grow the share of new customers who subscribe (working with the CRO Lead on on-site and post-purchase offers), and report subscribers, MRR, churn and save rate by brand every week.
* **Email, SMS and lifecycle:** own email and SMS strategy, manage the retention agency, keep the calendar live and flows in testing, keep list health and deliverability strong, and plan sale and launch campaigns with the Head of Growth and the Head of Brand & Community.
* **Post-purchase experience and loyalty:** ship at least one post-purchase improvement every month, and use cancellation reasons, reviews, surveys and support contact reasons to find why customers leave and fix the cause with the owning team.
* **Customer experience and support:** lead the Customer Experience Manager, own the weekly CX KPI scorecard (CSAT, first response time, AI resolution rate, refund rate and chargebacks), set customer service policy, and grow 4- and 5-star reviews.
* **Retention data and reporting:** track cohort retention, repeat purchase rate and lifetime value by brand and channel, report retention KPIs weekly, run a monthly retention review with the CEO, and write the retention playbook as SOPs so it runs without one person.

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with our CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final Interview with our CEO

**Salary Expectation**

USD $115,000 to $145,000 a year (based on experience and expertise) + performance bonus of 15-20% of base after the trial period.

title: Retail Marketing Manager
description:
**¿Todo listo para tu nueva aventura?**

En blue banana creemos firmemente que las personas son el centro de nuestro desarrollo como marca.

Por ello, nuestro objetivo es atraer el mejor talento para seguir creciendo en este proyecto sin límites, donde trabajamos para empoderar a las nuevas generaciones a hacer de sus vidas una aventura. Nuestra misión nos invita a conectar con nuestro consumidor de una manera significativa, a través de la creación de contenido, de historias inspiradoras y de productos icónicos de alta calidad, responsables con el medioambiente.

No solo somos una marca, ¡SOMOS UN ESTILO DE VIDA! y queremos influir positivamente en el mundo.

¿Te identificas con nuestra pasión y propósito? Si es así, sigue leyendo y descubre cómo puedes ser parte de esta emocionante misión.

**El puesto**

Buscamos un perfil de Retail Marketing Manager con experiencia en moda o retail que haga de la tienda física el corazón de cada campaña. Reportarás directamente al Head of Marketing y serás quien conecte marca, tienda y negocio en España y Portugal.

Si te gusta pisar tienda, entender al cliente y ver cómo una campaña se convierte en entradas y ventas, este puesto es para ti.

Tu contribución en blue banana brand será excepcional si desarrollas estas funciones:

**La tienda física como eje**

* Convertir los objetivos de marketing en planes de trade marketing para España y Portugal, con prioridades, calendario, presupuesto y KPIs: captar nuevas audiencias, aumentar los clientes activos, generar awareness, vender la nueva colección por género, atraer tráfico a tienda y mejorar el lifetime value y el rendimiento del canal retail.
* Llevar esos planes del retail calendar a campañas omnicanal con la tienda como eje, con un mensaje claro para el cliente y conectadas de forma coherente con digital, CRM y PR.
* Liderar de principio a fin las acciones en El Corte Inglés, centros comerciales, outlets y pop-up stores, coordinándote con Brand, Visual y Retail, y con los equipos de marketing de cada canal, para crear planes a medida y medibles.
* Asegurar la coherencia entre marca y acción comercial en todos los puntos de venta, en el resto de canales y en ambos mercados.

**Cada canal, con su estrategia**

* Conocer a fondo cómo funciona cada canal y quién compra en él: tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales.
* Adaptar cada campaña a la realidad y al presupuesto de cada canal: espacios y formatos disponibles, normativas de implantación, calendarios comerciales y acciones conjuntas con centros comerciales y grandes almacenes.
* Seguir los resultados de cada canal y campaña (tráfico, conversión, ticket medio, unidades por ticket, ventas por tienda y captación de clientes), detectar desviaciones y proponer ajustes para la siguiente activación.

**Mano a mano con Visual**

* Trabajar con Visual para que marca y negocio vayan de la mano en tienda: escaparates, PLV, señalética, ratio de atracción, categorización por familias y conversión.
* Definir qué necesita cada canal y cada tienda, para producir materiales eficaces y con el coste justo.
* Medir el impacto de escaparates y materiales en el comportamiento del cliente y en las ventas, y aplicar lo aprendido en las siguientes campañas.
* Preparar kits de campaña y guías de implantación claras para los equipos de tienda, junto a Retail y Operaciones.

**El cliente en el centro**

* Entender qué busca el cliente en cada tienda: por qué compra, cómo se mueve y qué le hace volver. Para ello combinarás datos, el feedback de los equipos de tienda y el análisis del mercado, la competencia y las tendencias.
* Trabajar con el equipo de CRM en la estrategia de cliente (nuevos y fieles) con foco en tienda: captación en el punto de venta, recurrencia y nuestro club Adventure Pass.

**Datos, reporting y presupuesto**

* Medir la rentabilidad de cada inversión por canal y por campaña, y priorizar con datos lo que más impacto tiene.
* Preparar el reporting para dirección y comité: cuadro de mando semanal, informe mensual y recaps de las campañas clave del retail calendar.
* Ser owner del presupuesto y de los objetivos de retail marketing.
* Usar la IA para analizar, decidir y convertir ideas en campañas.
* Impulsar una cultura de medición y mejora continua, y hacer visible el impacto de marketing en el negocio.

**¿Qué te hará triunfar con nosotros?**

* Más de 6 años en marketing en empresas de moda o retail. Valoramos la experiencia en entornos internacionales.
* Al menos 4 años como Retail Marketing Manager, Trade Marketing Manager o Marketing Manager con responsabilidad sobre el punto de venta, con experiencia en:

  + Campañas 360 con foco en tienda física.
  + Tiendas propias, corners de El Corte Inglés y centros comerciales, coordinándote con sus equipos de marketing.
  + Visual merchandising: escaparates, PLV y materiales de punto de venta.
  + Análisis de ventas y KPIs de tienda por canal.
  + Cliente, hábitos de compra, CRM y loyalty.
  + Gestión de presupuesto y cumplimiento de objetivos.

title: Head of Partnerships, EMEA
description:
**Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.**

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* You'll lead the development and execution of our EMEA partnership expansion strategy across key European markets including Germany, Italy, Spain, France, the Netherlands and the UK.

* You'll own and prioritise the European partnership pipeline, ensuring opportunities are commercially attractive, operationally deliverable and strategically aligned.

* You'll identify, secure and grow large-scale partnerships across airlines, online travel agencies, banks, payment providers, retailers, telcos, aggregators and embedded insurance channels.

* You'll build strong relationships with Zurich business units, distributors and strategic partners to accelerate growth across the region.

* You'll lead partner proposition development, commercial modelling, business case preparation and executive-level recommendations.

* You'll negotiate commercially successful partnership agreements that deliver value for customers, partners and the business.

* You'll provide commercial leadership to cross-functional teams spanning product, underwriting, technology, operations, claims, finance, legal, risk and compliance.

* You'll drive successful market entry and partnership launches, removing barriers and maintaining momentum across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

* You'll represent the EMEA growth agenda in executive forums, governance committees and strategic partner discussions.

* You'll lead and develop a high-performing partnerships team while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation and collaboration.

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* You'll bring significant experience in partnerships, business development, commercial strategy, market expansion or distribution leadership.

* You'll have a proven track record of originating, negotiating and delivering strategic partnerships in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

* You'll understand the dynamics of insurance, travel, affinity, embedded insurance, digital distribution or financial services markets.

* You'll have experience leading growth and market-entry initiatives across European or EMEA markets.

* You'll bring strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess market opportunities, partner economics, operational feasibility and return on investment.

* You'll understand modern partnership and distribution models including B2B2C, embedded insurance, API integrations, white-label solutions and aggregator channels.

* You'll be comfortable influencing senior executives, strategic partners and cross-functional teams across a matrixed international environment.

* You'll have exceptional negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex commercial and regulatory concepts.

* You'll balance commercial ambition with governance, customer outcomes and execution excellence.

* You'll bring European language capability and existing European insurance or partnership networks as an advantage.

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

**Career growth****.** This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

**Take the time you need, for you and your community****.** We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual, personal and volunteer leave benefits.

**Diversity and inclusion****.** We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

  

**Apply today and let’s go to great places together!**

title: Head of Talent Acquisition (Remote)
description:
**Unstoppable starts with people.** The future of payments is being built today, and at **Paymentology**, we are looking for people who want to help shape it. We power card issuing for leading banks, fintechs and digital brands across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we are looking for curious, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex challenges, embrace innovation and want to make a tangible impact at global scale.

**Head of Talent Acquisition**
==============================

We’re looking for a **Head of Talent Acquisition** to lead and shape our global Talent Acquisition function, ensuring Paymentology attracts, assesses and secures the exceptional talent needed to deliver our business strategy.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll define our global Talent Acquisition strategy, establish high hiring standards and lead a team of three TA Partners and a TA Operations role to deliver an effective, consistent and high-performing recruitment function.

This is a strategic leadership role for someone who combines commercial judgement, deep recruitment expertise and the confidence to influence senior stakeholders. You’ll play a critical role in translating business and workforce priorities into effective hiring strategies, strengthening hiring decisions and continuously evolving an effective, scalable and data-driven TA function that supports our global growth.

**Location:** This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Poland, Italy, Slovenia, Serbia, Czech Republic, Portugal, Croatia or Spain.

**Application deadline:** 18 November 2026.

**What you get to do:**
-----------------------

### **Talent Acquisition Strategy & Hiring Priorities**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning recruitment priorities with business objectives, approved workforce plans and future capability needs.
* Partner with the Executive Team, functional leaders and Finance to understand workforce requirements, challenge assumptions and recommend hiring priorities based on business impact, affordability, market conditions and recruitment capacity.
* Anticipate talent-market challenges and hiring risks, providing strategic insights and recommendations that support informed workforce and hiring decisions.
* Continuously evolve the TA operating model to support changing business needs, ensuring the function remains scalable, efficient and commercially focused.

### **Hiring Excellence & Talent Standards**

* Define and maintain high hiring standards, ensuring recruitment decisions are structured, evidence-based and aligned with Paymentology’s talent philosophy.
* Set clear expectations for role definition, assessment quality and hiring decisions, ensuring TA Partners effectively challenge requirements and uphold consistent hiring standards.
* Drive a culture of hiring excellence through effective interview practices, strong hiring-manager capability, timely decision-making and a positive candidate experience.

### **Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a global Talent Acquisition team comprising three TA Partners and a TA Operations role, fostering accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Empower TA Partners to own recruitment within their functions, strengthening their ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate complex hiring challenges and make decisions independently.
* Provide strategic direction and oversight to TA Operations, ensuring systems, processes, governance and reporting enable effective recruitment delivery.

### **Stakeholder Partnership & Strategic Influence**

* Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the Chief People Officer and Executive Team, providing insights on hiring priorities, talent-market dynamics and critical capability needs.
* Influence and challenge senior stakeholders, resolve competing hiring priorities across functions and provide leadership on selected executive and business-critical appointments.

### **Recruitment Operations, Technology & Analytics**

* Oversee the effectiveness of recruitment processes, systems and governance, ensuring consistent, compliant and scalable hiring practices across the organisation.
* Champion the adoption of modern recruitment technology, AI and automation to improve hiring quality, operational efficiency and candidate experience.
* Define and monitor recruitment performance metrics, leveraging data and market intelligence to identify improvement opportunities and inform strategic decisions.

### **Talent Attraction**

* Define and lead Paymentology’s global talent attraction strategy, strengthening our ability to engage and attract high-calibre talent in priority markets.
* Partner with People and Marketing to strengthen Paymentology’s positioning in priority talent markets and support proactive talent attraction initiatives and partnerships.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

* Extensive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 5 years in leadership roles with responsibility for TA strategy, team performance and recruitment effectiveness.
* Experience operating in a globally distributed organisation, ideally within SaaS, technology infrastructure or a similarly complex environment.
* Proven ability to define and execute a global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning hiring priorities and recruitment capabilities with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Strong commercial acumen and strategic judgement, with the ability to balance business priorities, hiring demand, recruitment capacity, budget considerations and talent-market realities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to advise and constructively challenge C-suite executives and senior business leaders.
* Deep recruitment expertise, with a proven ability to establish and uphold high hiring standards, drive structured and evidence-based assessment, and improve the quality of hiring decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing Talent Acquisition teams, building accountability, empowering others and developing their capability to operate as strategic business partners.
* Strong analytical capabilities, using recruitment data, performance metrics and talent-market intelligence to inform decisions, identify risks and drive continuous improvement.
* Experience designing and evolving scalable recruitment operating models, processes and governance, with the ability to lead change and drive adoption across the organisation.
* Strong understanding of modern recruitment technology, ATS platforms, automation and AI, with the ability to leverage these to improve hiring quality, efficiency and candidate experience. Experience with Ashby is a strong advantage.

We’re a team that cares deeply about the quality of our work, supports each other and is always looking for ways to improve. You’ll be joining a group of people who enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas and making things better, with plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

At **Paymentology**, we believe that making a difference starts with the people behind the work. You will be part of a diverse, global team of Paymentologists who are united by a shared mission to advance the world through payments.  
This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful work, collaborate across markets and functions, and help shape the future of a business with global reach and real impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any unlawful ground, including race, colour, ethnicity, sex, gender, pregnancy, marital status, family responsibility, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, language or HIV status.

Paymentology will never request any form of payment from applicants at any stage of our recruitment process, including for applications, interviews, training or job placements. **Responsibilities**

**Job ID** R-263919 **Date posted** 11/10/2026

Do you have experience navigating and transforming complex enterprise data into analysis-ready information to enable adoption of AI and automation, supported by knowledge of Regulatory Affairs strategy or policy? If you want to work on innovative projects of high importance for our Respiratory and Immunology (R&I) portfolio, then AstraZeneca is the place for you. Our aspiration is to be pioneers in science, leading in our disease areas to truly transform patient outcomes. This means our people are here to win, and we give you a breadth of opportunities to be curious and do cutting edge, unique work that has significant impact on science, medicines, and patients.

The Global Regulatory Affairs Therapeutic Area (TA) team that you will belong to is a strategic function within the R&I Research and Development (R&D) organization. The Regulatory Affairs team leads the development and execution of regulatory strategies for global programs across the entire lifecycle, proactively leveraging and applying broad regulatory and scientific expertise, leadership skills, and business acumen to identify and champion innovative drug development strategies to benefit patients.

More specifically, you will be part of the Strategy, Operations, and Innovation Team, which serves as trusted advisors to build an AI-enabled future Regulatory Affairs organization. Our Team comprises a diverse group of individuals including regulatory affairs managers, medical writers, labelling, digital, and policy and intelligence experts to deliver a breadth of capabilities to support the TA and portfolio.

The Digital function within Strategy, Operations, and Innovation enables a broad and growing remit that includes AI and automation delivery, as well as support of Regulatory systems and data quality. We are on the front lines of transforming our Regulatory Affairs organization to enable data-driven planning and decision support.

**The role**

We have a great opportunity for you to join our team within Respiratory and Immunology in the role of Associate Regulatory Affairs Director, Digital Transformation. This role will partner with Digital staff and Regulatory Affairs experts to translate business and analytical questions into data requirements, lead development and implementation of automated data pipelines and analysis-ready datasets in cloud data platforms to enable adoption of AI and automation, and monitor data quality to ensure Regulatory Affairs staff make decisions based on complete and trustworthy information. This role will also periodically liaise with cross-TA teams that own and maintain enterprise Regulatory Affairs systems and data products needed to carry out the above tasks.

The role will be based at AstraZeneca’s dynamic R&D hub in Barcelona, Spain.

ARADs are accountable for leading the development and implementation of the global regulatory strategy for a product, ensuring the strategy is designed to deliver rapid approval with competitive labelling in line with product considerations, and the needs of the business, markets, and patients.

As Associate Regulatory Affairs Director, Digital Transformation, you will be responsible for leading the development and implementation of automated data pipelines and analysis-ready datasets that enable rapid implementation of AI and automation solutions which optimize delivery of Regulatory Projects and meet our Regulatory Affairs business priorities. You will partner extensively with Digital staff and Regulatory Affairs experts to ensure understanding of data requirements, as well as engaging with other key internal stakeholder groups (e.g., Regulatory Systems, IT) to ensure availability of key Regulatory Affairs data sources and technologies necessary to support implementation of automated data pipelines.

The ideal candidate for this role brings a strong background in analytics or data engineering, data science, or a related field, a problem solving and continual growth mindset, and experience in either biopharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs or working with a Health Authority (e.g., FDA, EMA).

**ARAD Digital Transformation Key Responsibilities include:**

* Design, develop, and implement automated data pipelines and data models to enable rapid adoption of AI and automation solutions to support Regulatory Affairs digital objectives
* Establish data quality metrics and automated monitoring to ensure the reliability and trustworthiness of analysis-ready data used in AI and automation solutions
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure availability of key data sources and technologies necessary to support this work, as well as understanding of data requirements
* Develop and maintain documentation (e.g., data dictionary, data model) for analysis-ready datasets that can be referenced by Digital staff and other data end users
* Communicate the quality, trustworthiness, and limitations of analysis-ready data and downstream work products to business leaders and other internal stakeholders to ensure successful data-driven planning and decision support
* Maintain awareness of current and future trends in analytics and data engineering, data science, biopharmaceuticals, or other relevant industries to promote continual growth in skills and expertise

* Prior biopharmaceutical industry experience in Regulatory Affairs, with a Health Authority (e.g., FDA, EMA), or in other settings that required extensive knowledge of drug and biologic regulatory requirements
* Experience designing, developing, and implementing automated data pipelines and data models to transform enterprise data into analysis-ready datasets in cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies
* Experience implementing automated data quality checks and monitoring to ensure the reliability and trustworthiness of analysis-ready data
* Expert in Python and SQL for data pipeline development and orchestration, including experience using AI-supported coding for rapid prototyping
* Good software development practices, such as code version control with Git, reusable code design, and automated testing
* Able to translate ambiguous business and analytical questions into data requirements and technical solutions, working with Regulatory Affairs SMEs, data scientists, platform teams, and system owners
* Able to self-start and independently investigate unfamiliar data sources and complex data models to identify relevant data for analysis

**Desirable for the role**

* Experience extracting or transforming unstructured information into structured data using techniques such as document parsing, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Natural Language Processing (NLP)
* Familiarity with public health or Health Authority datasets, such as information available through the FDA and EMA websites
* Experience establishing or driving standard ways of working for a technical team

title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent )
description:
**This isn’t another growth job**

Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.

We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.

**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE GROWTH MEANS AT PARADOX**
------------------------------------------

Our growth machine has to be able to:

**1. Generate hypotheses.** Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.

**2. Act across every tool.** Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.

**3. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.

**4. Ship its hypotheses.** Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox,

We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.

We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.

We do that by merging :

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.

We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.

You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Build the agents that run growth**

* The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.

### **2. Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night**

* The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.

### **3. Build a creative machine with taste**

* The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.

### **4. Build measurement that checks itself**

* The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.

### **5. Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul**

* The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:** you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.

**You’ll own these KPIs:** LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.

**Desired outcomes:** conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.

**Tools you’ll master:** GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE**
---------------------------------

**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
---------------------------

If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.

If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.

If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.

If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.

If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…

If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…

If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…

**WHY JOIN US**
---------------

Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.

Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

**Growth & Ambition**

* > Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

**Freedom & Well Being**

* > A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices

-> 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us

**HIRING PROCESS**

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process
