title: ​​Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Officer (Identity and Access Management) ​(P)
description:
**Introduction**

Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants.

IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move.

IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration

Internal and external candidates will be considered for this vacancy.

For the purposes of this vacancy, internal candidates are defined as staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded or ungraded contract, including Junior Professional Officers (JPOs), UN Volunteers with at least twelve (12) months of continuous service in IOM, staff on Special Leave Without Pay (SLWOP), and staff members on secondment/loan released by the Organization, unless otherwise specified in their contract. Staff members holding a regular, fixed-term or short-term graded contract will not retain their contract type if appointed to an ungraded position.

**Organizational Context and Scope**

The ICT Officer Identity and Access Management will lead own and evolve the identity and access management (IDAM) ecosystem. The role will be the gatekeeper for the digital identity landscape, ensuring the right people (and devices) get the right access, at the right time, for the right reasons.

The role will be responsible for the design, implementation, and support of the identity orchestration using One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM), integrated with Microsoft Active Directory, Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID), and HR-driven lifecycle events via the Oracle ERP (WAVE).

The ICT Officer (Identity and Access Management) must understand the art and science of automating access, enforcing least privilege, and reducing identity-related risks.
  
Under the leadership of the Director of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) / Chief Information Officer and reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, the ICT Officer Identity and Access Management (IDAM) is responsible for the identity and access management function within ICT.

  

Responsibilities: IDENTITY AND ACCESS MANAGEMENT  
  
Design, configure, and maintain One Identity - Identity Manager (IDM) for user lifecycle management, provisioning, and role-based access control.  
Integrate identity data from the WAVE ERP system to drive Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes.  
Manage synchronization and identity federation between Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory (Entra ID).  
Define and implement access governance, including role modelling, segregation of duties (SoD), and access review campaigns.  
Develop automated workflows for account provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management across all ICT platforms.  
Collaborate with HR, Information Security, and Compliance teams to enforce identity related policies.  
Enforce Just-In-Time (JIT) access for sensitive operations.  
Monitor and respond to identity-related incidents and service requests.  
Create and maintain IAM documentation including architecture diagrams, SOPs, and audit records.  
Supervise the IAM team and conduct effective performance management and promote a cooperative work environment.  
  
MICROSOFT ACTIVE DIRECTORY AND ENTRA ID  
  
Ensure correct operation of hybrid identity sync from AD to Entra ID via Azure AD Connect and monitor sync health and conflict resolution.  
Define entitlement management with access packages for joiners/movers/leavers.  
Enforce naming conventions and OU placement standards.  
Manage service accounts with lifecycle governance (preferably with expiration controls).  
Manage access using Azure AD roles, administrative units, and custom roles.  
Assign privileged roles via Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with time-bound or approval-based access.  
Define Conditional Access Policies based on risk, device, location, and user sensitivity.  
Enforce MFA using built-in Entra policies.  
Enable the publishing and management of SaaS apps using SAML, OAuth, or OIDC for Single Sign-On (SSO).  
Configure provisioning connectors to automate account creation in cloud apps.  
Build processes to enforce user consent restrictions to limit data exposure to risky apps.  
Create and maintain procedures for maintenance of security groups and distribution lists.  
Implement and enforce role-based access control (RBAC) through group nesting and inheritance.  
Periodically review and clean up stale groups and memberships and establish access review campaigns for groups, apps, and privileged roles across regional offices.  
  
ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES  
  
Provide input for the license entitlements and ensure correct integration with FinOps and licensing portals.  
* Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

  

Qualifications: Education  
  
Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,  
University degree in the above fields with seven years of relevant professional experience.  
The following certifications are required.  
Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300).  
Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).  
Must attain and maintain ITIL version 4 Foundation certification and CISSP.  
One Identity - Identity Manager Foundations (#IM-FND) certification is an advantage.  
Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) is an added advantage.  
  
Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database .  
  
Experience  
  
A minimum of 5 years of experience in Identity & Access Management, IT Security, or related infrastructure engineering roles.  
Hands-on experience with One Identity - Identity Manager (strongly preferred).  
Solid proficiency in Microsoft Active Directory, Group Policy, and Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID).  
Experience in integrating IAM solutions with ERP systems for automated provisioning (e.g. SAP, Oracle).  
Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).  
Experience implementing RBAC, ABAC, and SoD controls.  
Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, SQL, or similar) for automating IAM workflows.  
  
Skills  
  
Demonstrated ability to supervise and train teams to work effectively and harmoniously.  
Project management skills for efficient roll-out of ICT initiatives.  
Demonstrated understanding of automation of user lifecycle processes across HR, AD, and Entra ID.  
Demonstrated ability to communicate with business leaders and those with limited technical background effectively.  
Demonstrated ability to handle confidential data in a professional, responsible and mature manner.  
Familiarity with global IT security trends and the ability to adapt NIST standards to evolving security threats and technologies.  
Working knowledge of supporting One Identity Manager, Active Directory and Entra ID.  
  
Languages  
  
For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written).  
  
Working knowledge of an official UN Language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage.  
  
Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.  
  
Required Competencies  
  
IOM's competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.  
  
Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:  
  
Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.  
Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.  
Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.

Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.

Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators

Notes  
  
Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.

IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children.  
  
IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times.

Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

**Your future team**

As Head of Customer Service, you'll lead Holidu's Customer Happiness front line from our Málaga office: 3 in-house Team Leads, almost 40 in-house advisors, and 150+ partner advisors. You may initially lead one market team directly while we complete the Team Lead bench.

You'll report to the Director of Customer Happiness and work alongside our enablement teams whose job is to equip the front line to succeed. We're at a turning point: we're moving to a new case management platform, rethinking how we measure performance, and redesigning how our teams work together. You'll be one of the people shaping it.

**What you will do**

**Own front-line performance**

* Own the results of our internal and external handling teams: resolution, customer satisfaction, response and resolution times, and productivity
* Set clear expectations, run a weekly performance rhythm with your Team Leads and partners, and act fast when results slip
* Make the tough calls when needed - on performance, staffing and priorities

**Lead the leaders**

* Manage, coach and develop our Team Leads in Málaga, building a leadership team that sets a high standard and holds each other accountable
* Potentially lead one market team directly at first, and stay close to the work by regularly handling cases yourself
* Build a culture of ownership, independent judgement, and pride in the work, with a clear development path for advisors from junior to senior

**Get the best out of our partners**

* Share accountability with our Workforce Management team for partner performance: help define performance targets, train and coach partner teams on their floors, and funnel partner feedback to our enablement teams so root causes get fixed
* Spend time on site with them, review quality together, and reduce escalations that bounce back to the in-house team
* Contribute to partner selection, onboarding and incentive design

**Fix how we work**

* Spot and remove friction on the front line: unnecessary escalations, duplicated work and outdated processes
* Be the operational voice in the rollout of our new case management platform, making sure workflows reflect how cases are really handled
* Bring coaching back to the floor - buddy systems and hands-on onboarding - so new advisors and partner staff get up to speed fast and continuously improve
* Lead the move to a model where complex cases are solved end to end by our in-house experts, with no escalation layers

**Build bridges**

* Work as one team with our enablement functions: be clear about what the front line needs, and hold them to it
* Represent the voice of our guests and hosts in cross-functional discussions with Product, Tech, Sales and Account Management

**What success looks like**

* 30 days: you know every Team Lead, have handled cases in each queue, and have spent time with our partners
* 90 days: shared targets are agreed with Team Leads and partners, a weekly performance rhythm is running, and first quick wins are delivered
* 6 months: measurable improvement in cost per resolved case, CSAT, escalation rates, a stronger Team Lead bench, and all advisors performing to a higher standard

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in customer service or customer operations, of which 4+ managing managers or multiple teams
* Has led an operation of 100+ people across in-house and outsourced teams
* A proven track record of turning around team performance, with measurable gains in both productivity and quality
* Experience managing outsourced support partners (BPOs) on performance and quality
* A leader who sets a high bar and holds people to it, while genuinely caring about their growth - you help your teams meet expectations rather than shield them from them
* Hands-on: you're comfortable stepping onto the floor and handling cases yourself
* Strong with data - you use KPIs to find root causes and drive action, not just to report
* Experience leading teams through change - new tools, new structures - while keeping people engaged
* Experience with complex, emotional B2C cases (eg. travel, hospitality, tour operators), not only transactional ticket queues
* AI-literate: you use AI tools in your own work, and you have run a team alongside AI agents or automation. You know where AI resolves, where it fails, and how to measure it.
* Fluent English; another of our market languages (Spanish, German, Italian, French) is a plus

  

**What we offer**

* **Impact:** Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters—and you’ll see the impact.
* **Learning:** Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets—with a strong focus on AI.
* **Great People:** Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts—people we can all relate to—making work meaningful and energizing.
* **Technology:** Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
* **Flexibility:** Work in a hybrid setup with 50%+ in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
* **Perks on Top:** Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized—but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.

**Life at Holidu**

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram@lifeatholidu

---------------

To represent GCN en Español on and off screen, creating and presenting engaging, entertaining and informative cycling content for our Spanish-speaking audience.

The role will involve being a key on-screen personality for the channel, presenting a wide range of video formats, from cycling news and race analysis to technical features, product testing, challenges and practical cycling advice.

The successful candidate will also contribute to the creative development of the channel, researching and pitching ideas, writing scripts, planning content and working closely with the wider production team to deliver videos that engage existing viewers and attract new audiences.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about cycling, knowledgeable about the sport and its industry, confident in front of the camera and able to bring personality, insight and energy to our content.

**Purpose / mission of the department**
---------------------------------------

To grow GCN en Español as a leading destination for Spanish-speaking cycling fans around the world.

This means growing our audience, views and subscribers, while continually developing the breadth, quality and appeal of our content. We aim to inform, entertain and inspire cyclists through original, relevant and engaging video content covering all aspects of the sport and cycling culture.

**Success outcomes (within the fixed-term contract)**
-----------------------------------------------------

By the end of the contract, the successful candidate will have:

* Successfully integrated into the GCN en Español team and established a strong rapport with the existing presenters and production team.
* Confidently presented and contributed to a variety of the channel's regular content and social formats.
* Researched, developed and pitched original ideas that have been progressed into engaging video content.
* Demonstrated the ability to independently research, script and present content to a consistently high standard.
* Contributed to the growth and engagement of the GCN en Español audience through compelling, relevant and entertaining content.
* Represented the channel professionally at cycling events, races and industry activities where required.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Presenting and content creation**

* Be one of the key faces and voices of GCN en Español, representing the channel on camera and across its various platforms.
* Present a wide range of content, including cycling news, technical features, product reviews, challenges, entertainment, interviews and practical advice.
* Bring energy, personality, humour and authenticity to presentations, helping to create an engaging relationship with our audience.
* Research, develop and pitch original content ideas that reflect the interests of our Spanish-speaking cycling audience.
* Write scripts, prepare presentations and work with producers and other team members to plan and deliver content.
* Take ownership of individual video projects where appropriate, from initial idea and research through to filming and delivery.
* Actively engage with the GCN en Español audience across social media platforms, helping to build a strong and loyal cycling community.

### **Cycling knowledge and technical content**

* Present informative and engaging technical content, including bike and component reviews, product comparisons, testing and explanations of new cycling technology.
* Present practical how-to content covering bike maintenance, riding techniques, training, fitness and cycling skills.
* Demonstrate products and techniques both in the studio and out on location, providing viewers with useful, accessible and credible advice.
* Use personal cycling knowledge and experience to provide insight, context and credibility to the content.
* Keep up to date with developments in the cycling industry, new products, trends and innovations.

### **Racing and industry coverage**

* Research and present cycling news, race reports and analysis, particularly around major professional stage races and one-day events.
* Present technical and feature content from professional cycling races and other industry events.
* Use industry contacts to arrange and conduct interviews with professional riders, teams, mechanics and other key figures in cycling.
* Help bring the stories, personalities and developments from the professional peloton to life for our audience.
* Attend race events and other locations as required to produce relevant and engaging content.

### **Teamwork and channel development**

* Work closely with International Content Creators, Production team and other presenters to ensure content aligns with the channel's objectives and overall GCN strategy.
* Collaborate with other GCN channels and the wider Play Sports Network team where opportunities arise.
* Contribute positively to the creative culture of the team, sharing ideas and supporting the development of new formats and content opportunities.
* Assist other members of the GCN team as and when required.

### **Commercial Content and Partner Relationships**

* Present branded and sponsored content for GCN en Español, working with commercial partners to deliver engaging video content that meets agreed campaign objectives.
* Work collaboratively with the commercial, production and editorial teams to develop creative ideas and concepts for partner-led content.
* Confidently integrate brand messaging, products and key campaign messages into video content in a natural, engaging and authentic way.
* Present product demonstrations, reviews, sponsored features and other commercial formats while maintaining the tone, personality and credibility of GCN.
* Build positive working relationships with commercial partners and represent GCN professionally during filming, events and other partner-facing activities.
* Understand the importance of delivering content that meets both audience expectations and commercial commitments.

**Skills, experience and attributes**
-------------------------------------

**Essential:**

* An elite-level road cyclist, comfortable demonstrating riding techniques and participating in cycling challenges and features.
* Good knowledge of, and contacts within, professional road cycling and the cycling industry, with knowledge of its equipment and technology.
* Passionate about cycling, with understanding of its overall culture and audience.
* Fluent Spanish speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Good ability in spoken and written English to communicate effectively with the wider Play Sports Network team, the majority of which are based in the UK.
* Confident and engaging on camera, with the ability to communicate information clearly and naturally.
* Creative, curious and able to generate interesting and original content ideas.
* Research, scriptwriting and storytelling skills.
* Flexible, organised and able to work effectively in a fast-paced production environment.
* A positive team player who can also work well independently and take ownership of projects.

**Desirable:**

* Previous experience presenting video or digital content.
* Experience in journalism, broadcasting, video production or content creation.
* Experience presenting technical cycling content, product reviews or race coverage.

**About the Team**

  

The Fitch Ratings Financial Institutions Group has actively built the agency into the global leader in bank credit rating coverage. Our experienced analysts provide comprehensive, timely and transparent coverage of major institutions around the world, as well as unparalleled coverage of smaller companies. Our analysts offer a diversity of talent and backgrounds, with experience in regulatory oversight, counterparty analysis, auditing, investment banking, buy-side investing and more.

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Monitoring a portfolio of issuer ratings, including the preparation of rating committee materials
* Analysis of financial institutions sector and individual banks data, update of financial excel-based tools and charts
* Writing and publishing of comprehensive rating reports on individual issuers
* Participation in credit rating committees for banks in the allocated region and other countries
* Regular interaction with contacts at issuers and with issuers’ senior management at rating meetings
* Participation in the publication of sector-specific research and commentary, including preparation of peer data, country snapshots and sector background information
* Assist as needed in the coverage of other banks in the portfolio; including working with other team members to prepare committee materials, peer tables or analytical tools, reviewing annual and interim accounts and completing ad-hoc data requests

  

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* Proven analytical experience (ideally between 4 and 6 years), ideally in credit- or audit-related fields, gained from working at a commercial/investment bank, accountancy firm, buy-side firm, regulatory authority, rating agency, or similar.
* Background in either financial institutions or corporate credit analysis. Experience in bank analysis and banking regulation is desirable.
* Excellent demonstrable written and verbal communication skills in Spanish (native level) and English are essential.
* Ability to work independently as well as being a good team player.
* Ability to cope with time pressure and work to deadlines.
* Strong writing and communication skills as well as strong command of financial statement analysis.
* Proficient in Excel
* A drive for innovation and appetite to find smart ways to implement AI into daily analytical tasks.

This position will involve occasional travel, primarily within Europe.

  

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Knowledge of another European language such as Portuguese is desired but not essential.
* University degree level, preferably with professional qualifications (such as CFA).

  

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment**: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

  

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day—supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We’re looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment—or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.

  

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. description:
Company Description

  

MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.

We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.

  

Job Description

  

He/She brings practical service knowledge into digital delivery: understanding customer, operational, commercial and regulatory needs, shaping how customers reach us and how we respond, and building a support function that is fast, compliant, measurable and AI-assisted by design rather than by retrofit.

The role covers the customer-facing layer of the end-to-end journey (from contracting to first bill, collection and service) across the contact channels, self-service area and support tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own customer ticketing and service, customer engagement, the continuous optimisation of support including its tools, and claim management, end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for customer service, engagement and claims across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow
* Translate customer and regulatory objectives into clear service processes, procedures, service levels and quality standards
* Design the omnichannel service model across phone, email, chat, WhatsApp, app and self-service portal
* Build the ticketing operation: taxonomy, routing and prioritisation rules, SLA framework, escalation paths, and shift and capacity planning
* Design proactive lifecycle communications: onboarding, first-bill explanation, consumption and tariff alerts, renewal and price-change notifications, and payment reminders
* Own the service side of retention — save flows, churn-signal detection and the operational response to them.
* Build the claims process end to end
* Ensure compliance with statutory response deadlines and the formal complaint framework, including complaint forms, consumer arbitration boards and regional consumer authorities
* Act as business owner for the support stack — CRM and ticketing, telephony/CCaaS, knowledge base, survey and QA tooling: define functional requirements, target design and evaluation criteria, support the IT organisation in vendor and partner selection, and drive business validation before go-live
* Hire, structure and lead the customer operations team; define roles, career paths, training curriculum and onboarding
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the support chain
* Collaborate across Growth, Offering, Operations and Finance on the business side, and Product, UX, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side

  

Qualifications

  

* University degree
* **Energy retail background is a must**
* Between 5 and 10 years of experience in customer operations, service management or contact centre leadership in a B2C environment, including hands-on responsibility for building or substantially rebuilding a service function
* Experience in the Spanish market, with a working understanding of Spanish consumer protection obligations and the formal complaints and arbitration framework
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch, including defining the requirements for the supporting tooling
* Demonstrable, practical experience applying AI in a customer support context
* Comfortable in a CRM or ticketing environment, able to read data models, define integration requirements at functional level and build reporting
* Track record of leading, growing and developing teams
* Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken. Italian, French or German language skills considered as a plus
* Experience in one or more other European markets — France, Germany or Italy in particular is highly appreciated
* Experience specifying and rolling out a support stack as business owner (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Freshdesk, Intercom, Genesys, Talkdesk or similar) is highly appreciated
* Experience in a high-volume regulated B2C environment — utilities, telecommunications, insurance, financial services or e-commerce — is highly appreciated
* Experience managing BPO partners in Spain or nearshore, and workforce management or forecasting experience, is a plus
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio or BPMN tools is an advantage

title: CP Transformation Lead GA South
description:
**Company Description**

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

 **Job Description**

**Location: any country within Geographical Area South**

**Country/Cluster Scope: GA South**

**Work Level: 5A**

The Transformation Lead serves as the transformation orchestration lead for implementing the Re-Imagine Europe programme within the Geographic Area (GA), with primary focus on Crop Protection. The role goes beyond project planning and reporting: it acts as the integrator that connects strategy, operating model design, change execution, capability building, new ways of working and business adoption across countries, functions and field-facing teams.

Working in close partnership with the GA Head, country leaders, HR, Finance, Communications, functional leads and the European programme team, the role translates the European master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap. It coordinates dependencies across workstreams, ensures that structural changes are implemented coherently, and drives adoption of future commercial ways of working, including new role interfaces, field force routines, customer segmentation, digital tools, AI-enabled productivity solutions and data-enabled performance management.

This is a high-visibility transformation leadership role requiring strong PMO discipline, change leadership, stakeholder influence, commercial understanding, digital curiosity and the ability to mobilise teams without direct authority. Success will be measured not only by delivery against milestones, but by business readiness, adoption of new behaviours, clarity of accountabilities, continuity of commercial execution and measurable progress toward the intended Re-Imagine business outcomes.

**Accountabilities**

* Integrated Transformation Roadmap: Translate the European programme master plan into an integrated GA transformation roadmap covering organisation design, people transition, capability building, change calendar, communications, commercial readiness, tools deployment and adoption milestones.
* Transformation Orchestration: Coordinate execution across countries, workstreams and functions, ensuring that HR, Finance, Legal, Communications, Commercial Excellence, IT/Digital, Sales, Marketing Activation and Technical teams move against one coherent plan and that dependencies are actively managed.
* Change Adoption & New Ways of Working: Design and facilitate the adoption approach for the new GA operating model, including role interfaces, governance routines, decision rights, RACI/DACI clarification, field force engagement, commercial calendar alignment and reinforcement of new behaviours after go-live.
* Field Force & Commercial Engagement: Engage sales, technical, marketing activation and customer-facing teams to ensure that the transformation lands pragmatically in the field, protects business continuity, supports customer impact and enables teams to adopt future commercial practices with confidence.
* Digital, Data & AI Enablement: Coordinate local readiness and adoption of enabling tools such as CRM/SFDC improvements, customer dashboards, AI-enabled sales support, data quality routines, automation and other Future of Commercial use cases, ensuring that technology deployment is linked to business value and user adoption.
* Business Readiness, Risk & Impact Tracking: Monitor transformation progress, readiness indicators, adoption metrics, risks, issues and business impact, including implications for P&L delivery, field productivity, customer coverage, capability gaps and timing risks against the commercial calendar.
* Stakeholder Mobilisation & Governance: Prepare and facilitate transformation governance forums, leadership checkpoints, country working sessions and cross-functional problem-solving meetings; ensure clear decisions, follow-up actions, ownership and escalation where needed.
* Transformation Documentation: Maintain the integrated roadmap, decision log, action tracker, risks and issues register, readiness dashboard, stakeholder map, change calendar and key handover materials required to secure continuity before, during and after go-live.

  
**Qualifications**

**Knowledge, experience & capabilities**

***Critical knowledge***

* University degree
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal; knowledge of the local language(s) of the GA an advantage.
* Experience in management programs, transformation PMO, change delivery or business transformation in a multi-country context.
* Solid understanding of PMO disciplines, transformation governance, change management principles, adoption planning, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Familiarity with agricultural or commercial business context, Future of Commercial concepts, CRM/data-enabled commercial execution and AI/digital productivity tools; Crop Protection experience an advantage.

***Critical experience***

* >5 years’ experience leading complex projects, transformation programs or PMO activities across multiple countries, functions or business units.
* Working in or with a multi-country, multi-functional team.
* Proven experience supporting organizational change, capability building, stakeholder mobilization, process redesign, digital adoption or commercial transformation.

***Critical technical, professional and personal capabilities***

* Strong transformation PMO discipline: able to structure complex programs, manage interdependencies, maintain momentum and convert ambiguity into clear execution plans.
* Ability to coordinate across multiple countries, functions and workstreams while maintaining one integrated view of priorities, risks, milestones and adoption status.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to connect people readiness, tool deployment, process change, customer impact and P&L implications.
* Excellent facilitation, communication and influencing skills; able to engage senior leaders, country teams and field-facing colleagues in a credible and pragmatic way.
* Comfortable with digital, data and AI-enabled ways of working; able to translate tools into practical use cases, adoption routines and measurable business value.

***Critical success factors & key challenges***

* Shifting the role from project tracking to true transformation orchestration, ensuring that structure, people, process, tools and behaviors move together.
* Creating strong engagement with country leaders and field force teams so the new operating model is understood, adopted and translated into day-to-day commercial routines.
* Ensuring that Future of Commercial, AI, CRM, customer segmentation and other digital enablers are not treated as parallel initiatives but embedded into the GA transformation plan and adoption agenda.
* Managing the tension between European consistency and local market realities while protecting commercial continuity, customer impact and readiness for go-live.

  
**Additional Information**

The job holder must be able to demonstrate a reasonable prioritisation of where job is physically performed and show flexibility to serve strong business need where required.

Employee may, as part of his/her role and maybe through multifunctional teams, participate in the creation and design of innovative solutions. In this context, Employee may contribute to inventions, designs, other work product, including know-how, copyrights, software, innovations, solutions, and other intellectual assets.

**Program Brief**

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solution driven, passionate changemaker, come join us positively impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future.

Since 2017, IRC has supported Rohingya Refugees and Bangladeshi nationalities communities in Cox's Bazar, Khulna, Barisal, and Chittagong with integrated services. The organization also addresses climate change impacts by building resilience and promoting economic recovery, education, and protection.

**Purpose of the role:**

The Senior MEAL Manager leads all MEAL work for the consortium. This is a full-time, hands-on role in the Program Management Unit (PMU), which manages day-to-day delivery of the project.

In this role, the post holder will:

* Set the MEAL framework and standards for the whole consortium.
* Collect, check and combine indicator data from IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners.
* Make sure DFAT-funded results are clearly attributed and that each client is counted only once.
* Build the MEAL skills of partner organizations.

Partners differ widely in capacity and resources, so the role works with a good degree of independence day to day. The aim is high-quality results, not just compliance. The post holder is supported by the Assessment and Learning (A&L) Manager, the Management Information System (MIS) Manager and IRC sector MEAL Managers and receives technical oversight from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality.

**Work Location:** IRC Bangladesh, Cox’s Bazar Office

**Contract Length:** 31st October 2027 (with possibility of extension subject to funding, program needs and performance of incumbent)

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Consortium MEAL framework and strategic ownership:**

* Design, maintain and regularly update the consortium-wide MEAL framework and MEAL Plan, including the Program Logic, log frame, MEL framework, Performance Indicator Reference Sheets (PIRS) and Indicator Tracking Table (ITT), in line with DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards (February 2026) and Development Evaluation Policy (2026), IRC MEAL policies and IRC’s global strategy, Strategy100. Ensure the framework, MEAL Plan, PIRS and standardized tools are approved and used by all partners.
* Own the consortium’s MEAL standard and practice. Contextualize existing IRC tools, standards and MEAL systems for the consortium rather than building parallel systems. Lead the standard MEAL methods, tools and reporting system, and strengthen partners’ capacity to use them.
* Agree with all partners how each indicator is defined and calculated, what data is collected, which tools are used, how often and with what sampling, and who is responsible. Ensure every partner applies the same definitions and protocols and understands the PIRS.
* Lead the annual Program Logic review and monitoring of key assumptions and risks with partners and contribute monitoring evidence to the consortium risk register.

**Data collection, consolidation, analysis and reporting:**

* Collect, clean, validate, analyze and compile project data for all indicators across IRC and all Bangladeshi Partners, for both monitoring and reporting.
* Ensure all partners collect data using CommCare-based tools and upload it daily to one central server and check the data routinely on dashboards.
* Maintain one common ITT for all partners (used for annual reporting) and analyze CommCare MIS data and the Program Indicator Dashboard (PID) monthly to assess progress and identify priority areas for targeted monitoring. Update the ITT and performance dashboards every month.
* Ensure data is consistently broken down by sex, age, gender, disability and location on every record (using the Washington Group Short Set on Functioning to identify persons with disabilities), and clear attribution of DFAT-funded results through project-specific codes in the MIS, addressing any attribution gaps through agreed data-sharing protocols and monthly data quality reviews.
* Apply DFAT’s unique client counting approach across all partners, using the program-specific client identifier in CommCare to count each individual once at service, sector and program level, and report unique reach against the target of 210,841 individuals by sector, sex, age, gender and disability. Ensure program data reported to DFAT is accurate, complete and donor compliant.
* Set and enforce common data management rules for all partners, covering file naming, storage, version control and data sharing.
* Ensure sensitive GBV and child protection case data remain within GBVIMS+ and CPIMS+ and agreed information-sharing protocols, with only aggregated, anonymized data used in consortium and DFAT reporting.
* Run routine consortium-wide analysis to identify programmatic, geographic, thematic and capacity gaps, including gaps in reaching the most at-risk groups (women and girls, children, adolescents and persons with disabilities) in line with JRP Priority 1 criteria, and flag them promptly to the PMU, outside the regular reporting cycle were urgent.
* Develop and monitor Value for Money (VfM) indicators aligned with DFAT’s 4Es framework (economy, efficiency, effectiveness and equity), including cost per client, cost per output and service utilization rates, working with Finance and sector leads and comparing results across delivery models and against sector benchmarks, and review the results with partners at program performance reviews.
* Prepare quarterly narrative and monitoring reports in consortium-agreed formats, and the MEAL inputs for DFAT annual performance reporting (led by the Program Coordinator, in the 8+3 format and aligned with DFAT’s whole-of-program indicators), with dashboards developed together with the MIS Manager. Submit reports on time and provide the DFAT inputs on schedule.

**Routine and process monitoring:**

* Lead a standardized process monitoring approach with tools and checklists for health and nutrition, protection, child protection and GBV, WASH, education, livelihoods, and emergency preparedness and response, covering quality, whether services are delivered as designed, inclusiveness, timeliness and the functioning of cross-sectoral referral pathways, with safeguarding, AAP and GEDSI built in.
* Monitor service quality, continuity, client access and satisfaction during the phased transition of services to Bangladeshi Partners, in line with the Partner Capacity building and Handover Plan, and report findings and corrective actions to the PMU and DFAT.
* Select activities for monthly spot checks based on MIS analysis (geographic coverage, program component, data quality performance and risk), and conduct spot checks with partner MEAL staff using digital tools.
* Plan and lead joint field visits with sector teams and partners, so that teams learn from one another (proposed monthly, and a longer 2–3 day visit each quarter covering all partners’ project areas).
* Review monitoring findings monthly with sector leads, and present consolidated findings at quarterly Program Performance Review and Reflection meetings, tracking agreed corrective actions to completion.

**Data quality assurance:**

* Check the quality of partner-reported data by verifying it, applying validation rules, cleaning it with a clear record of changes, and giving partners feedback.
* Lead annual Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) using IRC’s DQA methodology, adapted to DFAT’s Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards, and ensure at least 10% of reported data is verified against source documents each quarter during field visits.
* Lead on-site data verification and routine spot checks of CommCare records against registers, attendance sheets and case files (verifying sensitive GBV and child protection records only through agreed confidential protocols).
* Follow up DQA findings with agreed corrective actions and track them to completion and ensure compliance with IRC’s Data Quality Management Framework.

**Baseline, surveys, evaluations and research:**

* Use the baseline survey (completed in November 2026) as the benchmark for tracking change and refining targets, lead the internally managed outcome surveys (including the Year 2 midline) in line with the PIRS collection frequencies, coordinate the independent external endline survey in Year 3, and provide technical coordination of the Joint Program Review at around Month 18 (including the evaluation questions, validation workshop and joint action-planning workshop). Deliver all survey, review and evaluation activities on schedule.
* Develop Terms of Reference, methodologies, sampling plans (95% confidence level, 5% margin of error), tools and analysis plans, and oversee enumerators (IRC-enrolled incentive workers) and partner field supervisors, including daily data checks through dashboards, and ensure enumerators are trained in research ethics, safeguarding, PSEA, informed consent and sensitive-topic data collection.
* Prepare the Scope of Work in consultation with DFAT and share it before the evaluation team is recruited; procure and manage the independent final evaluation to DFAT’s quality and ethical standards and coordinate the management response and action plan and the learning workshop.
* Facilitate research as relevant to DFAT, such as KAP and SMART surveys, outcome harvesting, formative and multisector research, and coordinate with the protection and GEDSI teams so that the program-wide GEDSI analysis and protection analyses inform targeting and adaptation.
* Coordinate methodologies and reporting with DFAT’s external MEL provider.

**Accountability to affected populations:**

* Ensure there is one consortium-wide Client Feedback and Response Mechanism (CFRM) and coordinate it, building on existing partner systems, with safe, accessible and inclusive channels (adapted for persons with disabilities, women with restricted mobility, children and non-literate community members).
* Ensure feedback is recorded in the CommCare MIS and handled through IRC’s 4R approach (Receive, Refer, Respond, Reply), and that communities are told what action was taken.
* Ensure sensitive complaints, including safeguarding, PSEA and misconduct concerns, are referred immediately through safe, confidential pathways to IRC’s Ethics and Compliance Unit and are reported only in aggregate.
* Align CFRM complaint categories with the Common Feedback Platform (CFP) harmonized referral standards, coordinate with CFP focal points and inter-agency accountability mechanisms and refer out-of-scope concerns appropriately.
* Analyze feedback trends together with monitoring data, including signs of inclusion or exclusion errors in targeting, and work with the Community Mobilization, Community Engagement & AAP CoP so findings lead to changes in the program.
* Lead the annual multi-sectoral client satisfaction survey and ensure child-friendly and inclusive feedback methods capture the views of women, girls, boys, older persons and persons with disabilities.

**Learning and adaptive management:**

* Develop and maintain the consortium Learning Agenda (finalized with DFAT and partners) and learning logs and facilitate evidence-to-action processes so findings lead to program changes, including evidence-to-action briefs shared with DFAT, partners and JRP coordination platforms.
* Organize the quarterly reflection sessions, annual learning workshop and the Evidence-to-Action Plan following the Joint Program Review.
* Document and share learning briefs, case studies and good practices with partners, DFAT, other CoPs and IRC technical networks, working with the Communications team.
* Promote Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI), Value for Money, localization and safeguarding in all MEAL analysis and learning, drawing on the technical leadership of CDD on disability inclusion and Nari Maitree on gender equality and social inclusion.

**Partner MEAL capacity strengthening and localization:**

* Assess partner MEAL capacity, jointly with partners and in step with the joint organizational capacity assessments and develop a tailored capacity strengthening and sharing plan covering data collection, analysis, reporting and use of data. Implement the plan and document progress.
* Provide training, mentoring, coaching and supportive supervision to partner MEAL staff, and give regular feedback on adherence to agreed tools and standards, while drawing on partners’ own expertise through peer-to-peer, bi-directional capacity sharing.
* Support the gradual handover of MEAL systems, tools and decision-making to Bangladeshi Partners, consistent with the localization-first approach and the Partner capacity building and handover plan.
* Track and report the program’s localization indicators, including the share of funding passed to Bangladeshi Partners and partner leadership of MEAL functions.

**MEAL Community of Practice:**

* Manage the MEAL CoP, which brings together MEAL focal points from IRC and all partners to harmonize tools, review data quality and share learning, guided by one Learning Agenda, and lead its work, with technical support from the Head of MEAL & Program Quality and in coordination with the NGO Forum MEAL Manager (co-lead).
* Prepare the Learning Agenda and meeting agendas, run peer learning sessions, technical clinics, joint problem-solving and peer reviews, and hold the monthly informal sharing meeting and quarterly formal meeting.
* Maintain the shared repository of MEAL tools and learning products and the common action tracker and escalate matters needing management decisions to the PMU.

**Coordination and representation:**

* Represent consortium MEAL directly to DFAT, and present key monitoring and feedback findings to the PMU and, where relevant, the CPF, using aggregate data only (never individual client information) and including community feedback and the changes made in response, which is a standing CPF agenda item.
* Work with the Head of MEAL & Program Quality, Program Coordinator, A&L Manager, MIS Manager, sector MEAL Managers and the NGO Forum MEAL Manager as set out above.
* Represent IRC in inter-agency MEAL, information management, accountability and assessment working groups as required.

**Others:**

* Promote and actively participate in initiatives and efforts to build team engagement, inclusion and cohesion in IRC [team/office]
* Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies.

**Key Working Relationships:**

**Position Reports To:** Head of MEAL & Program Quality

**Internal:** MIS Manager, IRC sector MEAL Managers, NGO Forum MEAL Manager, Related CoPs

**External:** Partner MEAL focal points (Nari Maitree, Breaking the Silence, CDD, FIVDB and CNRS), DFAT and its external MEL provider

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive MEAL experience in humanitarian and development settings, including at least 3 years in senior or lead roles managing MEAL systems for multi-partner programs.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competences:**

* Demonstrated experience in strengthening MEAL capacity of local and national partner organizations, and in localization approaches.
* Experience with DFAT (including its Design, Monitoring and Evaluation Standards and Value for Money framework) or comparable institutional donor requirements (for example US Government, ECHO or OCHA) for compliance, reporting and indicator measurement.
* Experience in at least three of the following sectors: protection, health, WASH, education, GBV, livelihoods and resilience, in humanitarian settings.
* Experience leading baselines, surveys, evaluations and research studies.
* Experience designing and managing multi-partner data systems, including unique client counting and de-duplication, and client feedback and response mechanisms in humanitarian settings.
* Advanced skills in Excel, Power BI, SPSS, Kobo and CommCare; PowerApps and DHIS2 desirable.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analysis skills, and experience developing dashboards and automated reporting systems.
* Knowledge of data protection, safeguarding, protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA), GEDSI and accountability principles, including the ethical handling of sensitive GBV and child protection data.
* GIS/QGIS skills are highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions with partners at different capacity levels.
* Strong coaching, facilitation and collaboration skills, with a partner-led and respectful approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bangla.
* Female Candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

**Specific Educational Qualification:**

* Master’s degree preferred in statistics, sociology, public health, development studies, economics, social sciences, demography, monitoring and evaluation, or a related field; or minimum bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with additional relevant experience.

**Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

title: Head of Pricing and Price-to-market
description:
Allianz Partners is seeking a globally-minded pricing leader to architect the future of RSA (Roadside Asisstance) pricing. This is a strategic, high-visibility role combining deep technical pricing expertise with innovation leadership to drive profitable growth across RSA Lines of Business worldwide.
  
Working hand-in-hand with a dedicated RSA Data team that owns reporting and harmonized portfolio monitoring, your mandate is squarely focused on pricing intelligence: building state-of-the-art rating engines, advancing modelling techniques, connecting external data ecosystems, and setting the technical direction for how Allianz Partners prices RSA risk globally.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
PRICING STRATEGY MARKET POSITIONING
  
  

* Define and own the global pricing strategy for all RSA products, translating portfolio intelligence and market dynamics into competitive, technically sound tariffs across all geographies.
* Conduct rigorous technical competitor analysis (benchmarking RSA rate levels, product structures, and pricing tools against market peers) to sharpen price-to-market positioning.
* Collaborate with Regional Underwriting Portfolio Management teams to ensure pricing strategy is aligned with underwriting appetite, profitability targets, and commercial objectives.
* Support the planning process and RSA Smart Circle Meetings: contribute the pricing perspective to 360-degree quarterly reviews for top B-Partners, translating technical outputs into forward-looking commercial narratives.
* Drive profitable growth by identifying under- and over-priced segments, recommending corrective pricing actions, and monitoring their impact on portfolio KPIs.

RATING ENGINE DEVELOPMENT ADVANCED MODELLING
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end design and evolution of RSA rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, and comparable actuarial platforms, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and regulator-ready.
* Apply advanced statistical and machine-learning techniques (GLMs, GBMs, Random Forests, neural networks, and clustering methods) to frequency/severity modelling, risk segmentation, and rate relativities.
* Implement profit testing frameworks to validate tariff adequacy across the full PL, including claims, expenses, reinsurance costs, and required margin.
* Ensure all rating models are version-controlled, documented, and peer-reviewed, maintaining a high standard of actuarial governance across global markets.

EXTERNAL DATA, CONNECTED PLATFORMS ECOSYSTEM INNOVATION
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and integrate external data sources (telematics, geo-spatial and climate risk data, socio-demographic datasets, medical cost indices, and third-party claims benchmarks) to enrich RSA pricing models.
* Explore and assess AI-driven pricing ecosystems and next-generation actuarial platforms developing a prioritised technology roadmap for RSA pricing infrastructure.
* Collaborate with the RSA Data team to define data requirements and ensure pricing-relevant data pipelines are fit-for-purpose, timely, and of sufficient granularity for advanced modelling.
* Champion the use of open-source and cloud-native modelling tools (Python, R, cloud ML platforms) alongside vendor solutions, building a flexible and future-proof pricing tech stack.
* Evaluate connected insurance concepts (IoT, real-time risk scoring, and embedded pricing APIs) and assess their applicability within the RSA product and distribution landscape.

TARIFF IMPLEMENTATION PRICING GOVERNANCE
  
  

* Manage the full tariff lifecycle: data collection and harmonisation, actuarial modelling, final rate preparation, system testing, and sign-off, ensuring consistent implementation across all available pricing tools and markets.
* Define pricing governance standards, model validation protocols, and change management processes to ensure pricing decisions are transparent, reproducible, and commercially justified.
* Establish a global tariff review calendar aligned with portfolio performance cycles and market conditions, enabling proactive rather than reactive pricing management.
* Work with IT, Operations, and regional teams to ensure seamless deployment of updated rates into policy administration and quoting systems.

TEAM LEADERSHIP CAPABILITY BUILDING
  
  

* Lead, inspire, and grow a team of pricing professionals across global markets, setting clear objectives, providing structured feedback, and creating pathways for professional development.
* Build internal capability in advanced modelling techniques, external data utilisation, and pricing technology tools running knowledge-sharing sessions and supporting technical upskilling.
* Foster a high-performance pricing culture grounded in analytical rigour, intellectual curiosity, commercial awareness, and a drive for continuous innovation.
* Identify and develop talent within the team; support succession planning aligned with Allianz Partners' people strategy and the RSA pricing function's long-term growth.

What you will bring
  
  
EXPERIENCE BACKGROUND
  
  

* 10+ years in pricing, actuarial, or underwriting roles with deep expertise in PC or assistance/travel insurance pricing.
* Minimum 3 years leading a pricing function, with direct management of international teams of 5+ FTEs.
* Proven hands-on experience building and deploying rating engines using WTW Radar, Emblem, or comparable GLM/ML actuarial platforms.
* Demonstrated track record integrating external data sources and third-party platforms into pricing models in a production environment.
* Experience presenting pricing strategy and modelling outcomes to CRO, CFO, or Board-level stakeholders.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage given the global scope.

TECHNICAL MODELLING SKILLS
  
  

* Expert-level command of GLM-based rating engine development; proficiency in GBMs, Random Forests, and other ML techniques applied to insurance pricing.
* Hands-on with WTW Radar and/or Emblem for rate relativities, model fitting, and scenario testing.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or R for pricing analytics, model automation, and data manipulation.
* Familiarity with cloud-based ML platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google Vertex AI) and their application to insurance pricing pipelines.
* Experience with external data integration: geo-spatial data (e.g., Verisk, CoreLogic), medical cost databases, telematics feeds, open weather/climate APIs, and socio-demographic enrichment layers.
* Knowledge of pricing optimisation and elasticity modelling techniques, including demand modelling and customer lifetime value frameworks.
* Solid grounding in actuarial concepts: profit testing, reserving, reinsurance structures, and PL interpretation (GWP, NEP, loss ratio, CoR).

EDUCATION
  
  

* Degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Actuarial qualification or progress toward one (FIA, FCAS, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.

What we offer
  
  
Our employees play an integral part in our success as a business. We appreciate that each of our employees are unique and have unique needs, ambitions and we enjoy being a part of their journey. We are there to empower and encourage you with your personal and professional development ensuring that you take control by offering a large variety of courses and targeted development programs. All that in a global environment where international mobility and career progression are encouraged. Caring for your health and wellbeing is key priority for us. This is why we build Work Well programs to providing you with peace of mind and give the flexibility in planning and arranging for a better work-life balance.
  
  
At Allianz we use some AI-assisted technology as part of our recruitment process to help match candidates to roles based on skills, experience, job title, and location. AI supports our recruiters by enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of candidate assessments and job recommendations, while all applications are reviewed by our recruitment team and final hiring decisions are made by humans.
  
109205 | Product Management | Professional | Allianz Executive | Allianz Partners | Full-Time | Permanent
  
  
#LI-DC1
  
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer. We are united by a shared commitment: to put our customers first and at the center of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions. Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future – for our customers and for the world around us.
  
**At Allianz, we stand for unity:** we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. We therefore welcome applications regardless of race, ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
Join us.Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Technical Writer
description:
TANlock, a dormakaba Group company, is a fast-growing technology business specializing in intelligent high-security access solutions for data centers and other critical infrastructure. Since joining the dormakaba Group in July 2025, TANlock has gained access to a global network, expanded international market reach, and exciting new growth opportunities. At the same time, we continue to operate with the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit that define our company culture. Based in Georgensgmünd near Nuremberg, our dedicated team develops advanced electromechanical rack locking systems, versatile authentication modules and smart IP readers that help secure server and control cabinets around the world.

  

Position overview

This exciting expansion role requires an experienced technical pre-sales manager to lead our pre-sales engineering processes and team across the EMEA, USA, and Asia territories. Reporting directly to the Global Head of Sales, you will work closely with TANlock Regional Sales Managers and inside sales to provide deep technical and business support to new and existing key customers, distributors, resellers, and integrators.

You will serve as technical pre-sales leader and become the "voice of the customer," bridging the gap between our go-to-market teams, our TANlock Sentinel channel partners and our Germany HQ engineering, product, and operations teams.

What you will do

Technical Strategy & Consultation

* Solution Architecture: Discover customer technical pain points to recommend the optimal TANlock configurations (Biometric, RFID, PIN or mechanical locks).
* Integration: Advise/recommend clients on integrating TANlock with 3rd party access control providers, operating systems and management platforms.
* Technical Ecosystem expansion: Build in TANlock technical solutions alongside partner ecosystem OEMs and integrator systems.
  

Partner & Sales Enablement

* Trust Building: Identify and build credibility and authority with client network, IP, and security tech teams to design, test, and validate products for critical infrastructure sites.
* Channel Onboarding: Build and deliver technical training workshops to onboard partners into the Sentinel program for all TANlock products
* Tenders & Events: Guide and shape technical responses for multinational RFQs/tenders and attend trade shows, exhibitions, and distributor roadshows.
* Work in tandem with Regional Sales Managers across partner training, customer visits, pre-tender specification definition, and post-tender support.
* Build an overview of all integration and OEM solutions and leverage these relationships to cross-sell to end customers. Drive knowledge of these integrator solutions into the sales team and promote them to end customers.
* Establish, monitor and expand our competitor comparison matrix so we can monitor and ensure feature and product leadership.
  

Operations, PoC & Lifecycle Management

* Team Management: Train, nurture and lead the pre-sales engineer team and technical sales processes globally.
* Evaluation & PoC: Design, approve and manage Proof of Concept (PoC) deployments alongside local partners to pass validation. Establish a process and test plan to follow.

* Sentinel partners: Support onboarding across their technical sales teams.
* HQ Collaboration: Gather field requirements to assist in the specification of new products and features through TANlock new product development process.
* Support & Intelligence: Diagnose field hardware faults and triage Level 1 post-sales issues before handover to technical support.
  

What we require

* Education: Engineering degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, RF, Electronics, Networking, or Technical Services.
* Domain Expertise: Minimum 7 years of related technical and market experience within physical access IP authentication and access control products.
* Pre-Sales Record: Minimum 4 years of experience in pre-sales or field engineering, troubleshooting hardware, software, and IP systems. OEM or vendor experience is highly beneficial.
* Soft Skills: Proven track record with field engineering, troubleshooting large and complex IP systems and working methodologically to resolve issues.
* Good communication skills required to develop strong relationships with regional sales team, engineering, post-sale support and key technical customer contacts. Able also to leverage relationships with other business units and/or external partners to deliver solutions.
* Self-motivated, inquisitive, and possesses a "Go-Get" attitude with excellent communication skills to influence technical managers and C-suite executives alike.
* Valid German driving license. Commitment to travel up to 40% of the working week in Germany HQ and globally including week-long regional sales trips gional sales trips.

  

What we offer

  

* Competitive salary package with performance-based incentives
* Exposure to international customers and partners
* Direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers
* Opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing business
* International travel for trade shows, partner events, and customer meetings (approx. 40%)
