title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
description:
**This Isn’t Another Growth Job**
Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.
  
  
We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.
  
  
**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**
Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.
  
  
**What Ai-native Growth Means At Paradox 🤖**
Our growth machine has to be able to:
  
  

* Generate hypotheses. Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.
* Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Ship its hypotheses. Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.
* Measure with real KPIs. Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.
* Learn and loop on its own. Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox,
  
  
We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.
  
  
We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.
  
  
They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.
  
  
We do that by merging :
  
  

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.
  
  
We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.
  
  
You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Build the agents that run growth
* ❌ The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.
* Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night
* ❌ The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.
* Build a creative machine with taste
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Build measurement that checks itself
* ❌ The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.
* Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul
* ❌ The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.
  
  
**You’ll own these KPIs:**
LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.
  
  
**Desired outcomes:**
conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that runs continuously, a predictable growth engine.
  
  
**Tools you’ll master:**
GA4, Optibase, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, Claude Code, and whatever helps you see what others miss.
  
  
**THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍**
**Experience :**

* You have ideally a minimum of 3 years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally within SaaS, e-commerce, or digital product environments.
* You have a track record of designing, implementing, and scaling A/B and multivariate tests that have generated measurable improvements in revenue, user activation, or conversion.
* You’ve built with AI and agents yourself: Claude Code, automations, APIs, evals, creative pipelines. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

**You are :**

* A Conversion Architect, skilled at diagnosing funnel bottlenecks and translating data into structured experimentation roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.
* A Behavioral Strategist, fascinated by what drives human action, able to mix cognitive psychology, UX, and persuasion frameworks to design experiences that convert because they resonate.
* A Data-driven Creator, fluent in GA4, Hotjar, AB Tasty, VWO, Amplitude, not just running tests, but connecting insights to revenue, retention, and lifetime value.

**Traits :**

* Loop thinker: you see every channel as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
* Taste: you know a great hook in two seconds, and you’d rather ship one great ad than ten average ones.
* Numbers-honest: you say when a test failed. You care about real revenue, not vanity metrics.
* Builder, not manager: you’d rather build the system than coordinate an agency.
* Growth over ego: you love hard feedback, you read, study and learn fast.
* Cross-disciplinary: you move from psychology to spreadsheet to creative brief to code.
* Analytical: you turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, a metric and an experiment.

**Language**
French: Native / Bilingual
  
  
English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.
  
  
Our chosen language for written communication is English.
  
  
**IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU**
❌ If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.
  
  
❌ If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.
  
  
❌ If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.
  
  
❌ If you want to optimize without getting your hands dirty in landing pages, copy, or design — wrong role.
  
  
❌ If you want to manage agencies and budgets rather than build a machine — wrong role.
  
  
✅ If you’re obsessed with psychology, systems and creative…
  
  
✅ If you want to build the growth machine that learns faster than anyone else…
  
  
✅ If you dream of using AI to bring transformation to millions of people…
  
  
**WHY JOIN US ❤️**
Build one of the first truly self-learning growth machines, and write the playbook others will copy.
  
  
Grow something that genuinely changes lives, with the proof to show it.
  
  
Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.
  
  
You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.
  
  
**Growth & Ambition**

* > 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

**Competitive Salary**
But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…
  
  
**Impact & Meaning**

* > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
* > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.
  
  
But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…
  
  
**Freedom & Well Being 🗽**

* > 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
* > 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
* > 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
* > 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
* > 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
* > 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
* > 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
* > 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

**How To Apply 📃**
⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️
  
  
If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀
  
  
**HIRING PROCESS 📃**
That job description resonated with you?
  
  
Here is your tailor made hiring process
  
  
📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)
  
  
💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions
  
  
💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s Growth team
  
  
💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset
  
  
💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the growth vision and the next milestones to build
  
  
💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding
  
  
🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!
  
  
**About Our Hiring Process**
Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.
  
  
We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.
  
  
If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.
  
  
If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.
  
  
Welcome to Paradox.
  
  
Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

title: Chief Development Officer
description:
**Chief Development Officer**

* Prevent Child Abuse Utah (PCAU)
* Fully remote | Utah (Salt Lake, Davis, Weber, Summit, or Utah County) | Full-time, exempt
* Salary: $115,000 - $130,000

**ABOUT PREVENT CHILD ABUSE UTAH**

Since 1982, Prevent Child Abuse Utah (PCAU) has been the only nonprofit in Utah whose sole focus is to prevent child abuse and neglect. As the state's largest organization fully dedicated to prevention, PCAU stops abuse before it begins by strengthening families, educating communities, and expanding access to evidence-based prevention services statewide.

PCAU's mission is to forge and guide a community commitment to prevent child abuse in all its forms through programs, services, public awareness, education, public policy development, and system partner collaboration.

PCAU is in a period of remarkable growth. Over the past seven years, the organization has grown from a budget of roughly $900,000 to approximately $9 million. Our work centers on two core programs:

* Prevention Education: PCAU teaches students, educators, and school communities statewide how to recognize, resist, and report abuse. Through successful advocacy, this program now receives public funding, allowing it to reach more Utah schools than ever before.
* Utah Family Connections: PCAU's largest program pairs families with trained child development professionals through evidence-based home visiting. Home visitors mentor parents, build protective factors, and help families thrive.

PCAU also advances prevention through advocacy and public policy, professional training, and statewide partnerships, with offices in Ogden, Salt Lake City, Cedar City, and St. George.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

PCAU is creating its first Chief Development Officer position and elevating development to the executive leadership team. This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, strategic, and entrepreneurial fundraiser to build a unified development program from the ground up and shape the future of private philanthropy at one of Utah's fastest-growing nonprofits.

PCAU has built a strong foundation of public funding and community partnerships. The next chapter is about growing private support. The CDO will lead a single, cohesive fundraising strategy across the organization, aiming to raise $500,000 in private support in fiscal year 2026-2027 and grow to over $1 million within the next three years. The CDO will start with a small, hands-on team: a Development Coordinator who supports the gala, golf tournament, and outreach, and PCAU's prevention and policy lead. As the CDO raises private support and meets key goals, they will help shape the team, systems, and structure needed to take fundraising to the next level.

This role is for a leader who loves both the big picture and the details. The CDO will shape a long-term vision for private philanthropy while rolling up their sleeves to make it happen. On any given day, that might mean meeting a donor over coffee, mapping out a new giving strategy for Utah Family Connections, partnering with board members on the gala or golf tournament, refining how donor data is tracked, or exploring a creative new revenue idea.

This position reports to the CEO and works closely with the executive leadership team and Board of Directors.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are drawn to PCAU's mission. You bring both compassion and resilience, and you are motivated by seeing real, measurable impact through evidence-based programs.
* You are a creative, driven fundraising leader who wants to build something meaningful. You are energized by possibility, not intimidated by it.
* You are a strategist and a relationship builder. You know how to position an organization, craft compelling asks, and develop donor relationships that grow over time. You think beyond one-time gifts to long-term strategy, and you know how to make the most of an executive's time with key donors.
* You are self-aware, self-motivated, and confident. You take ownership of your work, thrive with autonomy, and are skilled at building trust in a remote environment, whether with colleagues across the state or donors in your community.
* You are flexible and adaptable, and you bring creativity and good humor to the work. Preventing child abuse is meaningful, important work, and it can also be heavy. PCAU's work is serious, but our culture is warm, fun, collaborative, and makes room for laughter.

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Lead Fundraising Strategy***

* Create and lead an annual and multi-year fundraising plan to grow private support and diversify PCAU's revenue.
* Set fundraising goals, metrics, and work plans, and report progress to leadership and the board.
* Track fundraising results and donor pipeline activity on an ongoing basis, using data to spot opportunities, address challenges, and adjust strategy.
* Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, contributing to organizational strategy and growth.
* Advise on where the CEO's time is best invested with major donors and partners.

***Expand Revenue***

* Build PCAU's individual and major giving program, identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding donors through strategic, multi-year giving opportunities.
* Grow relationship-driven foundation and corporate partnerships, collaborating with program leaders on private grant strategy.
* Lead strategy for the gala and golf tournament to increase revenue, sponsorships, and long-term donor relationships.
* Explore and help develop social enterprise and earned revenue opportunities.
* Extend fundraising into communities where PCAU has offices and programs.

***Build a Culture of Philanthropy***

* Partner with the CEO, Board Chair, and committees to strengthen board engagement in fundraising and help shape a future development committee.
* Support board members in meeting their give-and-get commitments.
* Oversee marketing and communications to strengthen PCAU's brand and share stories of impact with donors and the community.

***Strengthen Capacity for Growth***

* Lead, mentor, and empower a small, high-impact team, fostering a collaborative, accountable culture where each person has the clarity, support, and autonomy to do their best work.
* Integrate fundraising tools into an effective system with strong data practices.
* Make the case for future investment in development by outlining a roadmap to grow the team and fundraising capacity as PCAU reaches key revenue milestones.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 7+ years of progressively responsible fundraising experience, with a builder's mindset and a proven ability to launch new initiatives, expand donor bases, and scale fundraising programs
* Demonstrated success building and growing individual giving and major gift programs
* Proficiency with donor databases, CRM systems, and online giving and event platforms
* Experience with events, sponsorships, and foundation relationships
* Strong executive partnership skills
* Experience leading and mentoring staff
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Technically proficient and comfortable working independently in a remote environment
* High emotional intelligence and a collaborative, flexible, and positive leadership style
* Advocacy or public policy experience is a plus
* Background in child welfare or social services is valued; a passion for PCAU's mission is essential

**LOCATION**

This is a fully remote position, with regular in-person donor meetings and events. Candidates must live in Utah, within Salt Lake, Davis, Weber, Summit, or Utah County, with a preference for the Salt Lake area. The Wasatch Front offers a rare blend of urban energy and outdoor adventure, with world-class ski resorts less than an hour away and southern Utah's five national parks a scenic drive to the south.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* The salary range for this full-time, exempt position is $115,000 - $130,000. PCAU offers a competitive benefits package, including:
* Dental, health, and vision insurance
* SIMPLE IRA plan
* 17 paid holidays
* Generous paid vacation and sick leave
* Travel allowances
* Employee Assistance Program

**HOW TO APPLY**

Pathway Group has been retained to lead this recruitment effort on behalf of Prevent Child Abuse Utah. Please direct inquiries, nominations, and applications to jobs@pathwaygroup.co with "PCAU - CDO" in the subject line. A complete application must include both a cover letter and a resume. Inquiries and referrals will be held in strict confidence.

Learn more about PCAU at https://pcautah.org/

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**

Prevent Child Abuse Utah affirms its commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive environment that enables all people to perform to their potential. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are vital to achieving our mission, living our values, and advancing the common good. We respect and value the unique attributes, characteristics, and perspectives that make each person who they are, and we believe bringing diverse individuals together allows us to more effectively address the issues our communities face.

PCAU opposes discrimination in all forms, and we want the best person for the job. If you are passionate about our work, we encourage you to apply.

Pay: $115,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* nonprofit fundraising: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

##### **Position: Director, Marketing**

  

Compensation: Pursuant to state regulations, the salary range is $148,000-$162,000 plus bonus potential. Eligible to participate in the company benefits plan (https://cardinalgroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2025-Benefits-Guid-Eng\_SPA.pdf). We offer health, vision, dental, and pet insurance. We offer a 401(k) retirement plan, student loan assistance, licensing and continuing education reimbursement, parental leave, and housing allowances or gifts.

  

##### **Summary**

The Director of Marketing at Cardinal Group will redeﬁne how prospects and residents experience our communities in a way that drives qualiﬁed leads and ensures our communities are set up to be a place where our residents thrive.

This role bridges the gap between ﬁeld marketing execution and personalized hospitality standards, ensuring that every oﬄine touchpoint - from ﬁrst tour to lease renewal - feels curated, memorable, and distinctly ours.

Overseeing a team of Field Marketing Managers and Brand Specialists, this role will create the standards, build the playbooks, campaigns, and tools that empower on-site teams to deliver exceptional, high-touch hospitality that creates memorable moments. While our digital channels generate top-of-funnel reach, this position owns the oﬄine experience, ﬁeld campaigns, and experiential marketing engine that turns interest into qualiﬁed leads, tours into leases, and residents into lifelong brand advocates.

If you thrive at the intersection of creative brand strategy, operational standards, and experiential hospitality, this role is your platform to set a new benchmark for the industry.

Responsibilities

Hospitality Standards, Playbooks & Experience Architecture

* Roll out and maintain portfolio-wide playbooks covering every stage of the prospect and resident lifecycle (tour experiences, self-guided touchpoints, seasonal campaigns including move-in and renewal, event execution, etc.).
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and brand guidelines for on-site experience execution, ensuring consistency across all communities while ensuring room for the community brand.
* Partner with Operations and Learning & Development to create training modules and toolkits that equip site teams to act as true hospitality hosts.
* Set the standard for Cardinal with our Signature Site program to showcase the power of our people and our platform and how, when used together, we can

deliver high-touch hospitality for our prospects, residents, and team members while elevating real estate performance to maximize asset value and client returns.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to shape the end-to-end resident journey, ensuring all on-site amenities, events, and daily interactions reﬂect Cardinal’s hospitality standards.

  

Creative Campaigns & Experiential Field Marketing

* Conceptualize and execute high-impact, award-winning creative brand campaigns that generate industry envy and set our portfolio apart.
* Responsible for playbooks that set communities up for success for oﬄine lead-generation strategies, local business partnerships, campus/community outreach, hyper-local sponsorships, and experiential pop-ups aimed at driving qualiﬁed traﬃc directly to our assets.
* Manage the development of plug-and-play event toolkits, seasonal campaign assets, and promotional merchandise guidelines for communities to deploy.

  

Team Leadership & Field Enablement

* Direct, coach, and elevate a team of Field Marketing Managers and Brand Specialists, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and creative excellence.
* Collaborate with Leasing, Digital, and Operations to ensure teams have the hospitality and marketing resources, budget guidance, and creative support needed to succeed.
* Audit on-site customer journeys regularly to evaluate brand presentation, tour ﬂow, signage, ambient touches (scent, sound, refreshments), and overall hospitality execution.

  

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation

* Partner with Operations and Leasing Teams to deploy specialized ﬁeld marketing interventions for redlight deals.
* Work closely with the Digital Marketing, Customer Experience, and Centralized Team Members to ensure prospect and resident journeys are set up for success and adhere to Cardinal standards and hospitality best practices
* Oversee MarTech platforms and partners the ﬁeld uses for reputation management (Opiniion), social media (Hootsuite), creative (Canva) and production (Benson)

  

What Success Looks Like

* Lead Generation: Measurable increase in qualiﬁed leads that leasing teams can engage with, nurture and turn into leases
* Resident Satisfaction: Improvement in renewal rates, reputation management scores (ORA) and reputation sentiment score that can be tied back to hospitality and marketing enablement eﬀorts.
* Field Toolkit Adoption & Execution: Consistent and high adoption of standardized experience playbooks and campaign toolkits across the portfolio.
* Brand Impact & Industry Distinction: Delivery of standout creative campaigns that achieve internal buy-in, drive performance, and position Cardinal as an innovative leader in community hospitality.

  

Qualiﬁcations & Experience

* Experience: 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in Field Marketing, Brand Strategy, or Experiential Marketing, with a heavy emphasis on Hospitality, Multifamily/Student Housing, Retail, or Lifestyle Brands.
* Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management experience overseeing ﬁeld teams or multi-site specialists.
* Hospitality Mindset: Proven track record of designing customer journeys, service standards, or experiential activations that elevate a physical space.
* Campaign Expertise: Strong creative background with a portfolio of memorable, out-of-the-box marketing campaigns and brand activations.
* Operational Execution: Demonstrated ability to translate big creative ideas into practical, scalable playbooks and SOPs for ﬁeld teams.
* Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel up to to conduct site experience audits, lead ﬁeld trainings, and launch major community activations.

Equal Opportunity Employer  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

title: Associate Director of Digital Strategy
description:
### **Who We Are**

Teal Media is a full-service creative and design agency with a conscience. We believe purposeful design can transform organizations, inspire action, and enable progress. Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change—and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

We offer a variety of strategic, creative, and technical services, including brand strategy, web design and development, and creative support.

We’re a woman-founded and woman-led firm with a team that reflects a broad range of lived experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. At Teal, we value our people above all else and choose to work with partners and clients who share those values.

**Associate Director of Digital Strategy**
==========================================

Base salary $120,000–$140,000

**Put your digital strategy skills to work for causes worth fighting for.**

The organizations we work with are taking on some of the biggest issues of our time. They need people to pay attention, get involved, and give. We help make that happen.

Teal is a full-service creative agency partnering with nonprofits and mission-driven organizations to build brands, create websites, and turn digital engagement into action. We care deeply about the causes we serve. We ask hard questions, push the thinking, and sweat the details because our clients need work that delivers.

We’re looking for an Associate Director of Digital Strategy who brings that same conviction to their work. Someone who can earn a client’s trust, make a strong strategic call, and get into the platforms when a campaign needs attention. If you care about progressive causes and have the digital chops to help them move forward, we’d love to meet you.

**Why this role matters**
=========================

You’ll lead strategy for a portfolio of complex digital marketing engagements, helping clients connect their ambitions to clear priorities and measurable results. That means understanding their audiences, making smart choices about where to invest, and bringing paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content, SEO, and analytics together around shared goals.

You’ll report to our Senior Director of Digital Strategy and provide senior leadership on client accounts and projects. You’ll also mentor teammates and help grow Teal’s digital marketing practice through proposals, pitches, and stronger client partnerships.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* **Lead the strategy and own the follow-through**. Guide discovery, digital audits, audience research, and planning for complex engagements. Turn what you learn into practical roadmaps with clear goals, responsibilities, and measures of success.
* **Be the partner clients count on**. Build relationships with senior stakeholders, lead workshops and tough conversations, and help teams make decisions. Bring a clear point of view, listen closely, and respectfully challenge assumptions when a better approach will serve the mission.
* **Connect the channels**. Develop integrated strategies that grow audiences, deepen engagement, support advocacy, and raise money. Make recommendations that fit each client’s goals, budget, and capacity.
* **Make the numbers useful**. Establish KPIs, benchmarks, and measurement plans. Translate data and audience insights into clear recommendations, explain the story behind performance, and ensure approved optimizations make it into the work.
* **Stay close to execution**. Move comfortably between the big picture and the details. Review a campaign, troubleshoot a platform issue, or help execute when the work calls for it. We’re a small, agile team, and this role needs someone who is ready to jump in.
* **Make the creative stronger**. Partner with creative leads on campaign concepts, messaging, and ongoing communications. Give useful feedback and make sure the work reflects the client’s brand, reaches the right people, and supports the strategy.
* **Keep delivery on track**. Work with project managers, creatives, developers, and channel specialists to manage scopes, budgets, timelines, and quality. Spot risks early, recommend solutions, and keep clients and teammates informed before a problem becomes a surprise.
* **Help good partnerships grow**. Identify opportunities to expand client relationships where additional services would advance their goals. Work with the Senior Director and business development team on proposals, scopes, pitches, and prospect conversations.
* **Raise the team’s game**. Mentor colleagues, share what’s working across accounts, and improve the tools and frameworks behind our work. Support recruiting and onboarding as needed, and bring useful developments in digital marketing back to the team.
* **Balance great work with a healthy practice**. Meet the role’s billable utilization expectations while making room for approved business development and practice-building priorities. Understand how your decisions affect client outcomes and agency performance.

**What you bring**
==================

* A track record of leading complex, integrated digital marketing engagements, ideally for nonprofits, advocacy organizations, foundations, or other organizations working toward positive change.
* Broad knowledge of paid media, email, social, SMS, web, content strategy, SEO, and analytics, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one area. You can connect the disciplines and work confidently within the platforms you know best.
* The confidence and judgment to advise senior clients, facilitate productive conversations, and build agreement among people with competing priorities.
* Strong analytical instincts. You can connect performance data, audience behavior, and qualitative research to a recommendation people can act on.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills. You can explain what you recommend, why it matters, and how you’ll know it worked.
* Experience leading work across disciplines and helping colleagues grow, whether or not they report to you. You give clear direction, welcome feedback, and follow through.
* Sound agency judgment around scope, budgets, utilization, and competing priorities. You know when to dig deeper, when to make the call, and when to raise a concern.
* A real connection to the work. **You’re energized by progressive, mission-driven clients** and take their trust, resources, and results seriously.

**What we offer**

Work you can care about. Colleagues who care about the craft. And benefits that support a full life beyond your next deadline.

title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

title: Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers
description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.

Visit our website at **www.cleanspark.com**.

**Job Overview**

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
* Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
* Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
* Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
* Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
* Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
* Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
* Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
* Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
* Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
* Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
* Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
* Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
* 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
* Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
* Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
* Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
* Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
* Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
* Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
****Role Objective****
****AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.****
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (50+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 50+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

****Working Hours & Culture****

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager**
=====================

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on, strategic Marketing Manager to join the AltoVita team, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. This is a broad role for a well-rounded marketer who is comfortable switching between strategy and execution: writing an award submission in the morning, running an event logistics call in the afternoon, and challenging the marketing plan when something isn't working. We want someone who brings ideas, questions assumptions and helps shape where AltoVita's marketing goes next, as well as delivering it.

**What you will achieve in your first 6 months**
------------------------------------------------

* **Win industry recognition.** Own AltoVita's awards programme end-to-end, with a focus on our priority awards (the EMMAs and Business Travel Awards). You will select the right categories, build the evidence and write winning submissions.
* **Deliver flawless events.** Take full ownership of event execution from A to Z, including our annual Smart, Safe & Sustainable Summit, industry conferences such as GBTA, ProcureCon and the AltoLive webinar series. This covers planning, budgets, suppliers, speakers, promotion, on-the-day delivery, follow-up and ROI reporting.
* **Raise our online presence.** Sharpen AltoVita's brand awareness and thought leadership, especially on LinkedIn, by shifting toward fewer, more strategic and higher-impact posts. Grow engagement and net new followers along the way.
* **Own the quarterly Corporate Accommodation Trends Report.** Lead the research, writing, production and promotion of each edition, and turn it into a recurring thought-leadership engine across webinars, PR, social and sales.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and own the marketing content strategy, with content themes that resonate with our target audiences and align with company objectives and AltoVita's unique selling propositions.
* Shape and master the AltoVita voice on social platforms, building strong relationships with our audience, especially on LinkedIn.
* Craft compelling online and offline content, from SEO-driven and long-form pieces to thought leadership and product content.
* Identify the leading industry awards for AltoVita and write submissions ranging from 200 to 2,000 words. Manage deadlines, evidence gathering and stakeholder input.
* Research industry trends to produce whitepapers, benchmarking reports and industry reports, in collaboration with the demand and supply sectors AltoVita serves.
* Plan and run AltoLive webinars, including topics, speakers, moderation, promotion and repurposing content afterwards.
* Lead AltoVita's online and in-person event marketing, managing budgets and measuring each event's contribution to pipeline.
* Produce case studies and sales materials in collaboration with the Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Contribute engaging content to email marketing, including the AltoVita newsletter and account-based marketing campaigns, in collaboration with the Director of Marketing.
* Contribute to PR initiatives by gathering data and stories for press releases and interviewing leadership and team members for news stories.
* Work closely with our in-house designer on all creative and graphic needs.
* Build cross-functional relationships to find storytelling and promotional opportunities, and support the Sales, Product, Supply and Customer Success teams with marketing initiatives that meet business objectives.
* Bring strategic input to the marketing plan. Challenge priorities, propose new channels and ideas, and use data to recommend where to invest.
* Measure marketing performance regularly across leads, pipeline influence, engagement and reach, and report insights and recommendations.
* Maintain brand standards and tone of voice across all communication channels.
* Keep learning about trends in corporate housing, serviced apartments, global mobility, business travel and hospitality.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3+ years of B2B marketing experience across content, events and brand. Experience in hospitality, travel, global mobility or technology is strongly preferred.
* A proven track record of writing award submissions, ideally including wins.
* End-to-end ownership of events, both in person and virtual, including budgets, suppliers and ROI measurement.
* Exceptional written English with flawless grammar. Please be prepared to share writing samples.
* Experience producing research-led content such as reports, whitepapers or benchmarking studies.
* Experience growing a B2B brand on LinkedIn, with a strong grasp of thought-leadership content.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform.
* Strategic thinking combined with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, and the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Strong project management skills, consistency and attention to detail. You can juggle multiple deadlines without dropping the ball.
* A self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, remote environment with high autonomy.
* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, including comfort moderating webinars and representing AltoVita at events.

Governance & Compliance is the core of Vanta. It covers the frameworks, controls, policies, audits, and org structures that thousands of companies use to run their security programs. description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.
* **Whatever comes next.** New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners.

**Problems to Solve**

**Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet.** Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field.

**Move metrics.** Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome.

**Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems.** Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results.
* At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs.
* Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI.
* The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it.

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

**An elite AI builder.** You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here.

**A zero-to-one operator.** You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined.

**Marketplace-tested.** You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here.

**A finisher.** Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's.

**A partner who can help drive strategy collaboratively.** You work well with people who don't report to you and are a savvy cross-departmental collaborator on priorities and sequencing. If you need formal authority to effect change, this role isn't for you.

**Data-driven by reflex.** You'd rather build the query or the dashboard than argue from a hunch. This is unlikely to be a good fit if, when ambiguity hits, your first move is to guess and move on instead of digging for the number.

**At home in unresolved ambiguity.** Scope shifts as priorities do, and problems arrive unframed more often than not. That's the norm here, not an exception.

**Degree** in analytics, business or related field, with **7+ years of experience** in marketplace operations or equivalent roles.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A people-management role.** There's no team to build or manage, at least not to start.
* **A strategy-only seat.** You'll execute what you recommend, not hand it off to someone else to run.
* **A fit for anyone who isn't already an elite AI builder.** The AI bar on this team isn't aspirational; it's the baseline we hire against.

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base salary**: $175,000 to $200,000.
* **Equity component**: We want the person who takes this role invested in LawnStarter delivering excellent service, and in how far AI-first operating carries this company.
* **Healthcare**: Medical, dental, and vision.
* **Fully remote (US)**: All of LawnStarter is remote. This role demands deep independent work and close partnership across a distributed, multi-country team.
* **Flexible time off**: We focus on results. Take what you need.

*LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.*

The Director, Media Relations leads Empower Pharmacy's earned media strategy, positioning the company as a trusted authority in personalized and compounded medicine. Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Communications, this role serves as Empower's primary steward of earned media, proactive storytelling, and issues management. The Director combines strategic counsel, strong editorial judgment, and a deep understanding of healthcare communications risk to ensure Empower's voice is credible, accurate, and impactful in a highly regulated environment.  
  
As a key member of the communications team, the Director partners closely with executive leadership, legal, compliance, clinical, marketing, and internal communications teams to ensure consistent narratives across earned, owned, and internal channels while protecting and strengthening Empower's reputation.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Media Strategy and Positioning**

* **Media Strategy:** Develops and executes a comprehensive media relations strategy that advances Empower's brand, mission, and business priorities across earned media channels.

**Issues and Crisis Management**

**Communications Alignment and Insights**

* **Media Analytics:** Uses media monitoring, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to track coverage, sentiment, message pull-through, and competitive positioning, translating insights into strategic recommendations for leadership.

**Executive Support and Agency Management**

* **Agency Management:** Manages agency partners as needed, setting clear objectives, performance expectations, and accountability standards.

* Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific or technical topics into clear, accurate narratives.
* Experience leveraging media monitoring platforms, analytics tools, and AI-powered insights to inform strategy and measure impact.
* Demonstrated ability to counsel senior leaders and operate effectively in fast-moving, high-stakes situations.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in media relations, public relations, or strategic communications, with at least 5 years of experience in healthcare public relations, either in-house or agency.
* Required experience leading crisis management in healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or another highly regulated industry.
* Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, public relations, or a related field.
* Proven track record of securing high-quality earned media and managing complex narratives in regulated or high-scrutiny environments.

**KEY COMPETENCIES:**

* Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
* Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
* Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
* Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
* Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
* Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
* Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

* People: Empowering people defines who we are.
* Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
* Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
* Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

As a Production Director, you'll provide senior Production leadership across a fast-moving portfolio that may include dozens of events and experiences each year. You'll balance the needs of the client, the work, the team, and the business pushing to create consistency across programs while ensuring teams remain agile enough to respond to changing priorities and new opportunities.

* Deep knowledge of live event Production, including technical production, fabrication, venues, logistics, labor, vendors, contracts, and onsite execution. This is not primarily a film, video, broadcast, or content Production role.

* Confidence working with senior clients and navigating complex stakeholder organizations.

title: Franchisee Onboarding Consultant
description:
Join the Goddard Systems, LLC (GSL) corporate team and help shape a nationally recognized leader in early childhood education!

GSL supports approximately 700+ Goddard School locations across the U.S., helping franchisees deliver high-quality, play-based learning to more than 100,000 children and families. Our corporate team drives the strategy, systems, and support that enable schools across the network to thrive.

**Position Overview**

The Franchisee Onboarding Consultant serves as the primary operational coach and consultant for franchisees entering The Goddard School system—through new franchise awards, new school development, or transfers of ownership. This role ensures smooth, compliant, and successful onboarding and transition experience while driving early enrollment growth and operational readiness.

From Building Permit or Letter of Intent (LOI) approval through 90 days post‑opening or post‑transfer, the Consultant partners closely with franchisees to guide school readiness milestones, surface and escalate risks, and build the capabilities required to operate a high‑performing, premium early childhood education school.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Franchisee Onboarding & Readiness**

* Lead a structured onboarding roadmap, ensuring timelines, milestones, and deliverables are executed as planned.
* Guide franchisees through operational and programming readiness standards, ensuring alignment with brand, licensing, and health and safety expectations (in collaboration with the health and safety team).
* Serve as the franchisee’s primary point of contact, proactively identifying and escalating risks to the Director, New Franchisee Training Program and internal partners.

**Licensing & Compliance Readiness**

* Monitor licensing progress and escalate risk when requirements, timelines, or approvals are at risk.
* Guide franchisees through licensing readiness milestones, including preparation for state licensing visits, health and safety inspections led by GSL, and required documentation.
* Provide ongoing guidance on childcare licensing requirements, background checks, ratio rules, health and safety standards, and state‑specific mandates.
* Maintain accurate documentation of compliance milestones for new schools and ownership transitions that occur via School Transfers.

**Enrollment Growth & Market Activation** Help franchisees develop and activate local marketing, community engagement, and enrollment plans aligned to opening and enrollment targets.

* Coach franchisees on lead generation, local marketing tactics, community partnerships, and high‑conversion tour experiences.
* Orient franchisees to FMS, Wonder of Learning including The Goddard Family Hub and outlining parent communication expectations.
* Monitor enrollment progress against targets, surfacing and escalating risk relative to opening dates and upcoming enrollment periods.
* Analyze enrollment and marketing data to identify gaps, adjust tactics, and implement corrective action plans when needed.
* Introduce tools that the franchise consultant will utilize such as the Annual Business Review, System Standards Review and Wonder of Learning Review (TBD)
* Ensure classrooms are tour ready, supporting the Wonder of Learning program, shelves contain learning materials and the school and classrooms are inviting.

**Staffing & Operational Capacity Planning**

* Provide guidance on staffing models to include recruitment marketing and hiring timelines to support enrollment growth and operational readiness. Franchisee conducts all hiring activities.
* Assess staffing plans in relation to licensing, ratios, enrollment pacing, and financial sustainability.
* Coach franchisees on leadership readiness, staff onboarding, and early operational routines.

**Transfer of Ownership & Changeover Support**

* Assess operational health and safety, licensing status, staffing stability, and enrollment continuity of the outgoing operation.
* Coach incoming franchisees through a structured transition plan, including coaching, training, GSL systems access, and licensing notifications.
* Provide time‑bound post‑changeover stabilization guidance focused on early indicators of enrollment continuity, leadership alignment, and operational stability.
* Ensure continuity of child, family, and staff experience throughout the ownership transition.

**Risk Management & Escalation**

* Surface readiness, enrollment, licensing, changeover, and stabilization risks early and clearly.
* Escalate risks promptly when expectations are not being met, partnering with cross‑functional teams to resolve issues.
* Monitor early warning indicators and intervene with targeted support to prevent downstream disruption.

**Coaching, Communication & Collaboration**

* Coach franchisees on curriculum implementation, school readiness, staff onboarding, and brand standards.
* Support franchisees through opening week and/or transfer week, and early operations to reinforce best practices and goal setting
* Provide bi-weekly progress updates to franchisees and internal stakeholders.
* Track milestones, risks, and performance metrics in internal systems.
* Build strong, professional relationships with franchisees and cross‑functional partners.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Business, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience in early childhood operations, franchise operations, school leadership, or multi‑unit field support.
* Strong knowledge of childcare licensing standards and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with onboarding, project management, or school launches.
* Exceptional communication, coaching, and relationship‑building skills.
* Ability to travel up to 85% for site visits and transitional support.

**Preferred**

* Experience opening new childcare centers or supporting franchise launches.
* Familiarity with operational readiness planning.
* Enrollment management, sales, or tour conversion experience.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and project management tools.

**Key Competencies**

* Ability to manage multiple projects
* Operational & Program Readiness
* Compliance & Licensing Expertise
* Enrollment Growth & Market Activation
* Staffing & Capacity Planning
* Risk Identification & Escalation
* Changeover & Stabilization Support
* Communication & Influence
* Training, Coaching & Feedback
* Relationship Building
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
