title: Marketing Specialist - Digital Health/Healthcare Marketing
description:
**Healthcare Marketing | Full-time W-2 | Remote, U.S. (Nashville or Chattanooga based preferred)**
==================================================================================================

**About Clearstart**
====================

Clearstart is a holistic marketing partner built for healthcare companies navigating critical inflection points.

Marketing is at the core of what we do. We bring senior strategy and hands-on execution together in one connected team - helping healthcare companies build momentum, generate demand, and turn strategy into action.

Because growth rarely happens in a marketing silo, we can also bring in expertise across positioning, brand, web, GTM strategy, sales infrastructure, and the broader commercial organization, solving for the bigger picture without requiring clients to manage a collection of disconnected partners.

We plug in based on what a company needs. Serving as an embedded marketing team, providing senior leadership and strategy, adding execution capacity, or leading focused initiatives like a brand repositioning or website transformation.

We partner with select digital health companies, PE-backed care platforms, healthcare organizations, and payers navigating growth and change. Having sat in the CMO, CRO, and COO seats ourselves, we understand the challenges firsthand - from entering new markets and accelerating demand to repositioning for growth and preparing for what's next. We built Clearstart to be the team we always wished we had: senior operators working together, accountable to outcomes, and embedded enough to drive meaningful change.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You know how to take a strategy, plan, or brief and turn it into polished marketing work that is ready to perform. At Clearstart, you will execute across a broad mix of channels, learn from senior healthcare marketers, and help clients move from good ideas to work that is actually in market.

**Work in Healthcare and Digital Health**

Clearstart helps B2B & B2B2C healthcare and digital health companies navigate critical growth and transformation points - from establishing market fit to scaling, expanding, and repositioning. You will support growth-stage and PE-backed clients working through long sales cycles, new markets, complex buyer journeys, and important growth milestones.

You will work in one industry, building deeper knowledge of healthcare audiences, buying cycles, and patterns across the portfolio instead of starting over with every new client.

**A Team Around You**

You will work within a multidisciplinary marketing team, alongside account leadership, strategy, coordination, creative, and senior healthcare expertise. You will receive strategic direction while still having the space to use your judgment, ask questions, and recommend a stronger way to execute.

You will not be expected to solve every challenge alone. You will be expected to own your work, communicate early when something is unclear or at risk, and collaborate with the right people to move it forward.

**Help Improve How the Work Gets Done**

Clearstart has an established delivery model, and there is room for you to make it better. As you learn what works across accounts, you will help strengthen templates, quality checks, channel best practices, and repeatable ways of working.

Your onboarding will include a structured ramp, a peer buddy, and regular feedback so you understand both the standard and the reasoning behind it.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Marketing Specialist is a hands-on marketing builder responsible for translating approved strategies, plans, briefs, and identified needs into high-quality execution across multiple channels. This role is for a well-rounded marketer who understands more than the tools. You should understand the audience, objective, and intended outcome behind the work; know how different tactics fit together; and be able to execute without needing every step spelled out. Depending on the initiative, you may receive a detailed brief or broader direction and guardrails, then develop the tactical approach and deliverables needed to bring it to life. You will own hands-on execution and QA, contribute tactical recommendations, and incorporate feedback through approved launch or publishing.

**What You'll Own**

* **Marketing execution.** Turn strategic direction and account priorities into polished, client-ready work.
* + Understand the objective, audience, message, and intended outcome before building.
  + Ask thoughtful questions and flag issues when direction conflicts with the strategy, timeline, audience, or scope.
  + Think beyond the immediate task by anticipating what else is needed to make the work successful.
* **Execution across channels.** Build and deliver marketing work across a varied client portfolio.
* + Content and thought leadership: draft, edit, repurpose, and publish content.
  + Organic social: create, schedule, and publish social content.
  + Email marketing: build, QA, and deploy campaigns, nurtures, and newsletters.
  + Integrated campaigns: build and execute coordinated components across channels.
  + Webinars, conferences, and events: support pre-event, live-event, and post-event execution.
  + Sales enablement and collateral: create and update presentations, one-pagers, templates, and related materials.
  + Customer and retention marketing: execute customer communications and supporting materials.
  + Website and creative assets: make approved content updates and coordinate web and creative production.
* **Quality of your work.** Own the accuracy, completeness, and readiness of everything you produce.
* + QA copy, links, formatting, functionality, targeting, setup, and other details before submitting work for review.
  + Ensure execution follows the approved direction and flag anything unclear, incomplete, or incorrect before it moves forward.
  + Apply feedback so the same issue does not have to be corrected repeatedly.
* **Delivery and collaboration.** Keep your work organized, visible, and moving across multiple clients and deadlines.
* + Manage assigned deliverables and communicate progress, dependencies, questions, and risks early.
  + Collaborate with account, strategy, coordination, creative, and specialist team members to move work from idea through launch.
  + Balance competing priorities without losing context, quality, or momentum.
* **Optimization and best practices.** Use performance and experience to make future execution stronger.
* + Monitor performance where relevant and apply learnings to future work.
  + Bring tactical recommendations, ideas, and channel best practices to account and strategy leads.
  + Stay current on healthcare marketing across B2B & B2B2C audiences.

**How You'll Know You're Succeeding**

* Your work consistently reflects the approved strategy, audience, objective, and brief.
* Account and strategy leads trust you to own the details, apply strong marketing execution best practices, and deliver high-quality work without needing ongoing coaching on the fundamentals of your craft.
* Deliverables are polished, accurate, fully QA'd, and ready for client review or launch.
* Work is completed on time, and questions, dependencies, or risks are communicated before they affect delivery.
* You can independently move work from direction to completion while knowing when to ask, challenge, or escalate.
* You apply feedback, performance insights, and best practices so your execution becomes stronger over time.

**Who You Are**
===============

You are someone who:

* Is a well-rounded marketer (marketing generalist) who understands how content, social, email, campaigns, events, sales enablement, customer marketing, and related tactics work together.
* Enjoys hands-on execution and can turn strategy, a plan, a brief, or an identified need into high-quality work.
* Uses sound marketing judgment rather than simply completing a task or operating a platform.
* Is proactive and solutions-oriented, anticipates what is needed, troubleshoots issues, and knows when to escalate.
* Has a high quality bar and notices the copy, link, formatting, targeting, and setup details that can make or break execution.
* Can move among multiple clients, priorities, deadlines, and types of work without losing context or momentum.
* Is curious, receptive to feedback, and motivated to keep improving the work and how it gets done.

**What You Bring**

* 3-5+ years of marketing experience.
* Healthcare, digital health, or health technology marketing experience; agency experience is preferred.
* Hands-on experience across multiple B2B and B2B2C marketing channels, including content, social, email, campaigns, webinars and events, sales enablement, and related tactics.
* Demonstrated experience independently executing marketing work from strategy, plan, brief, assignment, or identified need through completion.
* Strong marketing technology fluency, with experience working directly in platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, CMS and web tools, email and social platforms, analytics and reporting tools, and other client systems.
* Experience managing multiple deliverables, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and experience independently QAing marketing work.

**You'll Probably Recognize Yourself Here**

* You receive a marketing initiative/plan and immediately think beyond the requested tactic to the audience, channel, CTA, dependencies, and details needed to make it work.
* You enjoy building the work, but you also want to understand why it matters and how it supports the larger strategy.
* You catch the missing audience segment, unclear direction, or inconsistent message before the work reaches the client.
* When you do not know the answer, you clarify the need, determine the right next step, and find the information or person who can help.
* Bonus: you have worked with growth-stage, PE-backed, provider, payer, or digital health companies.

**Why Join Clearstart?**
========================

**What We Offer**
-----------------

**Base salary**

$70,000-$85,000 per year, based on experience

**Employment**

Full-time W-2

**Location**

Remote, U.S.; Nashville or Chattanooga based preferred

* A 30/60/90-day ramp with COO & Account Director, a peer buddy, training on how Clearstart works, and regular feedback.
* Clear decision rights and clear expectations for what strong performance looks like.
* **PTO**: Unlimited PTO and paid company holidays.
* **401(k) plan**: A 401(k) match of up to 3.5% after you have been with the company for one year.
* **TextCare**: Employer-sponsored virtual concierge medicine service, TextCare, access for you and your household.
* **Laptop**: A company-provided MacBook laptop.
* **Paid Leave**: Paid maternity and bereavement leave to support employees through important life events.
* **Profit-sharing program**: After one year of full-time employment, employees are eligible for annual profit-sharing contributions based on company seniority, KPI performance, and annual performance reviews.

**Our Core Values**
-------------------

* **Lead, Don't Follow:** Build trust-based relationships and leverage expertise to confidently guide team members and clients toward success.
* **No Egos Allowed:** Work collaboratively without pretense, stepping up to support one another and deliver innovative solutions together.
* **Really Freaking Care:** Pursue every effort with a relentless commitment to excellence so that clients and colleagues thrive.
* **Adapt and Overcome:** Embrace change with agility to navigate challenges and unlock new opportunities for growth.
* **Creativity Over Complacency:** Approach every client and strategy with a fresh perspective, avoiding routine methods in favor of creative innovation.

**The Interview Process**
=========================

* **5-Min Video Interview:** Submit a 5-minute video answering a few questions to see if we'd be a good fit.
* Meet CEO and COO. Talk through marketing work you have executed, how you turn direction into deliverables, and what you want next.
* **Complete a practical assignment.** Work through a healthcare marketing execution scenario designed to show how you interpret direction, build the work, and QA the details.
* **Meet the team.** Talk with 1 or 2 future teammates about how you collaborate, manage shared work, and maintain quality working with multiple clients at one time.
* **Walk us through your work.** Review the assignment with CEO and COO. We will ask about your choices, what you would validate before launch, and how you would incorporate feedback. If both sides want to move forward, we will discuss an offer and start date.

**Apply**
---------

Apply through this posting. Include your resume and a short note covering:

* Do you have at least 3 years of hands-on marketing experience executing across multiple channels, such as content, email, social media, campaigns, webinars, or events? Select Yes or No.
* Are you based in the United States and able to be online from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Eastern Time? Select Yes or No.
* Have you worked in a marketing role supporting healthcare or digital health companies, either at an agency or on an in-house team?Select Yes or No.

**P.S. from Ashley (Founder & CEO)**
====================================

I don't want to hire quickly just to get someone in the door. I've done that before, and it cost us. This work matters too much.

Our clients usually come to us because something is messy. The pipeline stalled, the team isn't aligned, or the plan looked good on paper and isn't moving. That's why they hired us.

I need a well-rounded, hands-on marketer who can understand the goal, identify what is needed to execute well, and turn direction into polished marketing work. You will bring ideas, recommend tactical approaches, and catch the details that make the work successful.

You will know when to move forward within approved direction and when to involve your Account Director in decisions about strategy, scope, budget, or delivery commitments. You will care about the client, the team, and the work at the same time.

If that sounds like the work you already do, we'd like to meet you.

title: Sr. Vice President, Marketing & New Product Strategy
description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with **neffy®**, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you're motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Senior Vice President, Marketing & New Product Strategy is a senior commercial leader responsible for setting and delivering the commercial strategy for ARS Pharmaceuticals' current and future portfolio. Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, this role leads four areas critical to the company's growth: the U.S. marketing function for neffy®, New Product Planning for the pipeline, management of neffy® ex-US supply partnerships, and Public Relations and Advocacy.

As the commercial lead for the company's development assets, the Senior Vice President, Marketing & New Product Strategy will lead coordination across functions to build the integrated project plan for each asset, ensure the asset strategy is sound and commercially differentiated, establish clear milestones, and hold the organization accountable for hitting timelines. This leadership extends to ARS Pharmaceuticals' internally developed assets as well as any assets the company may acquire or in-license, beginning with the CSU asset and expanding as the portfolio grows.

The Senior Vice President, Marketing & New Product Strategy will be a strategic voice on the commercial and product leadership teams, shaping brand positioning, portfolio priorities, budget allocation, and contributing to business development decisions. The role partners closely with Sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Commercial Operations, Finance, Legal, and Business Development, and is accountable for building and sustaining a high-performing team and a culture of accountability, urgency, and excellence.

All activities will be conducted with the highest standards of integrity and in full compliance with Federal, State, and Local regulations and company policies.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**MARKETING LEADERSHIP:**

* Provides strategic direction and inspirational leadership to the marketing organization, accountable for the neffy® brand strategy and annual brand plan. Leads a core strategy centered on driving healthcare provider (HCP) behavior change, developing and executing HCP strategies, messaging, and programs that increase prescribing and adoption of neffy® across priority specialties and segments. Leads a precise, consumer strategy, deploying targeted, data-driven campaigns that reach the highest-value patient and caregiver audiences. Also responsible for complementary patient and caregiver programs. Leads the full marketing mix, including omnichannel and digital programs, by fully leveraging external agency partners and effectively partnering with the promotional review committee. Ensures brand plans are insight driven, enable competitive differentiation, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. Establishes clear brand performance tracking and diagnostics, applies advanced analytics to inform decisions, and rapidly develops action plans for course correction. Partners with Sales to ensure brand strategy translates into effective field execution, and with Market Access on pricing, contracting, and payer strategy.

  

**NEW PRODUCT PLANNING & ASSET COMMERCIAL LEADERSHIP:**

* Serves as the lead for integrated new product planning across the company's development assets, with initial focus on the CSU asset and expanding as the portfolio grows. Works in close partnership with the Chief Medical Officer, who leads clinical and development strategy, serving as the commercial counterpart to ensure the development program and the commercial strategy are built together and remain aligned from early planning through launch. Translate development decisions into commercial implications and brings market, payer, and competitive insight into development planning so that study design, endpoints, and label strategy reflect what will differentiate the asset in the market. Leads coordination across Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, CMC, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and Finance to develop the integrated project plan for each asset, ensuring the asset strategy is sound, milestones are established, and timelines are hit. Develops the target product profile, positioning, segmentation, launch archetype, and pre-launch roadmap for each asset. Defines market opportunity, patient journey, treatment pathways, and payer dynamics, and identifies where the company can win. Develops commercial assessments that inform go/no-go decisions and portfolio prioritization. Applies the same integrated leadership to assets the company may acquire or in-license, partnering with Business Development on commercial evaluation and due diligence, and leading integration of acquired assets into the development and commercial plan

  

**EX-US PARTNERSHIPS:**

* Working with the Chief Commercial Officer and in collaboration with the Director of Alliance Management, serves as the commercial lead for ARS Pharmaceuticals' ex-US supply partners for neffy® (marketed as EURneffy® in Europe and under local trade names in other territories). Acts as a strategic thought partner to these partners, sharing and gathering insights and ideas for growth. Leverages data and learnings from tactics deployed in ex-US markets to identify approaches that could help shape progress in the U.S. and across the portfolio, and shares relevant U.S. learnings in return. Leads regular touchpoints and business reviews to exchange market insights, and coordinates with Supply Chain, Business Development, Legal, and Medical Affairs as needed to support productive partner relationships.

  

**PUBLIC RELATIONS & ADVOCACY:**

* Leads the Public Relations and Advocacy team, setting the external communications strategy for neffy® and the broader ARS Pharmaceuticals portfolio. Builds and maintains strong relationships with patient advocacy organizations, professional societies, and other external stakeholders to elevate the patient and caregiver voice and strengthen the company's reputation in the allergy community. Oversees media relations and corporate communications. Ensures community insight underpins marketing programs and is attuned to the needs of patients and caregivers affected by severe allergic reactions.

  

**BUDGET MANAGEMENT:**

* Manages the marketing, public relations and advocacy, and new product planning budgets to maximize return on investment, monitoring spend regularly and reallocating resources as needed to support business priorities.

  

**LEADERSHIP & COMPLIANCE:**

* Lead a highly productive and motivated team across marketing, public relations and advocacy, and new product planning. Builds leadership capability within the team, enhances employee engagement, and visibly leads with ARS Pharmaceuticals' culture and values. Ensures all promotional, communications, and partner activities comply with company policies and applicable regulations, leveraging Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance guidance as needed.

  

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, preferably in business or life sciences; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. MBA or advanced scientific degree is preferred.
* Minimum 20+ years of pharmaceutical/biotech industry experience, with at least 10 years in progressive marketing leadership roles and a strong track record of brand performance.
* Demonstrated experience in new product planning, portfolio strategy, or leading cross-functional development teams, including shaping target product profiles and pre-launch plans.
* Experience launching products, ideally with an emerging or startup pharmaceutical company, and leading successful HCP-focused brand strategies.
* Experience working with ex-US or alliance partners to share insights and identify growth opportunities.
* Experience evaluating in-licensing or acquisition opportunities is a plus
* Strongly preferred: Experience in Allergy/Immunology and/or Dermatology.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong strategic and enterprise mindset, with the ability to set direction across multiple functions and assets and to make sound decisions with incomplete information.
* Proven ability to lead integrated, cross-functional teams without direct authority, driving alignment, accountability, and on-time delivery of milestones.
* Deep understanding of the drug development process, regulatory pathways, and how clinical development choices shape label, positioning, and commercial value.
* Strong business acumen, including market assessment and the ability to build business cases based on analysis of market opportunities and barriers.
* Understanding of the reimbursement landscape, payer dynamics, and pricing considerations for both in-line and pipeline assets.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing HCP marketing strategies that drive provider behavior change, with a deep understanding of prescriber decision-making and pharmaceutical industry trends.
* Experience building strong external relationships with partners, advocacy organizations, professional societies, and media.
* Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, including the executive team and Board of Directors.
* Entrepreneurial, hands-on leadership style and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Able to travel up to 30%, including domestic and international travel to partners, conferences, and meetings as necessary.

title: Senior Director, E-Commerce
description:
Position Title: Senior Director, E-Commerce

Manager: VP of Marketing, Digital & Creative

Location: Remote - LA, NYC, San Francisco

**ABOUT CREDO**

Credo, a trusted voice in an under-regulated beauty industry and a recognized pioneer in clean beauty retail, is looking for a full-time Senior Director, E-Commerce. Powered by a deep commitment to healthy beauty, we challenge conventional ingredient standards and believe that consumers should not have to sacrifice wellness for high performance.

Credo Beauty has stood for beauty with the highest standard since 2014. The Credo Standard® leads the way in efficacy, safety and sustainability. It isn’t a marketing claim; it’s an institution.

Credo is also where innovative brands launch and loyalty follows. Ilia, Kosas and Westman Atelier each entered the market through Credo and grew from here.

And the runway is big: 11 million potential customers shop online with no Credo store near them. For most of them, the site and the app will be their first experience of Credo.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

Digital is 60% of Credo’s business: 48% on Credobeauty.com and 12% on an app we only launched in 2025. We’re looking for the strategist who decides where it goes next.

You’ll set the vision for how Credo grows online, make the big calls on platform, investment and customer experience, and build the plan, partners and team to get there. This isn’t a role for keeping the lights on. It’s for someone who sees where beauty retail is heading and gets us there first.

As head of E-Commerce, you’re the CEO of Credobeauty.com and the Credo app. You own the digital strategy and the P&L behind it, and you’re the voice of digital in leadership conversations. You’ll lead a team and a bench of agency and tech partners, with real autonomy to decide what we build, what we buy and what we stop doing.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

As Head of E-Commerce, you’re the CEO of Credobeauty.com and the Credo app. You own the digital strategy and the P&L behind it, and you’re the voice of digital in leadership conversations. You’ll lead a team and a bench of agency and tech partners, with real autonomy to decide what we build, what we buy and what we stop doing.

**Deliver a 3-year growth plan**

Define where Credo’s digital business goes over the next three years: revenue, margin, and investment strategy on how the site, the app and our stores work together, and where we place our bets.

**Own growth and the P&L**

Own the revenue plan and the investment behind it, from acquisition through retention, and make the trade-offs that grow the business profitably.

**Build the next-generation experience**

Make Credobeauty.com and the app the best place to discover beauty: fast, personal, accessible, and as trustworthy as the Credo Standard itself.

**Grow the app into its own channel**

Take the app from launch to a full channel with its own strategy, audience and targets.

**Architect the stack**

Decide which platforms we build on and which partners we bet on, and lead us through a year of major replatforming.

**Turn data into direction**

Build the measurement that shows where we win and lose customers, and use it to steer the business, not just report on it.

**Build the team**

Lead and grow a high-performing team, and set the bar for how digital partners with Marketing, Merchandising, Stores, CX and IT.

**Offer and Promotions**

Work cross functionally with the team on offers and promotions, event mechanics, gift with purchases and pricing to drive digital results.

**PRIMARY RELATIONSHIPS**

Team: 1 direct report (Site Merchandising & E-Commerce Ops Manager) and open to build a team.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

You’re a strategist who builds. You’ve taken a digital business to its next stage, you see around corners, and you can turn a vision into a plan leadership believes in and a team can execute. You know Shopify Plus and the tech behind it well enough to make the big calls, and you know which details matter.

* 8–10+ years in e-commerce, including owning the strategy and P&L for a multi-million-dollar DTC or multi-brand retail business.

* A track record of leading a digital business through a major inflection point: a replatform, a new channel or a step change in scale.

* Deep Shopify Plus expertise and the judgment to architect a modern commerce stack.

* Strong commercial instincts: forecasting, investment allocation and the full-funnel economics of acquisition and retention.

* A data-driven mindset, with GA4 and Triple Whale fluency and a habit of turning numbers into decisions.

* Experience leading teams and agency partners, and influencing at the leadership level.

**Bonus points:**

* Beauty or multi-brand retail experience.

* Mobile app, loyalty or omnichannel programs you’ve built and scaled.

* You already use AI tools like Claude to think faster, analyze data and find efficiencies, and you can’t imagine working without them.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE**

* Real ownership. You set the direction, and you’ll see it in the numbers.

* A standard worth working for. Every product we sell meets the Credo Standard, and that bar applies to the work, too.

* A moment to shape. Digital is already 60% of the business, and the next chapter is yours to write.

* Remote, with roots. Work from anywhere in the NYC, LA or San Francisco area.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

title: Web Marketing Manager
description:
Spring Education Group is a national network of independent schools serving students from preschool through 12th grade. We believe that students can achieve more than they imagine. Each Spring school offers a carefully designed program led by expert educators who cultivate academic excellence, student independence, and a lasting love of learning. Our tuition-funded model allows our schools to create an open, transparent culture and a strong community, without the distractions of fundraising. We are building our network of schools to bring our distinctive approach to inspiring students to more families across America.
  
  
Web Marketing Manager — Spring Education Group
  
Position Summary
  
Spring Education Group is seeking a Web Marketing Manager to own search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring’s ecosystem of 200+ sites.
  
  
Reporting to the Director of Web Product Marketing, this manager owns the day-to-day delivery and health of our websites and our testing program. You'll be the team's link to IT, keep our sites technically sound for search, decide what's worth testing, and coach a UI/UX designer who builds tests. You'll also manage two analysts.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that manages and mentors a team of Analysts while partnering closely with the Content, Paid Media, Brand, and Email Lifecycle teams.
  
Position Overview
  
The Web Marketing Manager owns search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring Education Group’s ecosystem of 200+ sites.
  
This role serves as the team’s primary information technology (IT) interface, translating business needs into technical specifications and coordinating implementation with technical resources. The manager also leads SEO, experimentation, and analytics programs that translate website data into traffic and conversion gains.
  
This is a hands-on role that manages a team of Analysts and partners closely with the Content, Paid Media, Brand, and Email Lifecycle teams.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Web Project Execution and IT Coordination (about 50%)
  

* Lead web projects from specifications through IT and developer coordination, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation across 200+ sites.
* Own technical SEO health across our sites: audits, sitemaps, site structure and making sure page changes don't hurt search performance.
* Serve as the team’s primary interface with IT and engineering resources.
* Partner with the Director, our content lead and an outside SEO consultant on SEO and AI search priorities, and help roll out their recommendations across our brands.
* Partner with the Content team to brief Marketing partners on keyword, topic, and page-level optimization priorities.

Experimentation and Conversion (about 30%)
  

* Own the CRO and experimentation roadmap from end to end: establish testing priorities and strategy, then direct team execution from test design and development in Optimizely through analysis and rollout of winning variants.
* Partner with Paid Media and Content teams to align user journeys, calls to action (CTAs), and page experiences with conversion goals.
* Identify and prioritize the highest-impact funnel and behavioral insights to test, and direct Analyst efforts accordingly.
* Use GA4, heatmaps and session recordings to find where families drop off.

Data and Analytics (about 10%)
  

* Extract and analyze performance data from GA4, Google Search Console, Domo, and Google Business Profile (GBP) to inform content, SEO, and CRO decisions.

Team Leadership (about 10%)
  

* Manage and mentor Analysts, overseeing website governance, SEO execution, A/B testing, directory management, and day-to-day execution.

Required Qualifications and Experience
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in web management, conversion optimization, experimentation, web analytics.
* Experience running A/B tests from hypothesis through readout, with a working grasp of sample size, test duration and statistical significance. You should be able to teach test design to someone newer to it.
* Experience running experiments on websites with low traffic volumes is required.
* Hands-on analytics skills in GA4 and a business intelligence (BI) tool, such as Domo or a comparable platform.
* Experience working with IT or developers through specs, prioritization and UAT.
* Working knowledge of SEO: you've done an SEO audit, worked with an SEO team or fixed technical SEO issues.
* Strong organizational, project management, cross-functional communication, and collaboration skills.
* Strong GA4 skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience with answer engine optimization (AEO) or AI search.
* Experience in a multi-brand or multi-location marketing environment.
* Basic user experience and user interface (UX/UI) literacy sufficient to brief and evaluate external design partners.
* Testing on lower-traffic sites.

description:

**Description**

The Associate Editorial Director with GSW is responsible for managing editorial workflow within assigned teams and serving as an editorial point of contact for client management, medical, creative, and other cross-functional partners. This person can manage editors and helps facilitate cross-office staffing as needs arise. In addition, the Associate Editorial Director maintains assigned brand responsibilities, editing, and fact-checking print and digital materials across clients' various disease areas of focus. The Associate Editorial Director is proficient in editorial processes and the pharmaceutical advertising communications industry and independently handles a wide range of client projects.

Reporting to the VP, Editorial Director, the Associate Editorial Director supports the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of editorial processes and standards that ensure high-quality output for our clients. This role can include direct people-management responsibilities but ensuring editors have the support, resources, and guidance needed to succeed.

The Associate Editorial Director understands the broader goals of the department and organization, supports leadership objectives, contributes to a positive department culture, and takes a solutions-oriented approach to challenges. In this leadership position, the Associate Editorial Director serves as a role model and mentor, helping team members achieve department goals while supporting their professional growth.

**Key Job Responsibilities**
  
Duties may include, but are not limited to, all or some of the following:

Leadership and People Management

* Support the day-to-day management of the Editorial department and serve as a primary editorial leadership contact for assigned teams or offices.
* Provide day-to-day leadership and management for assigned direct reports (if people managing), including resource management, conflict resolution, communication of processes and expectations, performance evaluations, professional development plans, and MBO plans.
* Work to ensure editorial systems, processes, and standards are followed and issues are escalated appropriately.
* Train and onboard new Editorial hires and familiarize them with department processes, standards, tools, and ways of working.
* Train and foster the development of newer editors while coaching experienced staff and providing ongoing feedback and guidance.
* Plan and lead editorial team meetings as appropriate.
* Foster a positive, collaborative department culture and serve as a role model for editorial standards and professional expectations.

Workflow, Resourcing, and Operations

* Proactively assess workload, capacity, deadlines, and potential bottlenecks among editors they support.
* Develop coverage solutions and coordinate cross-office support as needed, escalating broader staffing and resource needs to the Editorial Director.
* Help manage editorial workflow and priorities to support appropriate coverage and timely delivery of work.
* Resolve day-to-day editorial staffing, workflow, and process issues within assigned areas, identifying solutions and escalating issues requiring broader department direction or support.
* Provide regular updates to the Editorial Director regarding workload, staffing needs, project risks, process concerns, and other issues requiring broader departmental oversight.
* Maintain and enforce established editorial best practices and process standards within assigned teams and accounts, escalating broader process issues and opportunities to the Editorial Director.
* Identify opportunities to improve editorial workflows and processes and partner with Editorial leadership on solutions and implementation.

Editorial and Brand Responsibilities

* Maintain assigned brand-editor responsibilities while balancing people-management (if managing), operational, and department leadership responsibilities.
* Supervise the editorial process across assigned accounts and teams, ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, and consistency.
* Perform various levels of editing, proofreading, and fact-checking on print and digital materials.
* Edit with a demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical and medical content, including recognition of drug trade and generic names and identification of potential reference or claims issues.
* Edit to enhance clarity, readability, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand and editorial standards without significantly altering intended meaning.
* Check the accuracy and consistency of information and supporting references.
* Produce accurate, high-quality work while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines.
* Stay current on relevant medical communications and editorial best practices.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Problem-Solving

* Work closely with account managers, medical, writers, designers, creative teams, project managers, and other partners to support cohesive and efficient development and review of client work.
* Serve as an editorial resource to cross-functional teams, helping clarify editorial processes, requirements, and expectations.
* Anticipate and identify roadblocks that may affect quality, timing, resources, or deadlines and develop practical solutions.
* Independently address routine brand- and team-level challenges while recognizing when issues require escalation or broader leadership involvement.

**Job Qualifications**

Skills

* High level of familiarity and comfort with AMA style and knowledge of FDA requirements relevant to pharmaceutical advertising and promotional communications.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong people-management and coaching skills, including the ability to guide editors with varying levels of experience.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and people simultaneously with a high degree of organization, initiative, and efficiency.
* Strong judgment and the ability to prioritize competing demands and identify when an issue should be resolved independently versus escalated.
* Ability to motivate and support people through change and evolving roles or processes.
* Solutions-oriented approach to challenges involving quality, timing, resources, workflow, and deadlines.
* Self-starter who can identify unmet needs, raise issues proactively, and recommend practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with minimal direction and adapt to shifting priorities, assignments, and business needs.
* Strong commitment to editorial quality, consistency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

* Candidates must be able to work PST hours
* Bachelor's degree in Journalism, English, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
* Minimum of 7 years of editorial experience, including experience in healthcare communications.
* Firm grasp of AMA style and FDA guidelines applicable to pharmaceutical communications, including fair balance and claims referencing.
* Proven track record of producing high-quality editorial work and managing editorial processes.
* Strong people-management, coaching, and staff-development skills.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and fact-checking skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational and project-management abilities.
* Proficiency with relevant editorial tools and content-management systems.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage tight or competing deadlines.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Head of Video
description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.

You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

**The Role:**
-------------

We're hiring a Head of Video to own every video Coram makes. Our YouTube channel already posts every week, and we're starting to hear about our videos on sales calls. You'll raise the production quality of each one and get it in front of security and IT leaders, so Coram becomes the media company for physical security.

This isn't an on-camera role. You'll report to the VP of Marketing and work remotely, with at least 2 hours a day of overlap with Pacific time.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own every Coram video from brief to publish, and set the bar for story, pacing, b-roll, graphics and sound
* Direct how we film our founders and experts, and edit the footage into videos people finish
* Publish every week without the quality slipping
* Manage our video editor and a bench of freelancers
* Cut long-form videos into Shorts, Reels, TikToks and LinkedIn clips, edited for each platform
* Plan where each video runs and how it spreads, with our Head of Content and SEO
* Own titles, thumbnails and hooks with our designers, and test what works
* Use AI tools to speed up production

------------------------------

* A portfolio that shows your taste and range, and your role on each piece
* 7+ years making video, including 2+ years owning the creative for a brand, channel or show
* Can cut the most important pieces yourself
* Have directed editors or freelancers, or managed a small team
* Able to make a technical product clear to a non-technical viewer
* Published weekly or faster for six months or more
* Grown an audience on YouTube, Instagram or TikTok; packaging and testing experience is a plus
* Fluent in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects, and a daily user of AI tools
* Clear written and spoken English

**What We Offer:**
------------------

* Competitive compensation package
* Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* For US-based hires: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance, plus a 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Referral bonuses

We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.

Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
